title: AI Engineering Lead
description:
Responsiv Overview
Responsiv is at the forefront of the legal AI revolution. The legal industry—historically slow to embrace technological change—stands on the cusp of unprecedented transformation, and we're leading the charge. As AI reshapes how legal work gets done, we're building the tools that will define this new era.

Backed by Greylock and OnDean Forward (Andrew Sieja, founder of Relativity).

What we do
Responsiv helps organizations stay ahead of regulatory change. Laws and regulations are constantly evolving—and for businesses in regulated industries, keeping up isn't optional. We build AI that understands how the regulatory landscape is shifting and maps those changes to what businesses actually need to do about it. Our platform monitors regulatory updates, identifies what matters to each organization, and surfaces the gaps between new requirements and existing compliance programs.
Role Responsibilities
  • Build and maintain robust data pipelines at scale: Design, build, and operate the data infrastructure that powers our core product—ingesting, indexing, transforming, and moving large volumes of data reliably using powerful frameworks. You'll own pipeline orchestration, robustness, monitoring, scale, and data quality checks to make sure nothing silently breaks and stuff always works.
  • Drive rigorous evaluation: Build evaluation frameworks that tell us whether our systems actually work, both data systems and AI systems. You'll define metrics that matter, run structured evaluations, and build the tooling that lets us measure real-world performance continuously—not just once at launch.
  • Develop and improve ML/NLP/AI models: Train, tune, and iterate on models that power our product—working across feature engineering, model development, and deployment. You'll contribute to the full ML lifecycle, grounded in the data and evaluation infrastructure, enabling continuous quality growth.
  • Ship fast and iterate: We're a startup, not a research lab. You'll make high-impact contributions with short feedback loops, balancing rigor with velocity. Expect to prototype quickly, learn from real-world performance, and continuously improve.
  • Collaborate across the stack: Work closely with product and engineering to integrate data and AI capabilities into user-facing features. You'll need to translate model outputs into things users actually care about, and get hands-on with Responsiv backend code as needed.

You're a good fit if you..
  • Have built and operated data pipelines in production: You've designed systems that move and transform large volumes of data reliably—not just happy-path demos. You understand idempotency, backfill strategies, schema evolution, and what it takes to keep pipelines healthy over time. Experience with established orchestration and processing frameworks is expected.
  • Care about rigorous evaluation and dataset quality: You've designed evaluation frameworks, and got to metrics that are bug-free and evaluations that are ergonomic. You're skeptical of leaderboard scores and obsessive about understanding where things actually break.
  • Have hands-on ML/AI experience: You've trained, tuned, and shipped models in production. You understand the grind of data preparation, the art of hyperparameter tuning, and why evaluation methodology matters as much as the model itself. Experience with NLP, document understanding, or classification problems is a bonus.
  • Have shipped end-to-end: From data collection and pipeline construction through model training to deployment and monitoring—you've owned the full lifecycle. Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms is a plus.
  • Take pride in building robust, well-engineered systems: You enjoy the craft of turning complex data and ML systems into something that runs reliably in production. You invest in tooling, observability, and developer experience—because you know that fast debugging and smooth iteration cycles are what let you move quickly without breaking things.
  • Thrive in ambiguity: You've worked in fast-paced environments where requirements shift, perfect data doesn't exist, and you have to make pragmatic tradeoffs. You take ownership, move quickly, and know when good enough is good enough—and when it isn't.
  • Can bridge data, ML, and product: You're able to translate business problems into data and ML formulations and explain system behaviour to non-technical stakeholders.
At Responsiv, our core values are not just words on a page; they are the guiding principles that shape our culture, define our actions, and propel us towards our vision.
·
  • Advocate like you're right. Listen like you're wrong. We communicate ideas with both passion and humility. We are all responsible for innovation and believe that ideas can come from anyone.
  • Practice extreme ownership: With ownership comes accountability. Deliver on your commitments and take individual responsibility for the team’s successes and failures.
  • Measure success: Having clarity on what success looks like is critical to its achievement. Make sure the measurements are meaningful. ·
  • Make an impact: Iterate quickly. Speed over Perfection. Results over Activity.
  • Do more with less: We value efficiency and resourcefulness. Quality is not dictated by the quantity of resources, but how effectively they are used.
  • Celebrate the wins. Acknowledge the losses. Both are important signals to help us steer the ship. Give meaning to the hard work by recognizing the moments, milestones, stories and people in our joint success.

title: Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) – Mobile/Home-Based Care
description:
Overview
We are seeking a skilled, compassionate, and dependable Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to provide high-quality physical therapy services to patients in their homes throughout the Fresno region.

The Physical Therapist Assistant will work under the direction and supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist to provide skilled therapeutic interventions, implement established plans of care, monitor patient response and progress, reinforce home exercise programs, and educate patients and caregivers on strategies to improve mobility, function, safety, and independence.
The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently within the scope of PTA practice in a home-based environment, has strong communication and interpersonal skills, and is passionate about delivering patient-centered care.
This is a 1099 independent contractor position.

Duties and Responsibilities
  • Travel to patients' homes throughout the assigned service area to provide physical therapy treatment under the direction of the supervising Physical Therapist.
  • Review the patient's established plan of care, treatment goals, precautions, and relevant clinical information prior to providing treatment.
  • Provide skilled physical therapy interventions in accordance with the Physical Therapist's plan of care, including:
    • Therapeutic exercises
    • Therapeutic activities
    • Neuromuscular re-education
    • Gait and mobility training
    • Balance and coordination training
    • Functional strengthening
    • Transfer training
    • Fall prevention and safety training
    • Manual therapy when appropriate and within the PTA's scope of practice
    • Functional mobility and activity training
  • Assist patients with improving strength, range of motion, balance, coordination, endurance, gait, mobility, and functional performance.
  • Train patients in the safe and appropriate use of assistive devices such as walkers, canes, and other mobility equipment as directed by the Physical Therapist.
  • Implement and reinforce individualized home exercise programs established by the Physical Therapist.
  • Educate patients and caregivers regarding prescribed exercises, mobility strategies, safety precautions, fall prevention, positioning, transfers, and strategies to promote independence.
  • Monitor patient response to treatment and recognize changes in pain, functional status, mobility, tolerance, or overall condition.
  • Communicate significant changes in patient condition, response to treatment, progress, concerns, or barriers to the supervising Physical Therapist in a timely manner.
  • Provide feedback to the Physical Therapist regarding patient progress and response to the established plan of care.
  • Assist the Physical Therapist with reassessments and other clinical follow-up activities as appropriate and permitted within the PTA's scope of practice.
  • Modify treatment activities within the established plan of care as appropriate and within the PTA's scope of practice, while communicating clinically significant changes to the supervising Physical Therapist.
  • Reinforce proper body mechanics, transfer techniques, positioning, and safety strategies with patients and caregivers.
  • Adapt treatment approaches to the patient's home environment, available space, equipment, functional abilities, and individual needs while following the established plan of care.
  • Coordinate care and communicate professionally with Physical Therapists, physicians, nurses, caregivers, occupational therapists, and other healthcare professionals as appropriate.
  • Communicate promptly regarding patient concerns, cancellations, scheduling changes, or other issues that may affect care.
  • Complete accurate, timely, and thorough documentation for daily treatment visits and other required clinical documentation.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations, professional standards, payer requirements, PTA supervision requirements, and company policies.
  • Recognize changes in patient condition that may require notification of the supervising Physical Therapist, referring provider, or other healthcare professional.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries at all times.
  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and professional care to patients and their families in the home setting.


Requirements
  • Current and valid Physical Therapist Assistant license in good standing.
  • Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program.
  • Strong knowledge of anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, biomechanics, therapeutic exercise, and rehabilitation principles.
  • Strong understanding of physical therapy treatment techniques and functional mobility principles.
  • Ability to safely and effectively implement a Physical Therapist's established plan of care.
  • Knowledge of therapeutic exercise, gait training, balance training, functional mobility, neuromuscular re-education, strengthening, transfer training, and fall prevention.
  • Strong observation and patient monitoring skills.
  • Ability to recognize and appropriately communicate changes in patient condition or functional status.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively manage a mobile patient caseload while maintaining appropriate communication with the supervising Physical Therapist.
  • Must be punctual, dependable, organized, and professional.
  • Comfortable entering and providing care in patients' homes and working with patients and caregivers in a home-based environment.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.
  • Ability to travel throughout the assigned service area.
  • CPR/BLS certification preferred or required according to company policy.
  • Previous home health, mobile therapy, outpatient, orthopedic, neurological, geriatric, or community-based experience is preferred.


Mobile/Home-Based Care Expectations
Because this position involves providing care in patients' homes, the Physical Therapist Assistant must be able to:
  • Arrive at scheduled visits within the expected timeframe.
  • Manage travel time and maintain an efficient daily schedule.
  • Carry and transport necessary clinical equipment and supplies.
  • Adapt treatment approaches to different home environments and available space.
  • Maintain a safe and professional environment during every patient visit.
  • Communicate promptly regarding cancellations, scheduling changes, patient concerns, or changes in patient status.
  • Respect patients' homes, privacy, routines, and individual preferences.
  • Demonstrate sound clinical judgment within the PTA's scope of practice when working independently in the community.
  • Maintain appropriate communication with the supervising Physical Therapist regarding patient progress, concerns, and changes in condition.


Documentation and Compliance
The Physical Therapist Assistant is responsible for completing all required clinical documentation accurately and within established timeframes, including:
  • Daily treatment notes
  • Patient response to treatment
  • Progress toward established functional goals
  • Exercises and interventions performed
  • Patient and caregiver education
  • Home exercise program instruction and reinforcement
  • Communication with the supervising Physical Therapist
  • Documentation of changes in patient condition or functional status
  • Other documentation required by the organization, payer, supervising Physical Therapist, or applicable regulations


The PTA must practice within the scope of the California Physical Therapist Assistant license and applicable supervision requirements and must follow the established plan of care developed by the supervising Physical Therapist.

Job Type
Full-time – 1099 Independent Contractor

Pay Structure (1099)
  • Guaranteed base pay: $840 per week
  • Base compensation is calculated at $35 per patient visit, based on a minimum of 6 patient visits per day.
  • $35 per additional patient visit for visits beyond the daily base of 6.
  • Compensation is subject to the terms of the independent contractor agreement.
Schedule
4/10 Schedule
  • Four 10-hour workdays per week
  • Typical start time: 7:30 AM–8:30 AM, depending on patient scheduling and geographic coverage.
  • Daily schedule may vary based on patient locations, visit duration, and patient needs.


Work Location
Mobile/Home-Based – Fresno Region
The Physical Therapist Assistant will travel to assigned patients' homes throughout the designated service area.

Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is a clinically capable, compassionate, dependable, and self-motivated Physical Therapist Assistant who enjoys working one-on-one with patients and families.
The successful candidate will be comfortable providing care in patients' homes, implementing established plans of care, adapting treatment activities to the patient's home environment, monitoring patient response, communicating effectively with the supervising Physical Therapist, and maintaining excellent documentation.
This position is an excellent opportunity for a Physical Therapist Assistant who values autonomy, flexibility, meaningful patient relationships, and community-based care while working as an integral member of a collaborative physical therapy team.

title: Project Manager
description:
Location: Rapid City, South Dakota
Position Type: Full-time
Compensation: Commensurate with experience

This is an exciting opportunity to join a company that works with Federal, State, Tribal, and Local Government agencies as well as private clients throughout the United States and internationally. This position is in Rapid City, SD. We are a consulting firm specializing in construction management services and wastewater operations and maintenance. We currently have an opening for a Project Manager to lead and collaborate with our team on projects within the Engineering division and cross-functionally with other areas of the business.
Job Summary
The Project Manager will provide exceptional customer service to internal and external customers by coordinating activities associated with the Engineering division. This position manages a portfolio of construction management projects from pre-award planning and proposal support through project execution and closeout. The Project Manager is responsible for supporting field personnel, maintaining customer relationships, and managing project scope, schedule, budget, documentation, compliance, and financial performance.
Project Manager Responsibilities:
• Partner with Business Development and Talent Acquisition to evaluate opportunities, identify qualified Construction Management Representative (CMR) candidates, and support proposal development.
• Prepare project rate sheets, bid inputs, labor estimates, Other Direct Cost budgets, and supporting cost documentation.
• Review scopes of services, plans, specifications, bid sheets, and customer requirements to identify deliverables, staffing needs, risks, and project start-up requirements.
• Develop project logistics assumptions for lodging, per diem or stipends, transportation, mobilization and demobilization, utilities, communications, equipment, printing, office space, and other project-specific needs.
• Prepare or coordinate professional and accurate quotations and cost inputs that align with solicitation requirements and protect project margins.
• Participate in customer interviews and prepare CMR candidates for project-specific technical interviews.
• Initiate personnel and project set-up documentation following contract award and coordinate onboarding and mobilization.
• Coordinate with Human Resources, Finance, Payroll, Information Technology, Accounting, and other internal teams to establish charge lines, timekeeping, invoicing, equipment, access, and project records.
• Lead internal project kickoff meetings and confirm contract dates, staffing dates, labor categories, invoicing requirements, project controls, and communication protocols.
• Conduct technical and project-specific onboarding for CMRs, including scope, plans and specifications, reporting expectations, project systems, customer communication, and required deliverables.
• Arrange project logistics, including travel reservations, lodging, vehicles, utilities, internet access, office or trailer needs, printing, equipment, supplies, and PPE, as required by the contract.
• Attend or support preconstruction meetings and ensure the project team is prepared for Notice to Proceed and field mobilization.
• Create and maintain project files, communication plans, deliverables lists, assignments, tracking tools, workflows, and stakeholder access in approved systems.
• Provide day-to-day leadership and support to CMRs, field engineers, construction managers, and other assigned project personnel on Federal projects nationwide.
• Serve as the primary escalation point for field personnel and as a key customer contact for project delivery matters.
• Maintain regular engagement with assigned CMRs and ensure they have the information, tools, coverage, and support needed to perform successfully.
• Attend project progress meetings and support agenda development, meeting facilitation, minutes, action-item tracking, and stakeholder follow-up as needed.
• Review project records and field reports for completeness, timeliness, quality, and appropriate escalation of contractor quality or performance concerns.
• Assist with submittals, Requests for Information, Division 01 requirements, schedule analyses, change documentation, Independent Government Estimates, cost analyses, punch lists, and closeout activities as required.
• Arrange qualified coverage during CMR leave or project absences, including direct coverage by the Project Manager when appropriate.
• Create and execute project work plans and revise them to address changes in requirements, scope, staffing, schedule, risk, or customer direction.
• Manage project budgets, Other Direct Costs, burn rates, job costs, labor utilization, and financial performance; identify and address unfavorable variances.
• Review and approve timecards, leave requests, expense reports, and project-related purchasing documentation in accordance with company requirements.
• Coordinate monthly invoicing with Accounting, validate supporting time and cost documentation, review draft invoices, and obtain customer approval for submission.
• Maintain complete, organized, and auditable project documentation, including key decisions, customer requests, revisions, approvals, deliverables, and historical cost records.
• Provide timely written communication to executive leadership, contracting personnel, customers, and staff regarding project status, risks, decisions, and required actions.
• Evaluate and recommend changes that materially affect project scope, budget, schedule, staffing, or delivery approach.
• Build productive and professional relationships with customers, CMRs, contractors, designers, and internal stakeholders.
• Coordinate cross-functional team efforts, resolve operational issues, and make timely decisions necessary for successful project completion.
• Contribute project knowledge, lessons learned, and relevant project details to past-performance and proposal resources.
• Research, cultivate, and assist in securing new work for the division.
• Provide ongoing coaching and support to assigned project personnel and complete required employee reviews and related documentation.
• Plan proactively for CMR reassignment and future availability as projects approach completion.
• Coordinate final invoicing, deliverables, records archiving, release documentation, system archiving, and administrative closeout.
• Complete final past-performance updates and prepare draft contractor-response information for customer performance evaluations for management review.
• Other duties as assigned.
Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
• Strong construction project management skills across the full project life cycle, including planning, mobilization, execution, controls, and closeout.
• Ability to read and interpret scopes of work, contracts, technical specifications, plans, drawings, and construction documentation.
• Working knowledge of construction change management, estimating, cost analysis, Independent Government Estimates, scheduling, submittals, RFIs, quality documentation, and closeout.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong project estimation, budgeting, financial analysis, and cost-control skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, facilitation, and customer service skills.
• Ability to organize ambiguous or changing requirements into clear plans, decisions, action items, and accountable follow-through.
• Ability to lead teams with varying levels of experience and coordinate effectively across departments.
• Sound judgment, initiative, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving risks.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Teams, SharePoint, and project or construction management platforms; working knowledge of AutoCAD is beneficial.
Required Education, Knowledge and Skills:
• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a closely related field.
• Minimum seven years of progressively responsible experience in engineering, general contracting, construction management, or a comparable technical project environment.
• Demonstrated experience managing project scope, schedule, budget, documentation, stakeholders, and field personnel.
• Proven ability to consistently meet deadlines and communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
• Professional Engineer license preferred.
• PMP/PMI certification preferred.
• OSHA 30 certification preferred.
• MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
• Experience supporting Federal construction management contracts and geographically dispersed field teams preferred.
Work Environment:
This position operates onsite in Rapid City, SD, primarily in a professional office environment using standard office equipment such as laptop computers, photocopiers, and smartphones.

The position may require lifting files, opening filing cabinets, and bending or standing on a stool as necessary. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the position.

title: Director of Financing
description:
Scope of Job
PowerFlex, an EDF Renewables company, is a leading national provider of intelligent onsite energy solutions that support carbon-free electrification and transportation. The Company delivers integrated solar, storage, EV charging, and microgrid systems, to businesses and organizations. As a single full-service provider, PowerFlex customizes clean technology solutions to help clients achieve their energy and sustainability goals. Through the comprehensive PowerFlex X platform, PowerFlex leverages patented smart software to control, monitor, and optimize a client's distributed energy resources to reduce cost and maximize return on investment.

The Director of Financing is responsible for successful financing of Powerflex’s distributed energy projects such as solar, solar-plus-storage and/or EVSE. The role oversees all financing aspects of the renewable energy projects, including risk assessment, project returns/economics, contract negotiations, diligence, and transaction structuring. The role leads/manages day-to-day activities of the financing department, sets commercial standards to ensure bankability of assets, and negotiates key financing agreements. The role works across the company’s legal, project development, sales, engineering, and construction teams to manage critical activities around asset financing in order to drive company revenue and profit generation from Third-Party Owned (TPO) projects.

THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY 10/31/26.

Location
This role would be required to be a hybrid role out of one of our offices (Mountain View, CA, San Diego, CA, Los Angeles, CA. or New York, NY).

Responsibilities
Ensure efficient and timely closing of financing of TPO projects developed by the company. Key responsibilities include:

  • Oversee a team responsible of all phases of transaction execution, including investor due diligence, project marketing/solicitation, financing terms & price negotiation, bid evaluation/analysis, structuring, financial modeling, and transaction closing.
  • Monitor the project pipeline to identify which projects will require financing.
  • Plan the timing of financing efforts in order to avoid construction delays.
  • Negotiate key financing contracts (e.g., MIPAs, EPCs, etc.) with investors and other commercial agreements with counterparties.
  • Work with advisors and internal and external legal personnel with respect to the structuring, negotiation and closing of financing deals.
  • Establish/manage relationships with investors and financial institutions and maintain an investor database.
  • Support Power Purchase Agreement and Lease contract negotiations and ensure financeability of contracts signed.
  • Set commercial standards to ensure bankability of the projects and provide guidance on return thresholds for projects with non IG offtakers.
  • Oversee project cash flow modeling of TPO projects and guide the business development team on offtake rate analyses in competitive situations and in cases that are outside of standard financing guidelines.
  • Drive risk management along with project development team to ensure that projects earmarked for financing meet contract standard criteria, adhere to internal requirements, and maintain detailed diligence documentation.
  • Deliver actional recommendations to the executive team on financing matters, and prepare/secure Board Approvals for financing transactions.
  • Identify and drive initiatives to continuously improve and/or automate business processes across Powerflex, with a focus on tools or processes related to financing.
  • Implement processes for financing of a fund’s projects per fund’s investment agreement, including.
  • Arrange fund financing (tax equity, transferability, etc.)
  • Implement/improve funds processes including standard forms of notice, contracts, shared model, share OPEX assumptions, DD checklist.

Qualifications
Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics; MBA, CFA or JD a plus
  • 6+ progressive experience in finance roles, at least 3 of which focused on solar or other renewable energy financing.
  • Deep understanding of project finance, including an exceptional overall understanding of finance and experience with detailed project finance concepts such as tax equity structures.
  • Strong understanding of financing contracts and ability to quickly and efficiently markup and gather comments to transaction documents.
Skills/Knowledge/Abilities
  • First-rate financial modelling skills, including the ability to train junior staff, quickly check their work, or jump in and do-it-yourself when needed.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and develop high-performing teams.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.
  • Respectfully challenges peers, and welcomes the opportunity when others challenge you.
  • Flexible, resilient, and curious.

Compensation
The pay range for this position is $185,760 - $227,040 annually. This position is eligible for PowerFlex's comprehensive Health and Welfare plans including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, 401(k) retirement plan and paid time off. The total compensation for this position may include an annual performance bonus (or other incentive compensation, as applicable). PowerFlex's compensation packages carefully consider a candidate's qualifications, experiences, and education in relation to the position.

description:
Summary:
The Systems Engineer provides the business knowledge and technical skills to implement technical strategies, evaluate products and provide a superior level of technical design/support that benefit the company.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Provide senior level technical guidance and serve as an escalation point for the Information Technology (IT) Team.
Provide senior level direction to the IT team, assist with mentoring and providing technical guidance to more junior staff members.
Work on and manage all phases of systems administration including definition, design, implementation, and testing of new service rollouts.
Coordinates and/or performs additions and changes to network hardware and operating systems and attached devices; includes investigation, analysis, recommendation, configuration, installation and testing of new network hardware and software.
Provides direct support in the day-to-day operations on network hardware and operating systems; duties include evaluation of system utilization, monitoring response time and primary support for detection and correction of operational problems.
Troubleshoots at the physical level of the network, working with network measurement hardware and software, as well as physical checking and testing of hardware devices, at the logical level working with communication protocols.
Define, communicate, and manage the execution of infrastructure strategy, standards and roadmaps based on the current state and short- and long-term needs of the enterprise.
Participate in the Global IT planning process and ensure architectural designs and principles are incorporated in enterprise implementations.
Evaluate existing or emerging technologies to consider factors such as cost, security, compatibility, and usability.
Establish strong relationships with key technology stakeholders and facilitate, communicate, collaborate, and persuade others in the definition, adoption, and implementation of a coherent architecture.
Participate in the building of roadmaps for acquiring, integrating, and implementing high-value technology and processes. Oversee efforts (e.g. proof of concepts) to measure and prove new technology value.
Design and deploy best practices regarding system monitoring, change control, service level agreements, and in the creation of the company’s infrastructure policies and standards.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Education and Work Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in information systems (Preferred) or related experience.
DoD 8570 level II (or higher) security certification (examples: CCNA, CND, Cloud+, Security+ CE,); OR can obtain the certification within 6 months of start date.
Minimum of ten years of experience within information technology
Minimum of five years of experience in a similar role and/or a strong demonstrated portfolio of completed IT/networking related projects.

Experience in the most current technologies and products used in the industry.

Strong proficiency in networking protocols and infrastructure (Ethernet, TCP, IP, HTTP, DNS, ICMP, DNS, DHCP, IPv4, Routing, LAN/WAN)
Strong proficiency with disaster recovery, backup technologies and recovery/restores.
Strong proficiency with systems hardening and network security.
Experience managing on-premise and cloud-based virtualization (VMware vSphere, Amazon Web Services)
Experience with monitoring and alerting systems (SolarWinds, Orion)
Experience with SSO solutions and implementation is a plus.
Experience with ITIL best practices.

Work Authorization/Security Clearance Requirements:

This position requires a government security clearance. Will be a part of the onboarding process.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
List of needed knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully accomplish the duties and responsibilities of the job.

Can multitask and manage multiple large to small projects in a cross functional environment.
Performs day-to-day administrative tasks such as maintaining information files and processing paperwork.
Work in a high energy, high volume, rapidly changing environment.
Displays a high level of initiative, effort, and commitment towards completing assignments in a timely manner.
Clear and effective communication skills in both written and spoken forms.
Knowledge of computer applications including email, databases, word-processing program, and spreadsheets (such as Microsoft Office).
Ensures that decisions are made based on policies, rules, and organizational directives to solve emerging problems.
Maintains confidentiality while processing and handling confidential information with discretion.
Knowledge and/or experience in writing, editing, and debugging new computer programs for assigned projects, including necessary records and desired output.
Knowledge of Active Directory, GPO’s, users and computers, Application support experience with Microsoft Exchange, Office products
Strong Knowledge of VMware environment.
Working and support knowledge of switch administration Cisco switches.
Must have the ability to solve technical and operation problems, showing a high level of customer service and project management skills.
Strong Knowledge of Server Administration for current Windows Server versions.

Work Conditions:
Environment Type:

Indoors. Production and Office Environment. Temperature Controlled.

Exposure Types:

Small and/or enclosed spaces

Work Hours:

On-call for emergent conditions.
Standard work schedule, overtime may be necessary for meeting deadlines, required travel, and emergent conditions.

Travel Requirements:

This position may involve travel up to 20% of the time.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Medium work that includes moving objects up to 50 pounds.

title: Senior Product Manager - Createspace
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager - Createspace based in Canada.

This is a senior product leadership opportunity focused on shaping and delivering innovative software experiences within a large-scale learning technology environment.
You’ll own the product lifecycle from discovery and strategy through delivery, market launch, post-release optimization, and eventual end-of-life.
The role combines customer empathy, strategic planning, market insight, and hands-on product execution.
You’ll develop roadmaps and product requirements while balancing customer value, business viability, technical feasibility, and usability.
Working closely with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and senior leadership, you’ll translate organizational strategy into impactful product initiatives.
The position offers the opportunity to influence product innovation, build industry-leading creation experiences, and contribute to the future direction of the portfolio.
You’ll operate in a collaborative, agile environment where data, continuous learning, and measurable business outcomes guide product decisions.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead the success of product features and initiatives across the full lifecycle, from customer discovery and product alignment through requirements, development, market delivery, post-release management, and end-of-life.
  • Apply curiosity and empathy to understand customer needs, initiating and participating in internal and external user research, discovery, and empathy sessions.
  • Develop and maintain product and feature roadmaps that balance customer value, business viability, technical feasibility, and usability in collaboration with engineering and design.
  • Gather and incorporate input from engineering, marketing, sales, customer engagement, leadership, and other stakeholders to address priority customer and market needs.
  • Translate organizational strategy, business requirements, and market opportunities into a clear and actionable product roadmap.
  • Convert product vision and roadmap initiatives into well-defined product requirements, including functional needs, supported use cases and workflows, constraints, and measurable success criteria.
  • Maintain a data-driven product backlog aligned with the product vision and roadmap, continuously incorporating customer feedback, sales insights, service input, competitive intelligence, and market developments.
  • Partner with engineering, design, senior management, and executive stakeholders to ensure product objectives and organizational priorities are achieved.
  • Drive product innovation, advocate for product direction, and identify opportunities to develop new industry-leading creation products and services.
  • Ensure release candidates meet defined product requirements and collaborate across architecture, engineering, PMO, implementation, support, marketing, market strategy, and customer teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Conduct feasibility assessments, including ROI analysis, business case development, and build-versus-buy-or-partner evaluations.
  • Represent product thought leadership at relevant industry events and contribute to broader market and product positioning.

    • Requirements

    • Typically, 8+ years of experience in software product management, with demonstrated expertise across product planning, market research, competitive analysis, positioning, enablement, evangelism, and product marketing.
    • Strong business and technical acumen, with the ability to connect customer needs, market opportunities, technical constraints, and business outcomes.
    • Proven ability to create product strategies and visions for larger initiatives, smaller experiences, and cross-cutting product opportunities.
    • Experience developing product roadmaps that are clearly aligned with organizational strategy and customer needs.
    • Strong prioritization skills, including the ability to break complex initiatives into focused, deliverable increments and visualize thin slices of value.
    • Demonstrated progress toward measurable, data-backed business outcomes and experience using insights to inform product decisions.
    • Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to enable, inform, and communicate effectively across diverse teams and stakeholder groups.
    • Experience partnering closely with software development and design teams on feature definition, prioritization, delivery, and defect management.
    • Strong go-to-market planning capabilities and an understanding of how to bring software products and features successfully to market.
    • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, strategic thinking, and decision-making skills.
    • A continuous-learning mindset and demonstrated acumen with artificial intelligence tools.
    • A strategic, results-driven, and highly motivated approach, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and navigate ambiguity.

      • Benefits

      • CAD $110,000–$150,000 annual base salary, with the final offer determined by relevant knowledge, skills, education, training, experience, geographic market data, and internal/external competitiveness.
      • Potential eligibility for additional compensation and benefits, including wellness subsidies, equity grants, and variable incentives.
      • Flexible work arrangements, with the role open to candidates anywhere in Canada.
      • Hybrid work opportunity, with an expectation for the ideal candidate to work approximately 3 days per week from a physical office location.
      • Learning and growth opportunities to support ongoing professional development.
      • Up to CAD $4,000 in tuition reimbursement for continuing education through the SkillsWave program.
      • 2 paid days off for SkillsWave-related activities such as exams or final assignments.
      • Employee wellbeing support, including access to mental health services, an Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP), financial planning, and related resources.
      • Retirement planning support and a competitive benefits package.
      • 2 paid volunteer days per year.
      • Home internet reimbursement.
      • Wellness reimbursement and employee recognition programs.
      • Employee referral program and social events.
      • Access to dog-friendly office spaces at select locations.
      • An opportunity to contribute to impactful work focused on transforming how people learn and develop.

title: Clinician - Community-Based Complex Needs Program
description:
About the Role
Wood’s Homes is seeking a skilled, adaptable, and creative Clinician to support youth whose needs extend beyond traditional office-based service models. This role is ideal for a graduate-level clinical professional who values relationship-based practice, interdisciplinary collaboration, and flexible intervention in real-world settings. The Clinician will provide direct clinical services while working alongside youth, families, caregivers, frontline staff, schools, healthcare providers, and community partners to support safety, stability, engagement, and meaningful progress.
Why This Opportunity Stands Out

Community-based clinical practice: provide support in homes, schools, recreational spaces, and other natural environments where youth live, learn, and connect.
Complex youth work: support young people with developmental disabilities, dual diagnosis, mental health concerns, substance use, trauma, attachment disruption, and high-risk behavioural presentations.
Treatment with creativity: use flexible, experiential, and evidence-informed approaches to engage youth who may be reluctant to participate in traditional counselling.
Clinical consultation and mentorship: help frontline teams translate assessment, formulation, and clinical theory into practical day-to-day support.
Collaborative practice: work closely with families, caregivers, schools, healthcare providers, Indigenous supports, and community partners.
Professional growth: contribute to case consultation, risk review, staff learning, specialized projects, and ongoing clinical development.

Key Responsibilities

Provide direct clinical services to youth through individual, family, group, and community-based intervention and therapy.
Build meaningful therapeutic relationships with youth who may be resistant to, disengaged from, or unsuccessful in traditional clinical services.
Complete comprehensive clinical assessments, including functional behaviour assessments, mental health assessments, risk assessments, and treatment planning.
Develop and support individualized treatment goals, safety plans, behavioural support strategies, and transition recommendations in collaboration with the broader care team.
Provide flexible, creative, and responsive interventions in real-time settings, including homes, schools, recreational environments, and community locations.
Adapt evidence-based interventions to meet the developmental, cognitive, communication, behavioural, and cultural needs of each youth.
Assess and respond effectively to crisis situations while maintaining therapeutic engagement, emotional safety, and professional judgment.
Provide consultation, coaching, and mentorship to frontline staff to strengthen their understanding of complex youth presentations and intervention strategies.
Support teams in understanding the interaction between developmental disabilities, mental health challenges, substance use, trauma, attachment, and behavioural expressions.
Facilitate case consultations, clinical risk reviews, and collaborative treatment planning processes.
Maintain timely, high-quality clinical documentation and reports in accordance with professional and organizational requirements.
Work collaboratively with families, caregivers, schools, healthcare providers, community partners, and internal program teams.
Contribute to staff learning, reflective practice, quality improvement, and specialized projects as assigned.

What You Bring

Master’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, Occupational Therapy, or a related clinical discipline.
Current registration and good standing with the applicable professional regulatory body.
Clinical experience supporting youth with dual diagnosis, developmental disabilities, complex mental health presentations, substance use disorders, trauma, attachment disruption, acute behavioural challenges, and concurrent mental health and neurodevelopmental needs.
Experience conducting clinical assessments and developing practical treatment plans and recommendations. Formal psychological assessment experience is considered a strong asset.
Strong understanding of trauma-informed, strengths-based, attachment-focused, harm reduction, culturally responsive, and person-centered approaches.
Sound clinical judgment and the ability to think critically in dynamic and rapidly changing situations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce timely, clear, and high-quality clinical documentation.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with interdisciplinary teams, families, caregivers, schools, healthcare providers, and community partners.

Clinical Practice Expectations

Ability to establish therapeutic relationships with youth who are resistant to, disengaged from, or unsuccessful in traditional office-based clinical services.
Demonstrated ability to provide flexible, creative, and responsive interventions in real-time community settings, including homes, schools, recreational environments, and other natural supports.
Skilled in adapting evidence-based interventions to meet the developmental, cognitive, communication, and behavioural needs of youth.
Strong understanding of trauma-informed, strengths-based, attachment-focused, harm reduction, and person-centered approaches.
Ability to assess and respond effectively to crisis situations while maintaining therapeutic engagement and emotional safety.

Consultation & Clinical Leadership

Provide ongoing consultation, coaching, and mentorship to frontline staff to enhance understanding of complex youth presentations and clinical intervention strategies.
Support staff in translating clinical theories and evidence-based practices into practical day-to-day interactions and interventions.
Assist teams in understanding the interplay between developmental disabilities, mental health challenges, substance use, trauma, attachment, and behavioural presentations.
Facilitate case consultations, clinical risk reviews, and collaborative treatment planning processes.

Promote reflective practice and skill development among direct service staff.

Additional Requirements

Current proof of professional registration may be required.
A valid Alberta Class 5 or Class 5 GDL driver’s license, automobile insurance with $2 million liability coverage, and a driver’s abstract with no more than six demerits.

title: Medical Coordinator (LVN) - Day Shift
description:
“Every person deserves compassion, dignity, and the safety of a place to call home.”
Homelessness is the largest social and public health crisis in California. Illumination Health + Home is a growing non-profit organization dedicated towards disrupting the cycle of homelessness by providing targeted, interdisciplinary services in our recuperative care centers, emergency shelters, housing services and children's and family programs. IHH currently has 13+ facilities with 22+ micro-communities scattered across Orange County, Los Angeles County and the Inland Empire.

Job Description

The Medical Coordinator (LVN) is responsible for delivering high quality medical care and influencing positive outcomes for patients experiencing homelessness in the recuperative care setting. We have many schedules available for this role, including weekends and nights.

  • The pay range for this position is $34.00 - $36.00 per hour, depending on experience.
  • This position also qualifies for $1.50 swing shift differential and $3.00 graveyard shift differential.
  • The schedule for this position is 7:00am to 5:30pm. Sunday - Wednesday (four 10 hour shifts). Workdays may vary.
  • Work site may vary based on operational needs.

Responsibilities

Client Care:

  • Perform initial intake to ensure that an appropriate care plan is established based on discharge information from the hospital or primary care notes
    • Assess health status of patient upon arrival by conducting head to toe assessment and checking vitals
    • Determine the patient’s insurance status, make follow up appointments with patient’s providers and reviewing medication list
  • Establish and maintain a care plan
    • Set weekly goals for patient to complete to assist with medical or social reintegration, verify goal completion, and assess medical needs.
  • Conduct morning, afternoon, and evening checks for all assigned clients to observe wellbeing, ensuring there is no change in medical conditions since hospital discharge.
  • Link clients to medical services when necessary (insurance, PCP, specialists, referrals).
  • Coordinate home health visits (if needed) and follow-up on medical appointments.
  • Promote health literacy by providing patient education with regards to clients’ illnesses, medications, preventative measures, treatment management and overall general health.
  • Arrange transportation for clients to and from medical appointments, as needed
  • Report emergency situations to Supervisor/Manager and document incident
    • Seek proper level of care to assess and treat medical complication
    • Initiate medical response system when appropriate
  • Support patient recuperation by providing necessary items and space needed to rehabilitate and assisting with the upkeep of the facility.

Administrative/Record Keeping:

  • Enter patient information and case notes into EHR and other documentation systems.
  • Complete and update medication, vitals, progress notes and care plan
  • Perform administrative tasks such as answering phones and filing paperwork.
  • Prepare patient reports for billing.
  • Maintain proper inventory of medical supplies and medications.

Compliance/Safety:

  • Maintain confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA guidelines, Illumination Foundation policies and DHS standards.
  • Provide patients with proper compliance forms upon admission
  • Utilize infection control measures according to OSHA standards.
  • Conduct medication reconciliation and ensure proper disposal and pickup of bio-medical/pharmaceutical waste.
  • Maintain a safe work environment by ensuring the cleanliness of the med room, wound care room, and medication storage room.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Current and non-restricted LVN license in California
  • 2 years of relevant experience.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Basic computer skills, including the ability to send and receive emails and summarize data in spreadsheets.
  • Valid CA Driver’s License.

Preferred:

  • Availability to work weekends and nights
  • Home Health nursing experience and experience working with populations dealing with addiction and behavioral health conditions.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, Calendar) and KIPU or other electronic health record systems.

Benefits

  • Medical Insurance funded by Illumination Health + Home (Kaiser and Blue Shield), depending on the plan
  • Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Life, AD&D and LTD Insurance funded 100% by Illumination Health + Home
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • 401K with Company Matching
  • 10 days vacation PTO/year
  • 6 days sick PTO/year
  • 10 days holiday PTO/year

title: Senior Software Development Engineer L4
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer L4 based in United States.

This role offers the opportunity to build and evolve a healthcare analytics platform that transforms complex data into actionable insights.
You’ll work across the full technology stack, developing web applications, APIs, data pipelines, reports, and visualizations.
The position combines hands-on software engineering with data engineering and business intelligence in a small, highly collaborative team.
Your work will directly support client-facing analytics involving healthcare claims, remittance, and related data.
You’ll contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from technical design and estimation through implementation, testing, deployment, and optimization.
Because the platform handles sensitive healthcare information, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance are integral to the engineering process.
This is an ideal environment for an autonomous, growth-minded engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and taking ownership from concept through delivery.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality full-stack software across front-end, back-end, and API layers.
  • Build and enhance web application features using Angular, C#, REST APIs, SQL, and related technologies.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize data-driven reports and dashboards that provide clients with meaningful views of healthcare claims, remittance, and related information.
  • Support data ingestion and transformation pipelines that move source information into the analytics database for reporting and business intelligence.
  • Write clean, testable code aligned with team standards and use test-first development practices where appropriate.
  • Work with MSSQL and Snowflake to develop features, troubleshoot issues, perform performance tuning, and optimize data-related functionality.
  • Participate in architecture and code reviews, iteration demos, retrospectives, and other collaborative engineering activities.
  • Partner with product management to scope, estimate, prioritize, and deliver enhancements while adapting to evolving technical and business requirements.
  • Take ownership of ideas and technical solutions from stakeholder proposal through completion, proactively identifying and resolving obstacles.
  • Handle PHI and PII responsibly while following security, privacy, HIPAA, confidentiality, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical production issues, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, in accordance with defined service-level expectations.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement across development practices, team processes, system performance, and overall platform quality.

    • Requirements

    • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, full-stack web development, or a closely related technical discipline.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field required; a master’s degree, PhD, or equivalent advanced practical experience is preferred.
    • Advanced SQL capabilities, including strong experience with MSSQL and Snowflake, as well as troubleshooting, performance tuning, and feature development.
    • Strong full-stack development skills across Angular for front-end development, C# for back-end development, and REST API design and implementation.
    • Advanced Power BI experience, including DAX, data modeling, dashboard development, report creation, and ongoing maintenance.
    • Solid AWS experience and familiarity with cloud-native architecture, deployment, and development practices.
    • Experience working with healthcare data or healthcare organizations, with an understanding of PHI, PII, HIPAA, and data security and privacy requirements.
    • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex technical work and take solutions from initial concept through delivery.
    • Strong analytical and creative problem-solving abilities, combined with a growth mindset and willingness to learn.
    • Excellent communication, organization, collaboration, and teamwork skills.
    • Ability to work effectively within a small, high-ownership engineering team and operate independently when tackling complex assignments.
    • Commitment to software engineering fundamentals, code quality, testing, documentation, and maintainable architecture.
    • Must be authorized to work in the United States; this position does not offer immigration sponsorship.

      • Benefits

      • Base compensation range of $105,000–$160,000 USD, depending on experience, skills, location, business needs, and internal equity.
      • Potential eligibility for performance-based incentives in addition to base compensation.
      • Health insurance options.
      • Life insurance.
      • Company-paid disability coverage.
      • 401(k) retirement plan.
      • 18+ days of paid time off, plus additional benefits and programs.
      • Benefits designed to support physical health, long-term financial planning, and work-life balance.
      • Opportunity to work on technology that supports healthcare organizations and improves data-driven decision-making.
      • Collaborative environment with significant ownership and opportunities to contribute across the full software development lifecycle.

title: Director of Environmental Health and Safety
location: Medina, OH, US; Baytown, TX, US; Manchester, TN, US
description:
Purpose : The Director of Environmental, Health and Safety is responsible for developing, leading, and continuously improving the company’s environmental, health, and safety strategy across all locations. This role provides enterprise-wide leadership to ensure regulatory compliance, reduce operational risk, protect employees and communities, and promote a strong culture of safety, environmental stewardship, accountability, and continuous improvement.
The Director will partner with senior leadership, plant management, operations, human resources, engineering, maintenance, and external stakeholders to establish practical EHS systems, standards, policies, procedures, training, auditing, incident management, and performance metrics that support safe, compliant, and sustainable business operations.

Areas of Responsibility / Tasks
Performance must reflect appropriate level of expertise and achievement of the desired results for the items listed below.

Essential Functions

Develop, implement, and maintain corporate EHS policies, programs, procedures, and standards that support compliance with applicable federal, state, local, and company requirements.
Travel to the Ravago America’s locations to provide on-site strategic leadership and technical guidance to site leaders and EHS personnel across manufacturing, distribution, warehousing, laboratory, office, and other business operations.
Travel to the Ravago America’s locations to establish and drive a proactive safety culture focused on employee engagement, hazard recognition, risk reduction, environmental responsibility, and operational discipline.
Travel to the Ravago America’s locations to develop, mentor, and support site-level EHS professionals and operational leaders to build organizational capability and accountability.
Travel to the Ravago America’s locations to monitor regulatory requirements and industry best practices, including OSHA, EPA, DOT, state environmental agencies, workers’ compensation requirements, and other applicable standards.
Lead the development and execution of EHS objectives, annual plans, key performance indicators, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Travel to the Ravago America’s locations to develop and oversee a comprehensive EHS audit program which drives continuous improvement and engagement at the site level.
Oversee the incident investigation processes, root cause analysis, corrective action tracking, and lessons-learned communication for injuries, near misses, environmental releases, property damage, and regulatory events.
Partner with operations and engineering teams to integrate EHS requirements into capital projects, process changes, equipment installations, facility expansions, and contractor activities.
Oversee environmental compliance programs, including air, water, stormwater, wastewater, waste management, hazardous materials, chemical reporting, spill prevention, and permit compliance.
Develop and support emergency preparedness and response programs, including crisis management, evacuation planning, spill response, fire prevention, severe weather response, and business continuity coordination.
Lead corporate EHS training strategy and ensure employees, supervisors, managers, contractors, and visitors receive appropriate safety and environmental training.
Manage regulatory agency interactions, inspections, audits, reports, permits, correspondence, and corrective action commitments.
Prepare and present EHS performance reports, compliance updates, risk assessments, and improvement plans to executive leadership and site management.
Support workers’ compensation, return-to-work, industrial hygiene, occupational health, ergonomics, and employee wellness initiatives as appropriate.
Manage external consultants, vendors, contractors, laboratories, and service providers supporting EHS programs.
Promote sustainability initiatives related to waste reduction, recycling, energy efficiency, emissions reduction, resource conservation, and responsible manufacturing practices

Competencies; Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSA)
To perform this role successfully, an individual must have experience achieving desired result(s) in their areas of responsibility. The requirements listed below are representative of observable behaviors and essential knowledge, skill, and abilities required of a successful incumbent within our culture

Strategic leadership and business partnership
Regulatory compliance expertise
Risk identification, assessment, and mitigation
Incident investigation and root cause analysis
Continuous improvement mindset
Strong coaching, mentoring, and team development skills
Ability to communicate effectively with executives, site leaders, employees, regulators, and community stakeholders
High integrity, sound judgment, and commitment to employee safety and environmental responsibility

Minimum Qualifications/ Education / Experience / Certifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Engineering, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
Experience:

Minimum of 10 years of progressive EHS experience, including leadership responsibility in a manufacturing, industrial, chemical, plastics, distribution, or related operating environment.
Minimum of 5 years of people leadership, multi-site EHS leadership, or corporate-level program management experience preferred.
Experience developing and implementing safety management systems, environmental management systems, risk assessment processes, audit programs, training programs, and corrective action systems.

Knowledge : Strong working knowledge of OSHA, EPA, DOT, hazardous materials, industrial safety, environmental permitting, waste management, and related regulatory requirements.
Licenses / Certifications: Professional certification such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM), Professional Engineer (PE), or similar credential preferred.
Language: English

Work Environment / Conditions
The work environment/conditions described herein are representative of those that an incumbent may experience, and therefore

This position operates in both office and industrial work environments. The position will entail responding to EHS matters outside normal business hours. Travel to company facilities, conferences, and regulatory meetings will be required.

Location: Remote in Moncton, NB

The Company:
Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it. This exceptional content, reach and scope offer advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:
Working remotely in New Brunswick with one of Postmedia’s news teams, ideal candidates are experienced reporters. Recent or graduating students are welcome to apply.
Enterprising self-starters and team players, they have a sense for stories that resonate with a diverse readership. A key asset is the ability to use digital tools to break and develop stories and ideas. Successful candidates will work to tight deadlines covering a wide range of news and other subjects.

The reporting term is for up to 22 weeks and the reporter will be assigned to the Times & Transcript.

Some weekend and statutory holiday work may be included.

What you’ll do:

Develop content to engage audiences across several platforms tailored to meet the varying needs of web and mobile audiences.
Have story ideas daily, a job essential along with the flexibility to quickly pivot to other newsroom priorities to meet changing needs.
Use social media and other digital tools to uncover what’s breaking and what readers in real time are talking about which quickly needs attention.
Cultivate sources to break stories and help set the news agenda.
Work with digital teams to create interactive content, including text, photo, video and other multimedia elements that both engage and enrich readers.

Who you are:

An experienced reporter or journalism school graduate, or a candidate from a related field. Newsroom experience is an asset, but you have the ability to quickly layer and prioritize what needs to be done to quickly move up the job learning curve.

Flexible to work effectively in breaking news, features and short form, along with non-traditional story formats.
Hungry to make the most of a chance to work in a daily newsroom with top-notch journalists and eager to show what you can do to help by collaborating with colleagues.
A digger with natural curiosity, not satisfied with pat answers; always looking for hidden story angles and with a talent, or developing one, for explanatory journalism.
A reporter interested not just in what happened or is happening, but also why and how, with the ability to concisely convey that added meaning to readers.
Experience and strength in video, podcast presentation and other digital tools is an asset.
A valid driver’s license and access to a personal vehicle are also assets.
Bilingualism in English/French is an asset

and experience.

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff ML Engineer based in Brazil.

This role focuses on accelerating Machine Learning research by building the engineering foundations, workflows, and shared tools researchers need to iterate at scale.
You will work closely with ML researchers and engineers to turn evolving research needs into reliable, reusable engineering capabilities.
The position spans ML infrastructure, platform engineering, MLOps, automation, experimentation, and distributed computing.
You will support complex workloads involving large datasets, GPU clusters, distributed computation, and interconnected ML components.
A key focus will be improving research reproducibility, reliability, scalability, development speed, and cost efficiency.
You will also help bridge research and platform teams, translating ambiguous technical challenges into practical and reusable solutions.
The role offers the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI initiatives with a strong focus on accessibility, inclusion, collaboration, and global impact.

Accountabilities:

  • Partner with ML researchers working on generative AI teams to identify bottlenecks and improve the speed, scalability, and reliability of research iteration.
  • Design, build, and maintain reusable research infrastructure, workflows, models, interfaces, and automation supporting experimentation, training, evaluation, data processing, and model packaging.
  • Enable reproducible experiments through consistent environments, dependency management, artifact and model versioning, configuration management, observability, and CI/CD practices.
  • Support scalable ML workloads involving large datasets, GPU clusters, distributed computing, and multiple interconnected models, services, and algorithmic components.
  • Deliver pragmatic research-enablement capabilities for immediate needs while keeping solutions aligned with the broader ML platform architecture and roadmap.
  • Act as a technical bridge between researchers and ML platform teams by translating research pain points into clear platform requirements, validating new capabilities, and supporting adoption of shared infrastructure.
  • Improve the path from research to production by making research outcomes easier to reproduce, integrate, test, and operationalize.
  • Contribute to shared ML engineering standards and architecture while promoting strong engineering practices through hands-on collaboration, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.
  • Evaluate and introduce technologies that can materially improve research velocity, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

    • Requirements:

    • Proven experience building reusable infrastructure, developer tools, or platforms that enable multiple engineers or researchers rather than supporting only a single predefined model or pipeline.
    • Strong proficiency in Python and Linux, including the ability to build sustainable software, automation, and services.
    • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments such as AWS, and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
    • Practical understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including data preparation, experimentation, training, evaluation, model and artifact management, packaging, deployment, and monitoring.
    • Experience supporting compute-intensive or distributed workloads and diagnosing reliability, performance, resource, and cost bottlenecks.
    • Practical knowledge of modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, with sufficient understanding of model behavior and constraints to collaborate effectively with ML researchers; this is an engineering and infrastructure role rather than a research scientist position.
    • Ability to work with ambiguous and evolving requirements, uncover underlying needs, and translate them into simple, reusable engineering capabilities.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, engineering, and platform teams.
    • Advanced English proficiency is required across conversational communication, writing, and reading.
    • Strong interest in diversity, inclusion, and accessibility, combined with curiosity, collaboration, an action-oriented approach, and comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage environments.
    • Impact-oriented mindset, with a focus on meaningful outcomes rather than output alone.
    • Experience supporting ML research in areas such as language modeling, machine translation, computer vision, multimodal or generative AI, robotics, or autonomous systems is desirable.
    • Experience scaling GPU clusters, distributed training, and large-scale data processing is a plus.
    • Experience building researcher-focused ML platforms, self-service experimentation environments, or tools supporting multiple evolving research workflows is advantageous.
    • Experience helping research teams migrate to or adopt shared ML platforms is desirable.
    • Knowledge of inference optimization techniques, such as custom GPU kernels, is a plus but secondary to strong research-enablement and ML infrastructure experience.

      • Benefits:

      • CLT employment contract, providing statutory employment rights and protections.
      • Caju Benefits Card with R$1,160 monthly allowance, with flexibility across meal, food, home office, culture, and mobility expenses.
      • Fully remote work from anywhere in Brazil.

Domain Strategy & Roadmap

Review domain-level QPE outcomes for systemic issues and patterns across Finance and Reinsurance product areas

Facilitate effective prioritization across competing Finance functional demands, escalating to Finance and Growth Office leadership when trade-offs require executive input
