title: Campaign Coordinator
description:
BASIC FUNCTION:
March of Dimes Canada is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented professional for the role of Campaign Coordinator as we prepare to launch a landmark, multi-year comprehensive fundraising campaign.
Reporting to the Senior Director, Leadership Giving, the Campaign Coordinator will provide administrative, project, and donor engagement support to the philanthropy team. The successful candidate will play an important role in coordinating campaign activities, maintaining accurate donor and prospect records, supporting stewardship initiatives, and helping to ensure the timely execution of campaign plans and priorities.
A highly organized and collaborative team member, the Campaign Coordinator will work closely with philanthropy colleagues, program staff, senior leadership, volunteers, and external stakeholders to support the achievement of campaign goals. This role is ideal for someone looking to build a career in fundraising and philanthropy while gaining exposure to major gifts, campaign strategy, donor stewardship, and project management.
Responsible for supporting campaign operations, the Campaign Coordinator will help drive the successful implementation of campaign initiatives through effective planning, coordination, and communication. The incumbent will assist with prospect research, donor correspondence, meeting and event logistics, campaign reporting, and database management, ensuring a high level of accuracy and professionalism in all aspects of their work.
The ideal candidate is an enthusiastic self-starter with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering exceptional donor experiences. They are comfortable managing multiple priorities, collaborating across teams, and contributing to a fast-paced fundraising environment. With a desire to learn and grow, the Campaign Coordinator will play a key supporting role in advancing March of Dimes Canada's campaign objectives and philanthropic impact.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Campaign Coordination & Project Support

In collaboration with the Sr. Director, Leadership Giving and internal stakeholders, support the implementation, tracking, and ongoing coordination of the $70M comprehensive campaign strategy.
Assist with monitoring campaign activities, timelines, milestones, and deliverables to support the achievement of fundraising goals.
Maintain campaign work plans, project trackers, and reporting tools to ensure activities are completed efficiently and on schedule.
Support the coordination of campaign meetings, prepare agendas and materials, document key discussions, and track follow-up actions.
Contribute to project and team budget administration by tracking expenditures, reconciling expenses, identifying efficiencies, and making recommendations regarding campaign-related expenditures.
Monitor campaign-related processes and recommend improvements that enhance efficiency, accuracy, donor experience, and service delivery.
Contribute to project and team budget administration by tracking expenditures, reconciling expenses, identifying efficiencies, and making recommendations regarding campaign-related expenditures.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies, privacy requirements, donor confidentiality standards, and risk management protocols in all aspects of campaign administration and donor engagement.

Donor & Prospect Support

Provide administrative and coordination support for donor cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship activities.
Conduct prospect research and prepare donor profiles, briefing notes, and background materials to support fundraising activities.
Coordinate donor meetings, presentations, and follow-up communications with current and prospective donors.
Assist with the preparation of donor proposals, gift agreements, partnership agreements, stewardship reports, and recognition materials.
Support the implementation of donor and partner recognition strategies to ensure meaningful engagement and stewardship.

Stakeholder & Volunteer Engagement

Collaborate with internal teams to support the identification, segmentation, cultivation, and stewardship of donors and campaign supporters.
Assist in building positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, helping to foster engagement and support for campaign objectives.
Provide administrative and logistical support to campaign volunteers, committees, and volunteer leaders, including meeting preparation, progress reporting, and follow-up activities.
Participate in campaign committees and support the implementation of committee action items.

Communications & Marketing Support

Work closely with the Marketing and Communications team to coordinate campaign materials, presentations, donor communications, and engagement resources.
Assist in ensuring campaign messaging and materials are customized and distributed effectively to targeted audiences.
Support campaign events, donor recognition initiatives, and stakeholder engagement activities.

Data Management & Reporting

Maintain accurate and up-to-date donor, prospect, and campaign records within the CRM. Track campaign activity, donor interactions, and fundraising progress, preparing reports and dashboards as required.
Support campaign budget tracking and reporting by gathering information, monitoring expenses, and assisting with progress updates.
Ensure gifts, pledges, and donor activities are accurately recorded and appropriately recognized in accordance with organizational policies and procedures.

Evaluation & Continuous Improvement

Assist with the collection, organization, and analysis of campaign data to support ongoing evaluation and reporting.
Contribute to campaign reviews and post-campaign evaluations by compiling information, documenting lessons learned, and preparing summary reports.
Identify opportunities to improve campaign processes, workflow efficiencies, and administrative practices.

Operations

Act as a professional ambassador for March of Dimes Canada, representing the organization's mission, vision, values, and impact in all interactions with donors, volunteers, and stakeholders.
Support a collaborative, inclusive, and donor-centric culture that advances the success of the campaign and broader philanthropy goals.
Undertake other duties and special projects as assigned in support of the campaign and the Philanthropy team.
Respond to complex and sensitive donor, volunteer, stakeholder, and campaign-related inquiries, exercising sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality.
Prepare, reconcile, and maintain complex and confidential campaign documentation, reports, donor records, stewardship tracking, pledge schedules, and related fundraising data.
Provide strategic administrative and project coordination support for executive meetings, campaign leadership meetings, volunteer committees, and campaign governance activities, including preparation of agendas, briefing materials, presentations, and reports.
Develop strong working relationships with internal stakeholders across departments to facilitate the exchange of complex information and support campaign objectives.
Coordinate with external stakeholders, donors, vendors, consultants, and community partners to ensure campaign deliverables and service requirements are met.
Identify, investigate, and resolve complex administrative and operational issues related to campaign activities, escalating matters and providing recommendations as appropriate.
Monitor campaign-related processes and recommend improvements that enhance efficiency, accuracy, donor experience, and service delivery.
Contribute to project and team budget administration by tracking expenditures, reconciling expenses, identifying efficiencies, and making recommendations regarding campaign-related expenditures.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies, privacy requirements, donor confidentiality standards, and risk management protocols in all aspects of campaign administration and donor engagement.
Provide guidance, orientation, training, and day-to-day support to staff, volunteers, students, and new team members involved in campaign activities as required.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Post-secondary education in fundraising, nonprofit management, business administration, communications, marketing, public relations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
One to three years of experience in fundraising, donor relations, project coordination, administration, communications, events, or a related role, preferably within the nonprofit or charitable sector.
Exposure to fundraising campaigns, donor stewardship, event planning, volunteer engagement, or philanthropy operations is considered an asset.
Understanding of fundraising principles and the donor relationship cycle, with a strong interest in building a career in philanthropy and campaign fundraising.
Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, particularly in data entry, reporting, and donor record management.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and effectively with donors, volunteers, colleagues, and external stakeholders.
Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive working relationships across diverse groups.
Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
Strong administrative skills, including meeting coordination, document preparation, scheduling, and record management.
Analytical and detail-oriented, with the ability to gather, organize, and interpret information to support decision-making and campaign activities.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams.
Experience using donor databases, CRM systems (such as Salesforce), and reporting tools is considered an asset.
Comfortable learning and using new technologies, systems, and digital collaboration tools.
Sound judgment, professionalism, and the ability to maintain confidentiality and discretion when handling sensitive donor and organizational information.
Positive, proactive, and service-oriented approach with a willingness to learn and contribute to team success.
Ability to work in a results-oriented environment and contribute to achieving campaign and fundraising goals.
Demonstrated commitment to equity, inclusion, accessibility, and understanding the unique needs, rights, and experiences of people living with disabilities.
Occasional evening and weekend work may be required to support donor meetings, campaign events, and organizational activities.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex and sensitive information while maintaining strict confidentiality and professional discretion.
Proven ability to analyze information, resolve complex administrative issues, and make informed recommendations to support decision-making.
Experience coordinating projects, committees, working groups, or cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
Strong relationship management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, senior leaders, volunteers, donors, and external partners.
Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and identifying opportunities to enhance processes, systems, and service delivery.
Experience with budget tracking, expense reconciliation, and administrative financial processes is considered an asset.

Other details:

Hybrid work arrangement - 3 days in office
Salary: $44,156 - $55,195 per annum

title: PT Assistant
description:
Position Summary
The role of the Physical Therapy Assistant (PTA) is a necessary part of the physical therapy team, helping physical therapists deliver quality care to their patients. PTAs implement selected components of patient/client interventions (treatment), obtain data related to the interventions provided, and make modifications in selected interventions either to progress the patient/client as directed by the physical therapist or to ensure patient/client safety and comfort.
Key Duties and Responsibilities
The key duties and responsibilities of the Physical Therapy Assistant include, but are not limited to:

Mastery of all Physical Therapy Aide duties and responsibilities

Patient and Clinical Care Activities:
Act as an assistant to the Physical Therapist when the Therapist is performing tests, evaluations, and complex procedures.
Collect clinical assessment scores, radiographic scores and assessments, and health related quality of life information.
Implement patient's individualized treatment plan as established by the primary Physical Therapist.

Provide individualized physical therapy treatments including but not limited to:

Therapeutic exercise including aerobic capacity conditioning, balance coordination, agility training, body mechanics and postural stabilization, flexibility exercises, gait and locomotion training, neuromotor development training, relaxation, strength, power, and endurance training
Functional training
Manual therapy
Airway clearance techniques
Integumentary repair and protection
Use of electrotherapeutic, physical agent and mechanical modalities
Health and Wellness
Falls Risk Interventions
Chronic Disease Management Education
Organize and facilitate treatment groups in collaboration with the physical therapist.
Instruct patients, families and other caregivers in the skills and techniques of the physical therapy treatment program under the supervision of the Physical Therapist.
Conduct screenings of patients at regular intervals to determine need for intervention/treatment
Assist the Physical Therapist in the evaluation process and with identifying a target list, including short-term goals, long-term goals and treatment plan
Train patients in locomotion using orthotics, prosthetics, or assistive devices such as canes, crutches, walkers, and wheelchairs.
Demonstrate use of gait, belt, and safety awareness, as well as demonstrating proper guarding techniques.
Order and instruct patients in the use of prescribed equipment.
Work with all other members of the rehabilitation team to implement programs consistent with the needs and capabilities of each patient
Contribute to cleaning, maintaining, identifying, and reporting the need for repair of equipment, as necessary.
Perform skilled services, upholding the Code of Ethics as stated and maintained by the APTA
Consistently use legible, legal and accurate documentation according to American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) and WPT standards
Maintain appropriate and timely documentation for all patients treated.
Participate in staff meetings, forums, committees, and in-service training activities
Complete duties and assist others as directed
Follow all policies as introduced during new associate On-Boarding, updated real-time and outlined in Associate Handbook

Education/Experience

An Associate’s Degree from an accredited college or university required
Certification in CPR required
Licensure must be acquired by passing the National Physical Therapy Exam from the Federation of State Boards of Physical Therapy.
Earn (continuously) continuing education units as required by the state of Washington

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Must meet physical requirements of frequent lifting, bending and squatting
Ability to perform well under pressure
Superior customer service skills
Great interpersonal skills; demonstrating patience, composure and cooperation; working well with all patients, physicians and staff
Ensuring that patients and families receive the highest quality of service in a caring and compassionate atmosphere which recognizes the individuals' needs and rights.
Understanding of and adherence to all safety, risk management and precautionary procedures, including the consistent respect for confidentiality (HIPAA)

Work Environment/Physical Demands
The work environment/physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a teammate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable differently abled persons to perform the essential functions.

title: Packager
description:
VMAC is looking for a Packager to join our Supply Chain team. The Packager plays an important role in ensuring VMAC finished products are accurately inspected, prepared, packaged, and ready for shipment. This is a hands-on position in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where attention to detail, organization, and teamwork are essential. The successful candidate takes pride in producing quality work, follows established processes, and understands the importance of ensuring our products leave VMAC complete, accurate, and properly packaged.
As Packager you will:

Perform final inspections of components, kits, assemblies, and finished products prior to shipment or inventory.
Build and prepare kits and finished products in accordance with Bills of Materials, work instructions, and established procedures.
Verify part numbers, quantities, components, and required documentation to ensure orders are complete and accurate.
Package products and components using appropriate materials and methods to protect them during handling and transportation.
Prepare products for shipment according to established shipping schedules and priorities.
Identify missing, damaged, or incorrect components and communicate discrepancies to the appropriate team members.
Use basic hand tools and equipment as required to complete packaging and preparation tasks.
Safely handle and move materials, kits, systems, assemblies, and finished products throughout the facility using forklifts and other material-handling equipment as required.
Ensure products are properly labelled and documentation is complete and accurate.
Maintain an organized workflow and prioritize tasks to meet daily shipping requirements.
Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area in accordance with VMAC standards.
Follow all applicable VMAC policies, procedures, work instructions, and health and safety requirements.
Perform other related duties as required.

What you bring:

Secondary school diploma.
Previous experience in a manufacturing, packaging, warehouse, shipping, assembly, or similar environment is considered an asset.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
Previous forklift certification or experience operating a forklift is considered an asset.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to prioritize multiple tasks while maintaining quality and accuracy.
Excellent communication skills.
Ability to work independently as well as contribute effectively as part of a team.
A positive, dependable, and hands-on approach to work.
Ability to perform the physical requirements of the position, including standing for extended periods and lifting, moving, and handling materials and products.

title: Senior Lead Product Manager (Remote, US)
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

As a Senior Lead Product Manager and Strategist, this role defines and advances Lumen’s wholesale infrastructure portfolio across waves, dark fiber, dim fiber, managed optical fiber systems, and infrastructure on-demand constructs. This leader must bring a strong market vision for the future of wholesale optical and fiber infrastructure, serve as a trusted advisor to strategic customers, and translate customer demand, market signals, and competitive insights into differentiated product strategy, roadmap direction, and commercial outcomes.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Act as the wholesale infrastructure product visionary for strategic optical and fiber-based services, shaping portfolio direction across waves, dark fiber, dim fiber, managed optical fiber systems, and terabit-on-demand offers.
  • Lead customer-facing engagement with Lumen’s most valued and strategic wholesale customers to understand network strategies, capacity requirements, commercial preferences, and long-term infrastructure needs.
  • Consult with customers and sales teams to develop solution constructs using existing product lines, including hybrid and lifecycle-based solutions that combine lit, dim, dark, and managed infrastructure options.
  • Identify market trends, customer preferences, competitive moves, and emerging infrastructure consumption models; convert those insights into recommendations for new products, enhancements, pricing approaches, and commercial frameworks.
  • Partner closely with inbound product management, architecture, engineering, IT, operations, finance, and sales to define requirements, scope business cases, influence roadmap priorities, and align product investments to wholesale growth opportunities.
  • Develop clear product requirements and shepherd initiatives through Lumen’s product introduction and governance processes from concept through launch, commercialization, and lifecycle management.
  • Own and communicate product-level KPIs, including revenue performance, sales adoption, win rates, customer traction, usage trends, pricing realization, and strategic growth indicators.
  • Provide deep market intelligence on wholesale infrastructure trends, route economics, technology evolution, pricing dynamics, and competitor positioning to support executive decisions, go-to-market planning, and product marketing strategy.
  • Support GTM and product marketing efforts by helping define positioning, value propositions, use cases, sales enablement narratives, and customer-facing messaging for infrastructure solutions.
  • Influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, bringing strategic clarity, disciplined execution, and strong leadership across highly visible, complex, and commercially important initiatives.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and relevant experience; advanced business or technical education preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, or infrastructure solution leadership within telecommunications, optical networking, or wholesale infrastructure markets.
  • Deep expertise in optical and fiber-based infrastructure services, including waves, dark fiber, dim fiber constructs, managed optical systems, and high-capacity on-demand bandwidth models, with the executive presence to engage senior customer stakeholders and the strategic acumen to shape portfolio direction.

title: Executive Administrator
location: WESTERLY, RI, US; Providence, RI, US
description:
Executive Administrator
Are you a highly organized and detail-oriented professional looking to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic corporate environment?
Washington Trust is seeking an experienced, highly organized, proactive and solutions-driven Executive Assistant to provide dedicated support to the Chief Executive Officer and Chief Operating Officer.
This position requires more than outstanding administrative skills. The successful candidate will be a trusted partner who anticipates needs, manages competing priorities with discretion and sound judgment, and serves as a key point of coordination across the organization. The Executive Assistant will be responsible for managing complex calendars, communications, travel, meetings, and executive priorities while also supporting strategic projects, leadership initiatives, and special assignments.
The ideal candidate is comfortable working behind the scenes to keep executives focused on the highest-value activities while simultaneously engaging with senior leaders, board members, clients, and community stakeholders.
If you are an accomplished executive administrator looking for an opportunity to contribute to a forward-thinking and mission-driven organization, we want to hear from you!
Key Responsibilities

Provide high-level administrative support to the Chief Executive Officer and Chief Operating Officer, ensuring the efficient management of daily activities, priorities, and commitments.

Manage complex and frequently changing calendars, exercising sound judgment in prioritizing requests and aligning executive time with organizational objectives and strategic priorities.
Conduct research, gather information, and prepare, edit, and proofread presentations, reports, correspondence, briefing materials, Board materials, and other business documents, ensuring accuracy, quality, and professionalism while supporting executive decision-making, strategic initiatives, and organizational objectives.
Coordinate and execute executive-level meetings, leadership forums, strategic planning sessions, Board-related activities, and special events, proactively managing schedules, agendas, materials, logistics, technology, and stakeholder communications. Extend support beyond the event itself by coordinating follow-up activities, monitoring key action items and commitments, and helping ensure that decisions are translated into meaningful outcomes.

Anticipate executive needs, identify potential scheduling or operational challenges, and proactively recommend solutions before issues arise.
Serve as a trusted representative of the Executive Office, fostering effective communication and strong working relationships among senior leaders, directors, employees, customers, shareholders, regulators, community stakeholders, and business partners. Manage and prioritize executive communications, including email and telephone inquiries, ensuring timely responses, seamless follow-up, and thoughtful coordination of matters requiring executive attention.
Coordinate travel arrangements, expense reporting, and related logistics while maintaining compliance with company policies and procedures.
Monitor ongoing initiatives, commitments, action items, and leadership priorities, helping to ensure deadlines are met, deliverables remain on track, and executives are informed of progress and potential issues.
Take ownership of assigned projects and responsibilities, independently driving work to completion while keeping executives informed of progress, issues, and opportunities.
Leverage sound business judgment, organizational knowledge, and critical thinking skills to anticipate needs, identify opportunities, and provide proactive recommendations that enhance executive effectiveness and organizational outcomes.
Continuously seek ways to improve processes, enhance efficiency, and add value through insights, organization, and proactive problem-solving.
Exercise discretion, diplomacy, and sound judgment in handling highly confidential, sensitive, and proprietary information.
Assist in managing Executive Office operations, records, document retention, and the organization of key business information to ensure accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with corporate requirements.
May provide support to other executives as needed, including to the Corporate Secretary with respect to Board and governance-related matters.
Provide backup support for other executive administrative functions as needed.

What Sets This Role Apart
The successful candidate will be more than an exceptional administrative professional. They will be a proactive partner who anticipates needs, thinks several steps ahead, and takes ownership of responsibilities with minimal direction. This individual will demonstrate strong business judgment, identify opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness, and bring thoughtful insights that help senior leadership focus on the organization's highest priorities.
What We’re Looking For:

Minimum of 7-10 years of demonstrated experience supporting C-suite executives, presidents, CEOs, COOs, or other senior leaders. Experience in banking, financial services, higher education, healthcare, law, or other complex professional environments preferred.
Demonstrated ability to anticipate needs, take initiative, work independently, exercise sound judgment, and assume ownership of projects and assignments from concept through execution, delivering successful outcomes with minimal direction.
Exceptional written, verbal, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex business, financial, and strategic information.
Advanced calendar management and scheduling expertise, with the ability to manage competing priorities and rapidly changing demands.
Outstanding organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to accuracy.
Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and relationship management skills, with a proactive, service-oriented approach.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint, as well as other collaboration and meeting platforms, including WebEx.
High degree of professionalism, discretion, diplomacy, and ability to handle highly confidential information.
Bachelor's degree preferred or an equivalent combination of education and relevant executive support experience.

Location:
Due to the nature of this role and the need to support senior executives, the successful candidate must be able to work primarily onsite at Washington Trust’s corporate headquarters in Westerly, Rhode Island, with periodic travel to our Providence office and other locations as business needs require.

Compensation: A good‑faith, reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is $95,000-$115,000 per year and the actual offer will depend on factors such as experience, skills, training, certifications, and education.
This base salary reflects one component of our competitive compensation package. This position may be eligible for an annual bonus and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

title: Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) – Mobile/Home-Based Care
description:
Overview
We are seeking a skilled, compassionate, and dependable Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to provide high-quality physical therapy services to patients in their homes throughout the Hemet/Temecula region.

The Physical Therapist Assistant will work under the direction and supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist to provide skilled therapeutic interventions, implement established plans of care, monitor patient response and progress, reinforce home exercise programs, and educate patients and caregivers on strategies to improve mobility, function, safety, and independence.
The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently within the scope of PTA practice in a home-based environment, has strong communication and interpersonal skills, and is passionate about delivering patient-centered care.
This is a 1099 independent contractor position.

Duties and Responsibilities
  • Travel to patients' homes throughout the assigned service area to provide physical therapy treatment under the direction of the supervising Physical Therapist.
  • Review the patient's established plan of care, treatment goals, precautions, and relevant clinical information prior to providing treatment.
  • Provide skilled physical therapy interventions in accordance with the Physical Therapist's plan of care, including:
    • Therapeutic exercises
    • Therapeutic activities
    • Neuromuscular re-education
    • Gait and mobility training
    • Balance and coordination training
    • Functional strengthening
    • Transfer training
    • Fall prevention and safety training
    • Manual therapy when appropriate and within the PTA's scope of practice
    • Functional mobility and activity training
  • Assist patients with improving strength, range of motion, balance, coordination, endurance, gait, mobility, and functional performance.
  • Train patients in the safe and appropriate use of assistive devices such as walkers, canes, and other mobility equipment as directed by the Physical Therapist.
  • Implement and reinforce individualized home exercise programs established by the Physical Therapist.
  • Educate patients and caregivers regarding prescribed exercises, mobility strategies, safety precautions, fall prevention, positioning, transfers, and strategies to promote independence.
  • Monitor patient response to treatment and recognize changes in pain, functional status, mobility, tolerance, or overall condition.
  • Communicate significant changes in patient condition, response to treatment, progress, concerns, or barriers to the supervising Physical Therapist in a timely manner.
  • Provide feedback to the Physical Therapist regarding patient progress and response to the established plan of care.
  • Assist the Physical Therapist with reassessments and other clinical follow-up activities as appropriate and permitted within the PTA's scope of practice.
  • Modify treatment activities within the established plan of care as appropriate and within the PTA's scope of practice, while communicating clinically significant changes to the supervising Physical Therapist.
  • Reinforce proper body mechanics, transfer techniques, positioning, and safety strategies with patients and caregivers.
  • Adapt treatment approaches to the patient's home environment, available space, equipment, functional abilities, and individual needs while following the established plan of care.
  • Coordinate care and communicate professionally with Physical Therapists, physicians, nurses, caregivers, occupational therapists, and other healthcare professionals as appropriate.
  • Communicate promptly regarding patient concerns, cancellations, scheduling changes, or other issues that may affect care.
  • Complete accurate, timely, and thorough documentation for daily treatment visits and other required clinical documentation.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations, professional standards, payer requirements, PTA supervision requirements, and company policies.
  • Recognize changes in patient condition that may require notification of the supervising Physical Therapist, referring provider, or other healthcare professional.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries at all times.
  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and professional care to patients and their families in the home setting.


Requirements
  • Current and valid Physical Therapist Assistant license in good standing.
  • Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program.
  • Strong knowledge of anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, biomechanics, therapeutic exercise, and rehabilitation principles.
  • Strong understanding of physical therapy treatment techniques and functional mobility principles.
  • Ability to safely and effectively implement a Physical Therapist's established plan of care.
  • Knowledge of therapeutic exercise, gait training, balance training, functional mobility, neuromuscular re-education, strengthening, transfer training, and fall prevention.
  • Strong observation and patient monitoring skills.
  • Ability to recognize and appropriately communicate changes in patient condition or functional status.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively manage a mobile patient caseload while maintaining appropriate communication with the supervising Physical Therapist.
  • Must be punctual, dependable, organized, and professional.
  • Comfortable entering and providing care in patients' homes and working with patients and caregivers in a home-based environment.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.
  • Ability to travel throughout the assigned service area.
  • CPR/BLS certification preferred or required according to company policy.
  • Previous home health, mobile therapy, outpatient, orthopedic, neurological, geriatric, or community-based experience is preferred.


Mobile/Home-Based Care Expectations
Because this position involves providing care in patients' homes, the Physical Therapist Assistant must be able to:
  • Arrive at scheduled visits within the expected timeframe.
  • Manage travel time and maintain an efficient daily schedule.
  • Carry and transport necessary clinical equipment and supplies.
  • Adapt treatment approaches to different home environments and available space.
  • Maintain a safe and professional environment during every patient visit.
  • Communicate promptly regarding cancellations, scheduling changes, patient concerns, or changes in patient status.
  • Respect patients' homes, privacy, routines, and individual preferences.
  • Demonstrate sound clinical judgment within the PTA's scope of practice when working independently in the community.
  • Maintain appropriate communication with the supervising Physical Therapist regarding patient progress, concerns, and changes in condition.


Documentation and Compliance
The Physical Therapist Assistant is responsible for completing all required clinical documentation accurately and within established timeframes, including:
  • Daily treatment notes
  • Patient response to treatment
  • Progress toward established functional goals
  • Exercises and interventions performed
  • Patient and caregiver education
  • Home exercise program instruction and reinforcement
  • Communication with the supervising Physical Therapist
  • Documentation of changes in patient condition or functional status
  • Other documentation required by the organization, payer, supervising Physical Therapist, or applicable regulations


The PTA must practice within the scope of the California Physical Therapist Assistant license and applicable supervision requirements and must follow the established plan of care developed by the supervising Physical Therapist.

Job Type
Full-time – 1099 Independent Contractor

Pay Structure (1099)
  • Guaranteed base pay: $840 per week
  • Base compensation is calculated at $35 per patient visit, based on a minimum of 6 patient visits per day.
  • $35 per additional patient visit for visits beyond the daily base of 6.
  • Compensation is subject to the terms of the independent contractor agreement.
Schedule
4/10 Schedule
  • Four 10-hour workdays per week
  • Typical start time: 7:30 AM–8:30 AM, depending on patient scheduling and geographic coverage.
  • Daily schedule may vary based on patient locations, visit duration, and patient needs.


Work Location
Mobile/Home-Based –Hemet/ Temecula Region
The Physical Therapist Assistant will travel to assigned patients' homes throughout the designated service area.

Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is a clinically capable, compassionate, dependable, and self-motivated Physical Therapist Assistant who enjoys working one-on-one with patients and families.
The successful candidate will be comfortable providing care in patients' homes, implementing established plans of care, adapting treatment activities to the patient's home environment, monitoring patient response, communicating effectively with the supervising Physical Therapist, and maintaining excellent documentation.
This position is an excellent opportunity for a Physical Therapist Assistant who values autonomy, flexibility, meaningful patient relationships, and community-based care while working as an integral member of a collaborative physical therapy team.

title: Marketing Data Analyst III
description:
How will you make a difference to PMI?
PMI is seeking a Marketing Data Analyst III to serve as a key individual contributor supporting paid media performance, measurement, and reporting. This role turns complex marketing data into actionable insights that help guide how PMI invests in paid acquisition, evaluates marketing efficiency, and improves conversion performance.
With a strong foundation in campaign analytics and attribution, the Marketing Data Analyst III will analyze paid media performance within the broader customer journey, connecting paid activity to conversions and sales across channels to provide a complete view of marketing impact. The role will also contribute to cross-channel reporting, forecasting, modeling, and broader marketing analytics initiatives in partnership with the wider Analytics team.
This is a hands-on analytical role for someone who is comfortable working with SQL, Snowflake, and reporting and visualization tools, while leveraging AI-assisted analytics to accelerate analysis, expand coverage, and uncover insights that drive smarter marketing decisions.
What you’ll bring to the role:
Paid Media Ownership

Performance Reporting: Deliver recurring and ad hoc paid media performance reporting at global and regional levels, ensuring stakeholders have accurate, timely, and actionable insight into media performance.
Media Efficiency Metrics: Apply and maintain consistent paid media metrics, including CAC, ROAS, CPA, CPM, CTR, and conversion rate, across channels and regions.
Campaign Analysis: Analyze campaign, audience, creative, channel, and geography level performance across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and programmatic, and recommend budget and optimization changes.
Incrementality and Testing: Support and analyze incrementality tests, holdouts, and structured experiments, reporting results with statistical confidence stated.
Agency Reconciliation: Reconcile agency and platform reported performance against PMI first-party and warehouse data, and identify and explain variance.
Campaign Tracking Accuracy: Maintain UTM governance and conversion tracking validation for paid campaigns to ensure accurate attribution and reliable performance data.

Marketing Analytics

Attribution Analysis: Contribute to attribution analysis across paid and non-paid channels, applying PMI's attribution standards and helping assess how channels contribute to conversion and sales.
Cross-Channel Reporting: Support cross-channel and funnel reporting, connecting paid media results to downstream conversion, customer, and product performance.
Forecasting and Modeling Support: Support forecasting, propensity, and media mix modeling efforts through data preparation, analysis, and interpretation of results.
Collaboration: Partner with global and regional marketing stakeholders, Data Engineering, and agency teams to translate analysis into practical recommendations.

Analytics Engineering

Data Extraction and Transformation: Use SQL and Snowflake for data pulling, transformation, and analysis, working from datasets delivered by Data Engineering
AI-Assisted Analytics: Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, quality assurance, and reporting, and validate AI-generated output against source data before it is shared.
Data Quality and Stewardship: Follow data governance and stewardship practices, promoting accuracy, consistency, and ethical use of data, and contribute paid media metric definitions to PMI's marketing semantic layer.

Key Deliverables:

Recurring paid media performance reports (weekly and monthly) for regional and global stakeholders, with clear recommendations on budget allocation and optimization.
Automated paid media dashboards and recurring reporting in Adobe Analytics and PMI standard reporting tools, enabling proactive performance monitoring.
Incrementality and experiment results that inform media investment decisions.
Reconciliation of agency and platform reported performance against PMI data, with variance identified and explained.
Accurate campaign tracking and attribution data across paid campaigns.

Role Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, analytics, statistics, economics, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Minimum 7 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or performance reporting, with significant time spent on paid media or digital marketing performance.
Hands-on experience analyzing data from Google Ads and Meta Ads required. LinkedIn Ads and programmatic experience preferred.
Experience analyzing marketing tests or experiments and interpreting results. Exposure to forecasting or modeling work preferred.
Experience with attribution models and tools like Rockerbox, Northbeam
Strong SQL and working proficiency with Snowflake for data querying, transformation, and analysis.
Working knowledge of paid media platforms and their reporting, including Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
Solid understanding of campaign analytics, attribution methods, conversion tracking, and UTM governance.
Familiarity with statistical concepts applied to marketing, including significance testing, cohort analysis, and lifetime value. Working proficiency in Python or R preferred.
Comfortable using AI tools in analytical work, including validating output before it informs a business decision.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify insight and translate it into recommendations.
Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with global and regional teams, and to present findings to non-technical stakeholders.

About the Role

We are looking for a Denials and Appeals Specialist to join our Revenue Cycle Management team. This role is responsible for reviewing, researching, and resolving post-service payer denials for clinic and surgical services.

The Specialist will investigate denial reasons, determine the appropriate resolution, and handle activities such as corrected claims, reconsiderations, written appeals, and payer follow-ups. The role will also collaborate with Coding, Revenue Cycle, and other operational teams to address complex denials, identify recurring issues, and help reduce preventable revenue loss.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review, research, and resolve assigned payer denials for clinic and surgical services.
  • Analyze denial reasons, claim history, payer responses, account documentation, and related information to determine the appropriate resolution.
  • Prepare and submit corrected claims, reconsiderations, written appeals, and supporting documentation based on payer requirements.
  • Conduct timely payer follow-ups and monitor denied claims through final resolution.
  • Utilize payer portals, EMR/practice management systems, electronic remittance information, and other healthcare revenue cycle tools.
  • Review payer policies, reimbursement guidelines, medical policies, and contractual requirements when evaluating denials.
  • Coordinate with the Coding team for denials involving coding, modifiers, bundling, medical necessity, or documentation concerns.
  • Coordinate with appropriate Revenue Cycle or operational teams for denials related to authorization, eligibility, registration, credentialing, or other upstream processes.
  • Identify payer processing errors and pursue appropriate corrected claims, reconsiderations, appeals, or escalations.
  • Maintain accurate and complete documentation of denial research, payer communications, actions taken, and resolution details.
  • Monitor assigned work queues and outstanding accounts to ensure timely follow-up within payer filing and appeal deadlines.
  • Prioritize denial accounts based on deadlines, account value, denial type, and established department guidelines.
  • Identify recurring denial trends and communicate findings to leadership to support denial prevention and process improvement.
  • Maintain confidentiality of patient, financial, and protected health information in accordance with applicable policies and regulations.

Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in healthcare Revenue Cycle Management, medical billing, insurance follow-up, accounts receivable, denial management, or a related healthcare revenue cycle function.

What You'll DoConduct security architecture reviews and discovery sessions across enterprise AWS and Azure environments to identify control gaps and validate the effectiveness of existing controls.Perform threat modeling and attack-path analysis, mapping adversarial behavior to MITRE ATT&CK and CIS Critical Security Controls to surface lateral movement, credential abuse, and insider threat risks.Tune AI-driven anomaly detection and behavioral analytics models to reduce false positives and improve triage accuracy for the SOC.Partner with Solutions Architects, Cloud Engineering, and Application Security teams to design secure deployment patterns aligned to enterprise compliance and risk requirements.Deliver evidence-based findings and security briefings to both technical audiences (SOC analysts, engineers) and executive stakeholders.Resolve complex multi-cloud security escalations end-to-end, partnering across cloud engineering and customer security teams.Translate recurring control gaps into actionable feedback that influences platform security roadmaps and expands coverage across regulated environments.

title: Senior Principal Radar Systems Engineer
description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

Join us to design and deploy next-generation, satellite-based radar that delivers persistent, all-weather, day-night sensing at global scale. You’ll build end-to-end capabilities—from waveform design, on-board processing, classification and calibration—for systems on LEO platforms. Working across RF hardware, phased arrays, and advanced DSP, you’ll turn raw echoes into decision-ready products. If you thrive at the intersection of electromagnetics, signal processing, and systems engineering—and want your code and designs to fly—this role is for you.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Develop algorithms for channel processing, beamforming, detection, estimation, calibration, interference mitigation, and related radar functions.

  • Create performance models, simulations, reference implementations, and test vectors.

  • Allocate processing functions across GPU, FPGA, embedded, and software resources.

  • Characterize latency, throughput, numerical precision, resource use, and failure behavior.

  • Support prototype demonstrations, requirements verification, software development, and I&T.

What you bring to this role:

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in electrical engineering, applied mathematics, physics, or a related field.

  • Five or more years of radar, sonar, communications, or high-rate signal-processing experience.

  • Strong DSP fundamentals and proficiency in MATLAB, Python, C/C++, CUDA, or comparable tools.

  • Experience translating algorithms into real-time implementations and objective tests.

  • Security clearance: U.S. citizenship is required. Candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance at the Secret level or higher, and any program-specific access required for the position. Continued employment is contingent upon obtaining and maintaining the required clearance and access.

Bonus points for the following:

  • GPU-accelerated radar processing and sub-second end-to-end latency experience.

  • UHF phased-array calibration or digital beamforming experience.

  • Experience developing independent golden-reference models and test vectors.

Additional Requirements:

This is a fast-paced, high-impact environment - flexibility to work extended hours or weekends during critical periods is expected.

This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Saratoga office. The target base pay for this position is $120,000 - $200,000 annually. The total compensation packaged will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used—so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in-orbit activities. If that’s your experience – then we’ll be immediately wow-ed.
This role requires access to controlled technical data. Under U.S. law (ITAR/EAR), we can only consider U.S. persons (U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, and individuals granted asylum or refugee status).
E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.

Why E-Space is right for you:

As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success. Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals. In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth industry.

We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

• An opportunity to really make a difference
• Sustainability at our core
• Fair and honest workplace
• Innovative thinking is encouraged
• Competitive salaries
• Continuous learning and development
• Health and wellness care options
• Financial solutions for the future

title: Analyst, Corporate Planning
description:
Reporting to the Manager of Corporate Planning, this role plays a key part in delivering actionable financial insights that support decision-making by WestJet's Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Board of Directors. The Corporate Planning team leads the company's budgeting and forecasting processes, evaluates the financial implications of strategic initiatives, and develops the framework for internal performance reporting. Key team deliverables include the monthly business review, annual budget, and financial analyses supporting a variety of corporate initiatives and activities.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze WestJet's financial and operational performance, identify key drivers and trends, and deliver actionable insights to improve business performance.
Support the preparation and delivery of monthly financial reporting and business review materials for the ELT and Board of Directors.
Coordinate the monthly review of departmental financial performance and investigate variances.
Support the development of the annual budget, long-range financial plan, and monthly forecasts.
Monitor and benchmark WestJet's financial and operational performance against key industry peers and competitors.
Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to improve reporting processes, data quality, forecasting accuracy, and overall efficiency.
Support monthly traffic reporting and provide analysis of key operational metrics, including flight movements and passenger volumes.
Contribute as an engaged member of the Finance team supporting ad hoc analyses, sharing best practices, and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Qualifications

Completion of post-secondary education in Finance, Accounting, Business or related field
3+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, valuation, or a related analytical role.
Proven ability to perform detailed financial analysis and synthesize findings into clear, concise recommendations for senior leadership.
Strong financial modeling skills, including forecasting, scenario analysis, and three-statement modeling; DCF valuation experience is an asset.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.
Highly analytical, naturally curious, and detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.
Experience with OneStream, Oracle Hyperion is an asset.
Airline industry experience is an asset.
Progress toward, or completion of, a professional designation such as CPA, CFA, or CBV is considered an asset.

description:
Job Title:

Vehicle Inspection Specialist

Location:

6801 Temie Lee Pkwy, Midlothian, VA 23112

Job Overview:

We are pioneering a streamlined workflow model to support our automotive technicians and deliver unmatched transparency to our customers. We are hiring a Dedicated Vehicle Inspection Specialist.

In this specialized role, you will be the frontline evaluator for every vehicle entering our shop. You will perform comprehensive Digital Vehicle Inspections (DVIs) and courtesy checks using tablet technology, capturing photos, video, and notes before handing the vehicle over to our repair team.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Execute Comprehensive DVIs: Perform complete Courtesy Checks and Digital Vehicle Inspections on all arriving vehicles using tablet technology.
  • Component & Safety Evaluations: Systematically inspect fluid levels/conditions, tire tread depths and air pressure, brake pad thickness, battery health, lighting, belts, hoses, and steering/suspension components.
  • Digital Documentation: Capture clear, well-lit photos and concise videos of worn, damaged, or clean components to attach directly to the digital report sent to the guest.
  • Data Entry & Accuracy: Input detailed, professional, customer-ready notes and precise measurements into the shop management system.
  • Maintain Quality Standards: Consistently achieve a 100 DVI System Quality Score on every vehicle by completing all required inspection fields, measurements, and media without cutting corners.
  • Vehicle Staging & Workflow: Safely move and stage vehicles between the parking lot, inspection bay, and primary technician bays to maintain a continuous, uninterrupted shop rhythm.
  • Bay & Equipment Ownership: Keep the dedicated inspection area clean, safe, organized, and staged for rapid vehicle turnaround.

Qualifications:

  • Industry Experience: 1+ years of experience in a quick-lube facility/dealership, automotive inspection facility, or formal completion/enrollment in an automotive technology program.
  • State Inspection License (Not Required, but Preferred): Active Virginia State Safety Inspection License preferred (or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire). Having this will result in a higher pay range.
  • Meticulous Eye for Detail: High accuracy in identifying fluid leaks, wear patterns, and safety hazards.
  • Tech-Savvy & Fast: Strong proficiency operating digital tablets, inspection software, and photo/video equipment at a steady pace.
  • Licensing & Driving Record: Valid Virginia Driver’s License with a clean driving record (Required). Note: A Virginia State Inspection license is NOT required for this role.
  • Professional Mindset: Punctual, self-motivated, and committed to high-quality work aligned with our "Love Your Neighbor" customer-first philosophy.

Physical Requirements:

  • Occasionally lift and/or move over 50 pounds
  • Be able to work with tools on vehicles lifted above their head
  • Work in tight spaces as dictated by the vehicle's needed repair
  • Have the needed dexterity in order to efficiently use hand-tools
  • Walk/stand for the majority of the workday
  • Drive manual transmission vehicles
  • Keeping a brisk work pace in a high-volume environment
  • Efficiently navigate a computer

Experience with conversational AI, service management platforms, case management, airline operations, reservations, loyalty, or guest support ecosystems is highly valued.

In return, you’ll get to work with people who are:

High performing and ambitious

Data driven and UX obsessed

Social, welcoming, curious, and open

Leaders who care deeply about your well-being, development, and success

title: Online Data Analyst - French (CA)
description:
TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of Canada's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst

In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.

  • Conduct structured quality audits on spatial datasets using mapping platforms, search directories, and GIS-standard evaluation tools
  • Evaluate and cross-reference complex business, geographic, and cultural data entries against multiple authoritative sources
  • Perform root-cause analysis when spatial data points conflict across sources, documenting the discrepancy with precise reasoning
  • Apply detailed evaluation frameworks with consistency and rigor across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations
  • Be open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
  • Provide structured feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence

Why this matters: Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures people can reliably find critical services, reach trusted businesses, and navigate with confidence. At scale, this is infrastructure work that is foundational to how billions of people interact with geographic information.

Why join the project:

  • Fully remote flexibility: Complete work from anywhere with stable internet, structuring your schedule around academic research, consulting, or other professional commitments
  • Structured onboarding: Access comprehensive evaluation guidelines, detailed reference materials, and practical examples before your first live assessment
  • Direct feedback and growth: Receive performance assessments tied to quality metrics so you can refine your evaluation precision
  • Intellectually rigorous work: Each evaluation requires methodical reasoning, framework interpretation, and structured discrepancy analysis.
  • Responsive support team: Contact dedicated contributor operations staff for clarification on guidelines, technical issues, or administrative questions

Qualification path

Requirements:

  • Professional fluency in English and French (native or near-native proficiency required)
  • Residency in Canada for the last 5 consecutive years
  • Being open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
  • Advanced analytical thinking and methodical problem-solving ability
  • Deep regional, cultural, and geographic knowledge of Canada
  • Comfort with rigorous guideline interpretation and consistent framework application
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in analytical, technical, or research disciplines (strongly preferred)
  • Stable internet connection and access to a personal computer

Qualification path

  • Complete your contributor profile and submit a brief background overview
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Review the open-book study guide and evaluation framework (provided in your welcome materials)
  • Complete an open-book qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

Service Rates

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

Year of Birth

title: Venture Content Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Venture Content Analyst based in Canada.

This is an opportunity to become deeply immersed in the venture capital ecosystem and turn market intelligence into high-quality content.
You’ll track funding rounds, new funds, investors, and emerging trends to understand what is genuinely shaping the market.
The role combines venture research, investment analysis, long-form writing, and content distribution across multiple channels.
You’ll produce thoughtful pieces covering portfolio companies, investments, notable investors, major deals, and important market developments.
Working closely with senior leadership, you’ll gain direct exposure to experienced investors, proprietary processes, and the thinking behind early market signals.
The position is designed to develop into a broader VC Analyst and content-focused role over time.
It is well suited to someone who follows venture capital every day, writes with precision, and is eager to go deeper into the topics they find most compelling.

Accountabilities:

  • Stay exceptionally well informed on venture capital activity, including new funding rounds, emerging funds, notable investors, and significant market developments.
  • Research and identify the developments, trends, and announcements that have meaningful implications for the venture ecosystem.
  • Produce high-quality long-form content for blog articles, LinkedIn, newsletters, and X, prioritizing depth, insight, and accuracy over volume.
  • Write about portfolio companies, investments, fund positions, angel investments, notable investors, major funding rounds, and emerging trends.
  • Conduct the research and analysis required to develop credible, well-supported content and investment-focused narratives.
  • Work closely with the Head of Brand and senior leadership on editorial planning, publishing schedules, and distribution across content channels.
  • Develop a deeper understanding of brand building and the research processes that support effective venture-focused communications.
  • Maintain a high standard of factual accuracy, recognizing that incorrect fund names, round sizes, investor details, or other market information can materially affect credibility.
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate research and content workflows while applying strong judgment about where AI can improve efficiency and where human expertise, taste, and original thinking are essential.
  • Build knowledge and experience that can support progression into a broader VC Analyst and content role.

    • Requirements:

    • Genuine and sustained interest in the venture capital market, with a habit of following the ecosystem closely on a daily basis.
    • Strong knowledge of venture funds, investors, partners, funding rounds, and current market activity, with the ability to identify key players and developments without extensive reference material.
    • Existing experience researching and writing about venture capital, investments, startups, or related market topics.
    • Ability to independently turn research into compelling articles, investment memos, and other high-quality written content.
    • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to factual accuracy.
    • Strong research, analytical, and written communication skills, with the ability to distinguish meaningful developments from market noise.
    • Good editorial judgment and the ability to develop thoughtful, original perspectives on venture trends and investment activity.
    • Practical experience using AI tools in daily work, combined with strong judgment about appropriate and inappropriate use cases.
    • Curiosity, intellectual rigor, and enthusiasm for continuously learning about the venture ecosystem.
    • Ability to work independently and asynchronously while maintaining high standards for quality, ownership, and communication.
    • Comfort operating in a flat organization and learning directly from senior leaders and experienced market participants.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote and asynchronous work environment.
      • Close collaboration with the co-founders and Head of Brand.
      • Direct exposure to an established network of investors and high-quality venture opportunities.
      • Access to internal investment and operating processes.
      • Opportunity to learn directly from experienced leaders and team members.
      • Exposure to a broad range of venture capital activity, investors, companies, and market trends.
      • Opportunity to grow into a dedicated VC Analyst and content-focused position.
      • Meaningful ownership over long-form content and venture research.
      • Opportunity to develop expertise across venture analysis, content strategy, brand building, and market research.

title: Coaching: E-Sports (Head Coach)
description:
Organization Overview
Excel Academy is a network of 5 schools in Massachusetts and Rhode Island that prepares students in grades 5-12 to succeed in high school and college and engage productively in their communities. The majority of our 1,700 students identify as Latinx or Hispanic and will be the first in their families to graduate from college. Families choose Excel because our students consistently outperform their peers in growth and achievement and are 5x more likely to graduate from college.
At Excel, we believe that every student—regardless of race, zip code, or economic status - deserves access to a free, high quality holistic education. During their middle school journey with us, students grow at a pace faster than most peers in their state. This is possible through a combination of high expectations, rigorous instruction, and individualized support. At our nationally ranked high school, students achieve at the highest level and are poised for success in their chosen college or career path.
About our Team
Everyday, our team members choose to be positive, drive their own growth, uplift one another, and hold the highest possible beliefs for what students can achieve.
About the Role
Athletics are an integral part of the high school experience. All members of the school community interact with the athletics program whether it be as participant, manager, spectator, coach, or friend. The programming impacts all students. The goal of the athletics program at Excel Academy Charter School is to provide students with the opportunity to experience leadership, overcome adversity, build character, and make a positive impact on their high school experience.
In order for students to achieve our mission it is essential that coaches uphold our values and expectations. Student athletes look to coaches as their exemplar and rely on them for their physical and emotional safety, expertise, and mentorship.
Dates: November 1 - March 15
Stipend:
  • Head Coach: $3,000 per season, plus postseason bonuses
Hours: 4 - 6 days/week for approximately 10-16 hours per week (afterschool time and weekends)
Your Impact
Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  • Plan, organize, and lead team practices that focus on skill development, strategy, communication, sportsmanship, and preparation for competition in approved esports titles.
  • Coach and supervise student competitors during all scheduled matches, tournaments, playoff contests, and school-approved events, including evenings and weekends as required
  • Maintain consistent communication with the coaching staff to support player development, program alignment, and smooth progression within the esports program
  • Manage team rosters, eligibility requirements, and participation in accordance with school policies, athletic department expectations, PlayVS requirements, and RIIL esports regulations.
  • Uphold and enforce all school, league, and athletic department policies, including expectations related to conduct, attendance, eligibility, sportsmanship, and appropriate online communication. RIIL regulations prohibit taunting, inappropriate communication, and abusive dialogue between participants.
  • Serve as a positive role model for student competitors by promoting academic responsibility, respectful behavior, teamwork, digital citizenship, and good sportsmanship.
  • Assist with equipment management, gym setup and breakdown, and maintaining a safe and organized practice and competition environment.
  • Coordinate with the Athletic Director regarding roster submissions, scheduling, score reporting, and postseason qualifications as required by the RIIL and PlayVS platform.
  • Ensure all participating students complete required esports participation documentation and acknowledgements in accordance with RIIL guidelines
Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
  • Understand how your identity markers (including race, class, and gender) impact your role;
  • Demonstrate understanding and respect for the cultures and languages of our communities;
  • Solicit and welcome collaboration and feedback from colleagues, students, families and the surrounding community;
  • Understand the impact of historical and structural racism and use this lens in your decision-making; and
  • Take action to demonstrate personal reflections and growth/be responsive to feedback and lessons learned
Qualifications
  • High school diploma or equivalent; college coursework or degree preferred
  • Previous competitive experience in esports, gaming clubs, organized leagues, or demonstrated knowledge of esports titles, competitive strategy, team development, and league operations
  • Working knowledge of popular scholastic esports titles such as Rocket League, Super Smash Bros., Mario Kart 8, and other approved competitive titles
  • Ability to work effectively with high school-aged student competitors and support their academic, personal, and competitive growth
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to collaborate with athletic staff, school administrators, parents/guardians, and students
  • Commitment to fostering a positive, inclusive, and development-focused team culture.

title: Koordynator/Koordynatorka Produkcji
description:
Koordynator/Koordynatorka Produkcji
Lokalizacja: Lędziny
