Tryb pracy: Praca stacjonarna, od poniedziałku do piątku, z elastycznym czasem rozpoczęcia (7:00–10:00), umożliwiającym okresowe wsparcie drugiej zmiany.
Opis stanowiska
Dołącz do zespołu Watlow w Lędzinach i weź udział w rozwoju zakładu, w którym uruchamiamy clean room, obróbkę CNC, nowe linie montażu szaf sterowniczych oraz produkty dla rynku półprzewodnikowego.
Szukamy osoby, która dobrze rozumie codzienną pracę produkcji, potrafi prowadzić liderów i chce mieć realny wpływ na sposób zarządzania zakładem. To rola dla kogoś, kto łączy perspektywę operacyjną z umiejętnością porządkowania priorytetów, rozwijania ludzi i budowania jasnych standardów pracy.
Stanowisko powstaje w związku z rozwojem zakładu i zmianą modelu zarządzania produkcją. Obecnie zespół produkcyjny tworzy ok. 70 Operatorów i Operatorek Produkcji, zarządzanych przez 3 Liderów Produkcji. Osoba na tym stanowisku będzie zarządzać bieżącą produkcją poprzez zespół Liderów Produkcji, wspierać ich w codziennych decyzjach oraz wzmacniać odpowiedzialność pierwszej linii.
Rola jest zaprojektowana tak, aby w przyszłości umożliwiać rozwój w kierunku stanowiska Kierownika Produkcji. Docelowo zakres obejmuje całość bieżącej produkcji: montaż finalny, elektronikę i procesy czyste oraz szafy sterownicze wraz z obróbką CNC.
Zakres obowiązków

Odpowiedzialność za wynik bieżącej produkcji w obszarach bezpieczeństwa, jakości, terminowości, produktywności i kosztu
Zarządzanie zespołem Liderów Produkcji: wyznaczanie celów, ocena wyników, rozwój kompetencji liderskich i budowanie następców
Zatwierdzanie obsady, nadgodzin, cross-trainingu i przesunięć pracowników między obszarami
Prowadzenie spotkań zarządzania produkcją, integrowanie wyników obszarów oraz eskalacja problemów wymagających decyzji systemowych
Ustalanie priorytetów między obszarami produkcyjnymi oraz rozstrzyganie konfliktów dotyczących zasobów, terminów i wsparcia technicznego

Zapewnienie jasnej odpowiedzialności za organizację pracy pracowników, w tym przy rotacji między obszarami oraz pracy na pozostałych zmianach.

Współpraca z planowaniem w zakresie oceny wykonalności planu oraz zatwierdzania odstępstw
Nadzór nad standardami BHP, 5S, reakcją na problemy jakościowe oraz skutecznym przekazywaniem zmiany
Udział w uruchamianiu nowych procesów i linii oraz prowadzenie działań usprawniających organizację produkcji

Czego oczekujemy

Minimum 3-letniego doświadczenia w zarządzaniu produkcją, najlepiej obejmującego prowadzenie liderów lub kilku zespołów jednocześnie
Doświadczenia w środowisku produkcyjnym o dużej zmienności, szerokim asortymencie lub krótkim cyklu realizacji zamówienia
Umiejętności prowadzenia ludzi: wyznaczania oczekiwań, udzielania informacji zwrotnej, prowadzenia trudnych rozmów i rozwijania kompetencji
Zdolności podejmowania decyzji przy sprzecznych priorytetach oraz spokojnego rozwiązywania konfliktów
Rozumienia znaczenia BHP, instruktażu stanowiskowego, matrycy kompetencji i formalnego dopuszczenia pracownika do pracy
Umiejętności pracy ze wskaźnikami produkcyjnymi i podejmowania decyzji na podstawie danych
Znajomości języka angielskiego umożliwiającej samodzielną współpracę z funkcjami globalnymi
Wykształcenia wyższego, preferowane techniczne lub z obszaru zarządzania

Mile widziane

Doświadczenie w produkcji technicznej, elektrycznej, elektronicznej lub montażowej
Doświadczenie w budowaniu struktury liderskiej lub standardu pracy pierwszej linii
Praktyczna znajomość Lean Manufacturing, 5S, standaryzacji pracy lub metodycznego rozwiązywania problemów
Doświadczenie w pracy z systemami ERP/MES, raportami produkcyjnymi lub spotkaniami SIM
Doświadczenie w uruchamianiu nowych linii lub procesów oraz w organizacji międzynarodowej

Dlaczego warto dołączyć do Watlow
Oferujemy realny wpływ na decyzje dotyczące obsady, priorytetów produkcyjnych i rozwoju zespołu, w roli zarządczej skoncentrowanej na ludziach i standardzie pracy - planowanie produkcji jest u nas wydzieloną funkcją.
Rola daje możliwość dalszego rozwoju w kierunku stanowiska Kierownika Produkcji, w zależności od wyników i gotowości do przejęcia szerszej odpowiedzialności.W pierwszych miesiącach skoncentrujesz się na przejęciu odpowiedzialności za największy obszar produkcyjny, a następnie - wraz z rozwojem kompetencji i gotowości do objęcia szerszej odpowiedzialności – będziesz stopniowo rozszerzać zakres działania na pozostałe obszary bieżącej produkcji.
Jako część międzynarodowej grupy Watlow zapewniamy dostęp do standardów i rozwiązań stosowanych w zakładach na całym świecie, stabilne zatrudnienie oraz wsparcie wdrożeniowe i rozwój kompetencji liderskich.
Oferujemy również pakiet benefitów pracowniczych, w tym prywatną opiekę medyczną, kartę Multisport i ubezpieczenie grupowe.

title: Mainframe and Legacy Modernization Consultant
description:
Sabot Consulting is assembling an independent assessment team to conduct a one-time retrospective assessment lasting four months of a large, multi-year public-sector enterprise modernization program.

This is an assessment engagement, not an implementation. You will not build, configure, integrate, remediate, or operate anything. You will examine what has already been built, review the evidence, interview the people who built it, and reach independent, defensible conclusions for executive leadership. Independence from the program's implementation vendors is a contractual requirement of the engagement.

The scope covers nine assessment domains and 65 discrete assessment requirements: program governance and risk, business process alignment, architecture and design, integration and data management, mainframe and legacy modernization, security and privacy compliance, software development lifecycle and configuration management, testing and quality assurance, and operational readiness. The technology environment includes a major cloud customer relationship management platform, a public cloud infrastructure estate, an enterprise integration platform, a content management platform, intelligent document processing, and a mainframe lift-and-refactor migration.

Deliverables include an assessment management plan, an initial assessment report, recurring status briefings, per-domain assessment reports, readiness assessments, an executive briefing, and a final assessment report.
You will work full time for four months in a small paired-team structure alongside senior peers. Findings go directly to executive leadership and to a legislative oversight body.

Required

  • 12 or more years in mainframe environments, including legacy modernization or migration assessment experience
  • COBOL and PowerBuilder legacy environments.
  • Experience with mainframe-to-cloud lift-and-shift or refactor programs, ideally assessing them rather than executing them
  • Batch processing, job scheduling, error handling, and reconciliation controls
  • Data synchronization between mainframe systems and modern cloud platforms
  • Modernization sequencing and dependency risk analysis
About Us: Sabot Consulting is a management consulting company focused on providing technical and management consulting to IT executives and managers in strategic, operational, and project-based practice areas. Our focus on providing expert staff that have the knowledge, experience, and professionalism to engage the client at all levels is the key to our success.

We have an incredible opportunity for a dynamic Flight Coordinator to join our growing New York Team!

Attention: Must possess a valid driver’s license and meet all eligibility requirements to obtain a Port Authority of NY/NJ (PANYNJ) ID to qualify for this position.

About DO & CO
We have a passion for hospitality culinary delights on every banquet floor and in the sky. With the three business segments of Airline Catering, International Event Catering, and Restaurants, Lounges & Hotels, we offer gourmet entertainment all over the world. We operate in 33 locations, 12 countries and 3 Continents, maintaining the highest standard of quality in both our products and services. We refine the classics, develop the unknown and grow constantly – sometimes beyond our own expectations.

Responsibilities:

Maintain clear and professional communication across all operational channels, promptly distributing incoming information to the appropriate departments.
Ensure all production processes meet established quality standards and deadlines to guarantee the accurate, on-time handover of DO & CO’s high-end products directly to the aircraft crew.
Verify that all products and trolleys consistently meet the highest quality standards and are delivered according to customer specifications.
Conduct physical inventory counts and pack additional equipment or products as needed, working inside a refrigerated environment.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and provide suggestions to enhance operational efficiency and customer service.
Confirm that all special meals and correct meal counts are prepared, packed, and accurately assigned for each flight.
Collaborate with the Food Packing team and support the assembly line when necessary, including tray setup, food preparation, and packaging in a refrigerated environment.
Perform other duties as assigned by management while upholding DO & CO’s operational and quality standards.

Qualifications:

Valid driver’s license required.
Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, preferably in customer service or a similar field.
Must meet all requirements necessary to obtain a Port Authority of NY/NJ (PANYNJ) ID badge, in accordance with TSA regulations (49 CFR §1542.209).
Proficient in basic computer use and systems navigation.
Strong planning, coordination, and organizational skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
Hands-on and proactive approach to teamwork and task execution.
Comfortable working at least 70% of the shift in a cooler/refrigerated environment.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and work effectively while meeting stringent deadlines.
Strong teamwork and leadership capabilities.
Must be able to read, write, and communicate clearly in English; bilingual in Spanish is a plus.
Must have a flexible schedule to support business operations, including weekends and holidays as needed.

What We Offer:

Pay rate: $22.50 hourly.
Daily Complimentary Meals (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner).
An organization dedicated to fostering innovation; in pursuit of cultivating creativity, embracing new ideas and leveraging our impeccable standard for hospitality.
Genuine career development opportunities, both nationally and internationally.
The chance to collaborate and represent a leading force in the luxury global gourmet entertainment industry.

Diversity & Inclusion Statement
DO & CO provides equal employment opportunities. Applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, disability status or any other protected characteristic.

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Grafana App Platform
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Backend Engineer - Grafana App Platform based in Canada.

This is a senior engineering opportunity focused on evolving a large-scale observability platform into a highly scalable, multi-tenant application platform.
You’ll work on foundational backend architecture that enables both open-source and cloud applications to integrate deeply with dashboards, alerts, incidents, and telemetry.
The role combines hands-on coding with architectural design, roadmap influence, and production operations.
You’ll tackle complex distributed-systems challenges including scalability, high availability, multi-tenancy, and data isolation.
Because changes affect a broad global user base, you’ll play a critical role in planning and safely rolling out architectural improvements without disrupting services.
The environment emphasizes autonomy, pragmatic engineering, cross-team collaboration, and continuous improvement driven by production insights.
You’ll also have access to modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate prototyping, testing, refactoring, documentation, and incident follow-ups.

Accountabilities:

  • Build and evolve backend features while improving the operational experience of the systems you own, using production insights to continuously refine reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Design and implement architectural improvements that support a scalable, standardized, and multi-tenant application platform for observability workloads.
  • Author, contribute to, and review technical design documents, helping establish clear architectural direction and sound engineering practices.
  • Take an active role in shaping the technical roadmap, balancing long-term platform evolution with practical delivery priorities.
  • Collaborate across engineering teams and with external stakeholders to ensure platform changes are aligned with broader product and technical needs.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, sharing knowledge and helping raise engineering quality across the organization.
  • Participate in weekday 12-hour x 5-day and separate weekend 24-hour x 2-day on-call rotations, taking ownership of the customer experience and production reliability.
  • Use AI coding assistants where appropriate to accelerate development, testing, refactoring, documentation, and incident follow-up while maintaining strong review and quality standards.

    • Requirements

    • Strong software engineering and coding experience combined with hands-on operational experience, including responsibility for running and supporting software you have built.
    • Proven experience working with SaaS platforms at scale and solving distributed-systems challenges such as scalability, multi-tenancy, data isolation, and high availability.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly and select the appropriate communication approach for different situations.
    • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to make plans transparent, align stakeholders, incorporate feedback, and coordinate work across multiple teams.
    • A pragmatic, outcome-oriented mindset with the ability to prioritize progress over perfection, navigate ambiguity, and make sound decisions in evolving environments.
    • Strong backend engineering fundamentals and an interest in building reliable, maintainable, and scalable platform infrastructure.
    • Experience with Golang is valuable; candidates without prior Go experience should be comfortable learning and adopting the language.
    • A collaborative, low-ego approach and willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of an individual team or squad.

      • Benefits

      • 100% remote work with a globally distributed team and a collaborative remote-first culture.
      • Country-specific compensation: the source posting provides a U.S. range of $174,986–$209,983 USD; compensation for Canada is determined according to the applicable local market range.
      • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) are included in roles, providing employees with an ownership stake and alignment with long-term organizational success.
      • 30 days of annual leave per year, with 3 days reserved for designated shutdown days, subject to applicable local legislation.
      • Career development opportunities within a high-growth, scaling organization.
      • High-trust environment with autonomy, transparent communication, and empowered teams.
      • Access to modern AI coding assistants and a company-funded usage budget, within applicable security guidelines.
      • Access to advanced AI models and tools to support development workflows.
      • In-person onboarding designed to help new team members connect with colleagues and understand the organization’s culture and ways of working.
      • An innovation-focused environment grounded in open-source values, collaboration, and meaningful technical work.

title: Campaign Strategy Executive

Working closely with Studio Leads and the wider team, you'll translate client briefs into sharp opportunities, ideas and responses- blending strategic thinking with hands-on campaign and operational support.
You'll also help keep the team running smoothly, supporting administration, coordination and workflow behind the scenes.
This is a capability-building role, offering exposure to campaign strategy, media and creative solutions across SCA's audio, digital, content, talent and cross-platform offerings.
What does your day to day look like?

Maintain case study libraries and market insights, and support post-campaign reporting and learnings

title: Vocational Rehabilitation Specialist
description:
The Opportunity:
The Vocational Rehabilitation Specialist (VRS) provides direct vocational rehabilitation services to adults facing employment barriers. This role involves delivering a range of services including skills and interest assessments, confirmation of suitable employment options, individualized employment planning, active job search support, and follow-up to ensure successful employment outcomes. The VRS works closely with clients to support their career goals and facilitate workforce integration, contributing to high-quality rehabilitation outcomes.
Services are delivered under Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) and Canada Pension Plan – Disability (CPP‑D) agreements, ensuring alignment with contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements.
Reporting directly to the Program Manager, Skills Development and Employment (Rehabilitation Portfolio), the VRS ensures that services are delivered in alignment with program objectives, organizational policies, and applicable legislation, while promoting service excellence and continuous improvement.
Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities:

Accept referrals and review client plans/documentation from WSIB or CPPD.
Provide vocational rehabilitation services to adults facing employment barriers.
WSIB-focused activities:

Confirm suitable employment opportunities for return-to-work.
Advise and support clients in active job search strategies, including resume preparation, interview techniques, and employment planning.
Follow up on placements to ensure successful integration.

CPPD-focused activities:

Conduct vocational assessments and professional exploration to determine career pathways.
Document suitable employment and develop individualized rehabilitation plans.
Provide ongoing follow-up to support implementation of rehabilitation plans and program objectives.

Conduct labour market research and transferable skills analyses.
Collect and share information on labour market trends, professional requirements, and access conditions.
Negotiate employment opportunities with employers as needed.
Ensure client satisfaction and adherence to quality standards.

Qualifications and experience

Minimum of two years of recent, relevant experience in employment support services.
University degree in Vocational Rehabilitation, Social Sciences, or a related field.
Relevant professional designation (e.g., CVRP or OCCOQ), or eligibility to obtain the required designation.
An equivalent combination of education, relevant professional experience, and professional designation may be considered.

Strong knowledge of the labour market.
Bilingualism (English/French) is highly valued.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Strong organizational, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Access to a vehicle and a valid driver’s license required.
Strong knowledge of the labour market.
Bilingual (English/French) considered an asset.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Strong organizational, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Access to a vehicle and a valid driver’s license required.

Important details

Hybrid work arrangement (as applicable).
This role supports rehabilitation services within the Skills Development and Employment portfolio, with a focus on WSIB and CPP‑D funded programs.

title: PACE Social Work Supervisor (El Cajon, CA)
description:
Position Summary:
Under the supervision of the Social Services Technical Manager, the PACE Social Services Supervisor, oversees site-specific San Diego PACE Social Services provision, consistent with standards of social work and San Diego PACE, promoting and ensuring quality, efficiency and accessibility of Social Services to PACE participants and families. The Social Services Supervisor is responsible for leading social workers and case Managers in the provision of social work services and ensuring high quality standards within the Social Service Department. The Social Services Supervisor may, as needed, carry a case load (panel) and will train social workers and case managers to effectuate social services, including planning, organizing, implementing and closing the loop for all social services needed for San Diego PACE participants and their families. The PACE Social Services Supervisor will oversee outcomes for the department and provide weekly quality and productivity reports to the Site Manager and Social Services Technical Manager. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: organization of daily workflow, supervision of social service employees and related client outcomes, of QAPI projects, assessment, auditing charts and managing employee performance, treatment(s), teaching and counseling to participant, caregiver or other appropriate representatives. Social Services is the liaison between the interdisciplinary team, caregiver representatives, and community agencies.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Responsible for the overall provision of direct social work and case management services to the participants of the San Diego PACE program, ensuring adherence to policies and procedures of PACE, applicable laws and licensing requirements at all times.
Ensures Social Workers actively engage and contribute meaningfully during Interdisciplinary Team meetings
Train social workers to conduct robust psychosocial assessments, care planning and periodic re-assessments (minimally every 6 months) of each participant's case.
Participate in the hiring process, train and develops Social Workers and case managers.
As assigned, conduct robust psychosocial assessments, care planning and periodic re-assessments (at least every 180 days) of participant's cases.
Ensures assessments, and care plans are thorough and completed prior to the scheduled team meeting, including communicating participant changes to team members.
Ensures that all MSWs complete Plan of Care signing and documentation in EPIC
Appropriately escalate issues/concerns to Social Service Technical Manager
Oversees the development of Social Workers and case managers including monitoring and feedback of all aspects of services provided to individuals.
Providing superior customer service to stakeholders, and team members.
Ensures resources are available to provide appropriate referrals community agencies or facilities; acts as liaison with such organizations and as an advocate for participants.
Consults with, develops and advises staff members as to the interconnectedness of social, emotional and cultural factors, and their impact on health.
Fosters a positive and professional environment of effective relationship building amongst staff and maintain a cohesive team.
Participates in Program and Policy development of Social Work department.
Provides clinical and crisis management support to individuals, Employees, & Providers.
Maintains working knowledge of facility service areas including transportation, community characteristics and geography.
Ensures that participants receive a visit by appropriate PACE staff member within 24 hours of hospital admissions or on Monday if participant is admitted on Friday or weekend.
Coordinate hospital discharge, in conjunction with interdisciplinary team, including communication with attending physician.
Communicates with family, legal representatives and caregivers frequently and as appropriate.
Acts as a resource for education and training to other team members and day center staff regarding topics such as dementia, difficult behaviors, and difficult personalities
Ensures that all participants complete Care Plan signing after every assessment.
Assigns & monitors Social Workers and Case Manager caseloads for proper service deliver, quality and compliance.
Ensures required documentation is in place, accurate, up-to-date, and in compliance with internal and external regulations and policies.
Acts as site program administrator during absence of Social Service Technical Manager.
Resolves employee issues within position responsibilities.

Additional Duties and Responsibilities:

May work on special assignments in addition to normal job functions, including traveling to other San Diego PACE sites.
Enhances professional growth and development through participation in educational programs current literature, in-service meetings and workshops.
Adheres to and models SYHC’s core values and behaviors of Excellence, Empowerment, Integrity and Respect.
Adheres to SYHC and PACE attendance and punctuality policies and practices.
Performs other related duties as assigned or requested.
Actively participates in the implementation of the I-SAT and HOS M surveys

Job Requirements:
Education Required:
Master's Degree from an accredited School of Social Work

Certifications/Licenses Required:
Valid California driver’s license. Reliable transportation with proper insurance to meet San Diego PACE guidelines. First Aid/CPR certification.

Experience and Required Skills:

1 year of experience in a healthcare setting; work must have included social work provisions to frail and/or elderly populations.
Counseling theory and techniques and ability to effectively and efficiently utilize EPIC EMR and other documentation outlets.
Knowledge of community resources and appropriate utilization to meet the needs of clients and employees.
Organization and project management skills.
Ability to establish and maintain good interpersonal relationships. Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
Comfort performing home visits to private homes of San Diego PACE applicants and participants with frequent travel in San Diego county.
Understanding of Scope of Social Work practice and authority to practice

Preferred:

Experience as a Clinical Social Worker and/or demonstrated experience as a leader.
Demonstrated ability to conduct individual and group therapy for geriatric clients
Analytical thinking and problem solving abilities.
Able to meet a standardized set of competencies for the Social Services Department, as required by San Diego PACE and approved by CMS before working independently.

Verbal and Written Skills Required to Perform the Job:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Equipment Used:
Office equipment, including but not limited to, computers, phones (including
cell phones), copy machines, fax machines.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:
Prolonged periods of sitting and standing. Frequent walking. Driving within the County of San Diego. Lifting of no more than 15 lbs. Ability to remain calm and objectively evaluate problems. May be required to work outside normal working hours.

Universal Requirements:
Pre-employment requirements include I-9, physical, positive background and reference check results, complete application, new hire orientation, pre-employment PPDs.

title: Per Diem Dental Patient Service Representative
description:
Patient Service Representative — Dental
About the Role
Are you a Patient Service Representative who loves creating a welcoming first impression and keeping things running behind the scenes? At Thundermist Health Center, you’ll be the friendly face and voice of our Dental department — greeting patients, scheduling appointments, verifying insurance, collecting payments, and making sure every visit starts and ends smoothly. You’ll handle registration, answer incoming calls, and keep accurate records so our clinical team can focus on delivering great care. If you’re organized, people-focused, and want your work to support health equity in our community, we want to hear from you.
What You’ll Do
Reporting to the Dental Practice Manager, you’ll be the hub of daily operations at the front desk.
Scheduling & Patient Registration

Welcome patients and manage all aspects of check-in and registration.
Schedule, confirm, and coordinate dental appointments, ensuring accuracy and appropriateness of booking.
Verify dental insurance coverage and patient copays prior to each visit.
Enter and maintain patient registration data, encounter billing information, and insurance changes with complete accuracy.
Prepare patient records ahead of dental visits.

Communication & Collections

Answer all incoming calls promptly and take complete, accurate messages.
Collect payments at the time of service.
Obtain referrals to specialists and schedule follow-up appointments as needed.
Provide daily productivity and collection reports to the Practice Manager.

What We’re Looking For
You’re someone who brings a warm, professional presence to every interaction — on the phone, at the front desk, and with colleagues across the clinic.

High school diploma or associate degree.
Accurate data entry skills and strong attention to detail.
Excellent communication and customer service skills, including professional telephone etiquette.
Knowledge of medical terminology, diagnosis coding, billing procedures, or dental insurance is a plus.
Candidates who don’t meet every preferred qualification are encouraged to apply.
A commitment to patient-centered service and Thundermist’s mission of caring for our community.

Schedule & Locations
This is a per diem position at a Thundermist Health Center Dental location. You’ll need to be available for flexible scheduling based on coverage needs and may include shifts during the following hours of operation: Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM; candidates must be available to work evenings and holidays as needed.
Work Environment
You’ll work onsite in a general office environment within our Dental department.

Moderate physical activity including walking, standing, sitting, bending, and stretching.
Regular use of a PC, multi-line phone system, and standard office equipment.

Our Values
Everything we do at Thundermist is guided by five core values: Integrity, Innovation, Excellence, Community, and Caring. If those resonate with you, you’ll feel at home here.

Ready to join a team that truly cares?
Apply today.
Thundermist Health Center is an equal opportunity employer.
We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex,
national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation,
gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: School Age Early Childhood Educator - Forest Hill
description:
Be more than a teacher; Be more than an instructor; Be more than a friend; Be the Spark that allows a child to shine. Join our professional and passionate team of early childhood educators!
Position: Registered Early Childhood Educator or otherwise approved
Status: part-time
Intended location: Forest Hill YMCA Before & After School Program, Midhurst

The opportunity: To build healthy, strong, connected communities through nurturing environments for children.

In this role, you will:

Provide personal care to children, including but not limited to toileting/diaper changing, providing first aid, administering medication, monitoring dietary, allergies & medical conditions
Actively engage with children and always ensure supervision and safety of children in a group setting of up to 15 children independently
Plan and implement play-based learning in accordance with YMCA Curriculum
Ensure positive, professional communication with families, staff and volunteers on an ongoing basis
Provide an inclusive environment, supporting the needs of all children, including those with exceptional behaviours and additional needs
Demonstrate appropriate behaviours in line with our Mission, Vision and Values
Adhere to work schedule to ensure program stays within ratio and provide adequate notice to supervisor regarding unexpected scheduling changes
Demonstrate flexibility with routines and schedules
Other duties as assigned

For this role, you bring:

Minimum 18 years of age
Current Standard/Intermediate First Aid and CPR (Level C) certification OR completion of certification within first 90 days of employment
Satisfactory Vulnerable Sector Check
Up-to-date immunizations or equivalent in accordance with local public health and Child Care Early Years Act

Availability requirements: Monday to Friday, 25 hours per week, with split shifts approximately 7:00-9:30 a.m. and 3:30–6:00 p.m. on all school instructional days (September to June).Hours and shifts are not guaranteed on non-instructional days (e.g., PA days, March Break, Christmas Break, summer) and may be scheduled at a different location.
Passion for working with children and providing quality play-based learning

Well-developed interpersonal and relationship building skills with families, staff and volunteers

Benefits of working with us:

Complimentary access to virtual and/or in-person opportunities promoting health and fitness
Employee & Family Assistance Program
Annual paid Wellness Day
Annual recognition pay
Professional development opportunities
Work life balance that offers most evenings and weekends free; all statutory days off
6 well-being days per year

About us:
The YMCA of Simcoe/Muskoka is a registered charity dedicated to building healthier, stronger communities by promoting physical, mental, and social well-being for all. We offer a wide range of inclusive and affordable programs and services to individuals and families, regardless of their background or financial situation.

Our Y ignites the potential in people, serving over 64,000 individuals across Simcoe County, the District Municipality of Muskoka, and the District of Parry Sound. We are dedicated to creating vibrant, connected communities where everyone belongs.

Our YMCA employs over a thousand staff and hundreds of volunteers who serve tens of thousands of individuals each year in various programs such as child care, camps, health and fitness, leadership development, employment and literacy, immigrant services, and youth programming.

Our commitment is to create a safe and supportive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued. At the Y, we believe in the potential within each person to shine, and through support, positivity, and guidance, we empower individuals to overcome obstacles and achieve their goals. When we help each person shine, we unlock the collective strength of our entire community.

We believe income should never stand in the way of wellbeing. Thanks to the generosity of our donors, we ensure that our inclusive programs and services are accessible to individuals and families across our community through our financial assistance program.

Applications will remain open until filled.

This role is for an existing vacancy that is available or will be available at the time of fulfillment.

We wish to express our appreciation to all applicants for their interest in this position; however only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

In keeping with our commitment to child and youth safeguarding, job offers are contingent on the completion of a current Vulnerable Sector Check and employment reference checks. Vulnerable Sector Checks are reviewed on an individual basis and the offense(s) - if any - is considered in the decision-making process in relation to the requirement of working with children, therefore not eliminating all candidates with a record from being offered a position. Vulnerable Sector Checks must be renewed every three years.

The YMCA of Simcoe/Muskoka is committed to fair and accessible employment practices. Our goal is a diverse, inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. Each step of our recruitment process is human-led; we do not use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated screening tools. Individuals needing employment accommodation in the hiring process or job postings in an alternative format may contact the recruitment department sm.jobs@sm.ymca.ca

title: Part-time Logistics SME - Search & Rescue Inventory Management
description:
Corner Alliance is a dynamic, growing consulting firm that devotes itself to providing an enriching employee experience while working in meaningful ways to create results for the government. We are currently seeking a Logistics Subject Matter Expert with 8+ years of experience to join our team and fully embrace our commitment to deliver, grow and thrive.

*This is a part-time role with a level of effort of around 8 hours per week and is Contingent Upon Award.

About the Role:

As a Logistics Subject Matter Expert supporting our Federal government client, you will be trusted to provide logistics and inventory management expertise to support FEMA warehouse operations, including equipment maintenance, inventory tracking, and disaster response support.

Key Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

title: Staff Backend Engineer, Database Automation (Go)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Backend Engineer, Database Automation (Go) based in Canada .

This is a senior technical role focused on building and evolving database automation and PostgreSQL-as-a-service capabilities at internet scale. You will use Go to automate the full PostgreSQL lifecycle, from provisioning and configuration through upgrades, failover, scaling, and decommissioning. Your work will make database operations safer, more consistent, resilient, and easier to scale across high-throughput, always-on services. You will help replace bespoke database configurations with standardized platforms and repeatable automation. The role combines hands-on engineering, technical leadership, architecture, and close collaboration with infrastructure and product engineering teams. You will also operate the systems you build in production and use real-world feedback to continuously improve them. The environment is fully remote, asynchronous, and highly collaborative, with a strong emphasis on ownership, automation, and AI-enabled productivity.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, build, test, review, and maintain Go-based automation covering the full PostgreSQL lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, failover, scaling, and decommissioning.
  • Develop automation across infrastructure-as-code tooling and cloud infrastructure while evaluating operator-based approaches for managing stateful services.
  • Build reliable services and automation capable of supporting high-throughput, always-on production workloads where correctness, latency, and availability are critical.
  • Integrate compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, and managed data services across cloud providers into a coherent PostgreSQL platform.
  • Develop a standardized PostgreSQL-as-a-service platform that reduces bespoke database configurations and enables database operations to scale without requiring equivalent growth in the operations team.
  • Build safe and repeatable PostgreSQL major-version upgrade automation and validate changes against real production traffic before deployment.
  • Research and implement improvements to PostgreSQL performance, scalability, reliability, and data health while proactively addressing critical database saturation points.
  • Use AI agents and productivity tools throughout implementation, code review, service operations, and repetitive engineering workflows while maintaining the repository context required for effective team collaboration.
  • Collaborate with product management, infrastructure, software delivery, database, and platform engineering teams to design and deliver high-performing solutions.
  • Provide technical direction for major initiatives, turning ambiguous problems into clear architectures and sequenced execution plans that enable multiple engineers to work in parallel.
  • Review database automation and Go contributions with a focus on safety, maintainability, performance, and long-term operational reliability.
  • Document automation practices, PostgreSQL operational patterns, and platform guidance that enable other engineers to effectively use and contribute to the systems.
  • Operate the solutions you build in production end to end and use operational feedback to guide subsequent iterations and improvements.
  • Influence engineering practices beyond the immediate team through design reviews, mentorship, cross-team collaboration, and reusable technical patterns.

    • Requirements:

    • You bring professional software engineering experience working with PostgreSQL in large, complex production environments, including experience building or operating database-as-a-service capabilities.
    • You have strong proficiency in Go, including experience designing, implementing, testing, and reviewing backend services.
    • You have experience developing Kubernetes operators, controllers, or comparable automation for the lifecycle management of stateful services, particularly databases.
    • You are comfortable with infrastructure as code and understand core database operations concepts such as high availability, replication, backups, and system-level performance trade-offs.
    • You have demonstrated ownership of the technical direction for significant initiatives and can translate ambiguous technical challenges into scalable architectures and executable plans.
    • You have experience working with high-throughput, always-on production systems where reliability, performance, and operational safety are essential.
    • Familiarity with Ruby is a plus, particularly for working within environments that use Ruby on Rails, but it is not required at the start of the role.
    • You have strong written communication skills and are comfortable collaborating asynchronously within a distributed, all-remote team.
    • You are self-directed, well organized, and capable of managing priorities independently while maintaining strong ownership of outcomes.
    • You demonstrate strong alignment with principles of transparency, collaboration, inclusion, and open-source contribution.
    • You can influence engineering practices beyond your immediate team and are comfortable partnering with database, infrastructure, and platform teams.
    • You have experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical growth through design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

      • Benefits:

      • The position is fully remote and supports an asynchronous, distributed working environment.
      • The U.S. base salary range is $152,800–$259,200 USD, depending on level, experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, market data, equity considerations, and geographic location.
      • The listed base salary does not include potential bonuses, equity compensation, or benefits.
      • Benefits are designed to support employees’ health, finances, and overall well-being.

      • Employees have opportunities to work with modern AI tools and incorporate AI into their daily workflows to improve efficiency, innovation, and impact.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Scrum Master:

The scope of the proposed services will include the following:

  • The duties of a Scrum Master include but are not limited to:
  • Guide a team and organization using Agile/Scrum best practices, methodologies and values.
  • Assess the Scrum maturity of the team and organization and coach the team to higher levels of maturity, at a pace that is sustainable and comfortable for the team and organization.
  • Remove impediments or guide a team to remove impediments.
  • Facilitate completion of work assignments, assigning, or dictating work assignments.
  • Facilitate discussion, decision making, team building and conflict resolution.

  • information: supporting product managers to maximize return on investment (ROI) and meet the organization’s objectives.

  • Engage in agile delivery utilizing best agile methodology (i.e. Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, XP, etc.).

title: MEP Project Manager
description:

description:

About us: New Seasons Market began in 2000 when three families got together to open a neighborhood market, a place where local communities can come together to connect with where their food comes from. A friendly, inviting place that honors its region’s farmers, ranchers, growers and makers—helping them prosper for generations to come. Over the years, our community has grown, but our goal is still the same: to build community through good food.
About the role: Responsible for the implementation and oversight of category strategies in stores, including resets, new item cut-ins and ensuring that all systems and processes for the department are in place and are being followed consistently throughout all of the stores. Acts as liaison between the Prepared Foods and Bakery merchandising teams and the Prepared Foods, Bakery and store leadership teams. Inspires an outstanding customer experience in our Prepared Foods and Bakery department by ensuring an innovative product mix and assortment that aligns with the New Seasons brand and is viable from a financial standpoint.
Position Responsibilities:

Develop and Train:

Collaborates with store leadership teams and serves as a resource for the development of Prepared Foods and Bakery managers. Provides insightful, helpful and consistent performance feedback and acts as a resource to store leadership in holding the departments accountable.
Maintains excellent communication with department managers, store leadership teams, Operations leadership, and the Prepared Foods and Bakery merchandising teams.
Provides mentorship to Prepared Foods and Bakery Department Managers and other key department roles to achieve operational and merchandising excellence.
Assists Department Managers with back room and inventory organization, inventory preparation and other basic department processes and procedures.
Guides Department Managers with proper Prepared Foods and Bakery ordering. Mentors order writers to build ordering acumen and write orders consistent with department goals and standards to ensure the highest level of product availability.

Operational Support:

Support Prepared Foods and Bakery departments in stores when specific needs are identified. This may include temporarily filling in for key positions, assisting with and monitoring ordering for departments, writing department schedules, or any other vital department task identified by leadership.
Partners with Prepared Foods and Bakery leadership teams and merchandising team to quickly resolve issues impacting store operations, in stock conditions, inventory, margin, waste and store conditions.
Utilizes tools and educates store staff to optimize facings for holding power and assortment, communicating with the category manager to ensure category roles and assortment targets are in place.
Collaborates with Operations, Prepared Foods and Bakery leadership to identify category opportunities for expansion or retraction of product displays and cases. Identifies potential for increasing sales and inventory control.
Constantly monitors category trends by evaluating assortment, zero movers, items not carried, shelf/case standards, tagging and rotation.

Reporting:

Performs regular detailed department audits with department leadership. Reports on these audits to Operations leadership and Merchandising teams along with recommendations around any changes or actions that need to be taken.
Perform regular whole store surface walks and report on these walks to Operations and Store leadership.

Tools and Equipment Used (not all inclusive): This position works with standard office equipment. May be required to use the following tools and equipment when working in stores or offsite; baler, hand truck, POS, industrial kitchen equipment (i.e. blast chiller, grill, knives/blades, oven, grills, scales, etc.) and basic housekeeping / janitorial items.

This position works consistently at a light work level and may be asked to work on occasion at a medium or heavy work level when supporting stores or other offsite events. Frequently required to sit, walk, reach and grasp. Occasionally required to be on feet with a mix of standing and walking throughout shift. Up to occasionally, dependent on location, required to climb stairs, step stool and /or ladders.

Performs other tasks and duties as assigned.

This job description is not meant to be an all-inclusive list of duties, responsibilities and requirements, but constitutes a general definition of the position's scope and function within our company. New Seasons Market reserves the right to amend and change duties, responsibilities, and requirements to meet changing industry or business needs as necessary.

General Requirements:

Understands and models our company culture. Acts as a steward of company resources, mission, vision and values. Promotes sustainable business practices.
Embraces an agile work environment and guides others through change and continuous improvement.

Builds community within and outside of New Seasons Market and New Leaf Community Markets. Works in stores and other offsite events and locations as needed to support our core business and community.
Works cooperatively and positively with fellow team members, customers and vendors spiriting a respectful workplace where everyone is welcome.

Demonstrates ability to manage own time and models a flexible work style. Shifts tasks as priorities and circumstances change based on needs and conditions of department. Creative with problem-solving and is solutions-oriented.

Utilizes strategic thinking, data and industry knowledge, and calculated risk-taking to create competitive advantage.
Communication style is confident, informative, adaptive to different styles and effective.
Gives and receives feedback in a constructive manner demonstrating company Speak Up culture. Responds to feedback in order to improve performance.
Maintains confidentiality and exercise good judgment around sensitive information.
Adheres to work and food safety policies set forth by the company and all local, state and federal regulatory agencies. Contributes to store and office cleanliness, maintains equipment.
Observes all company rules and policies. Understands and complies with specific department or location guidelines, tasks and responsibilities.

What you Bring as a Candidate:

Minimum 2 years experience in Prepared Foods and Bakery retail management required, including ordering and inventory management experience.
Working knowledge of category schematics and planograms highly preferred.
Previous visual merchandising experience highly preferred.
Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel and PowerPoint, with skills to learn new computer programs and systems. Experience working with food service inventory software highly preferred.
Excellent organizational and project coordination skills, with an eye for process improvement. Previous project management experience a plus.
Experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with ability to respond to urgent job responsibilities as they arise and flexible when priorities redirect.
Excellent interpersonal skills, including tact and diplomacy, to collaborate, negotiate and communicate effectively and professionally with cross-functional partners at all levels in the company.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise good judgment around sensitive information.
Valid driver’s license and vehicle required, with ability to travel regularly to store locations and other sites throughout the Portland Metro area.

Physical and Environmental Work Space: Work occurs in office, a variety of off-site environments and in a grocery store environment which includes surfaces that can be wet and slippery, moderate noise level, and temperature extremes in controlled environments in the cooler and freezer, and depending on location, working outside in all temperatures. There may be exposure to certain allergens and / or chemicals. In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the ADA Amendments Act of 2008, and other applicable state or local law, we will make reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities.

title: Physical Therapist (PT) – Mobile/Home-Based Care
description:
Overview

We are seeking a skilled, compassionate, and dependable Physical Therapist (PT) to provide high-quality physical therapy services to patients in their homes throughout the Hemet/Temecula region.

The Physical Therapist will travel to patients' homes to perform comprehensive evaluations, develop individualized plans of care, provide skilled therapeutic interventions, monitor patient progress, and educate patients and caregivers on strategies to improve mobility, function, safety, and independence.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in a home-based environment, has strong clinical judgment and communication skills, and is passionate about delivering patient-centered care.

This is a 1099 independent contractor position.

Duties and Responsibilities

· Travel to patients' homes throughout the assigned service area to provide physical therapy services.

· Perform comprehensive physical therapy evaluations in the patient's home environment.

· Assess strength, range of motion, balance, gait, mobility, coordination, endurance, pain, functional limitations, and ability to safely perform activities of daily living.

· Evaluate the patient's home environment and identify potential safety and fall risks that may impact mobility and independence.

· Develop individualized plans of care based on evaluation findings, physician orders/referrals, patient needs, clinical judgment, and functional goals.

· Establish measurable short-term and long-term functional goals.

· Provide skilled physical therapy interventions appropriate to the patient's diagnosis and functional limitations, including:

o Therapeutic exercises

o Therapeutic activities

o Neuromuscular re-education

o Gait and mobility training

o Balance and coordination training

o Functional strengthening

o Manual therapy when clinically appropriate

o Transfer training

o Fall prevention and safety training

· Train patients in the safe use of assistive devices such as walkers, canes, and other mobility equipment.

· Develop and instruct patients in individualized home exercise programs.

· Educate patients and caregivers regarding diagnosis, treatment, exercises, mobility, safety, fall prevention, and strategies to promote independence.

· Monitor patient response to treatment and make appropriate clinical modifications to the plan of care.

· Perform reassessments and communicate changes in patient condition or functional status as appropriate.

· Coordinate care with physicians, nurses, caregivers, physical therapist assistants, occupational therapists, and other healthcare professionals.

· Communicate effectively with referring providers regarding patient progress, concerns, and recommendations.

· Complete accurate, timely, and thorough documentation for evaluations, daily treatment visits, reassessments, progress reports, and discharge summaries.

· Maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations, professional standards, payer requirements, and company policies.

· Recognize changes in patient condition that may require physician notification, additional medical evaluation, or modification of treatment.

· Maintain patient confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries at all times.

· Provide compassionate, respectful, and professional care to patients and their families in the home setting.

Requirements

· Current and valid California Physical Therapist license in good standing.

· Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program.

· Strong knowledge of anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, biomechanics, and rehabilitation principles.

· Strong clinical reasoning and patient assessment skills.

· Ability to independently perform comprehensive PT evaluations and develop appropriate plans of care.

· Experience treating patients with orthopedic, musculoskeletal, neurological, balance, gait, weakness, mobility, and/or functional limitations preferred.

· Strong knowledge of therapeutic exercise, gait training, balance training, functional mobility, neuromuscular re-education, and fall prevention.

· Excellent patient assessment and acute/chronic pain management skills.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work independently and effectively manage a mobile patient caseload.

· Must be punctual, dependable, organized, and professional.

· Comfortable entering and providing care in patients' homes and working with patients and caregivers in a home-based environment.

· Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.

· Ability to travel throughout the assigned service area.

· CPR/BLS certification preferred or required according to company policy.

· Previous home health, mobile therapy, outpatient, orthopedic, neurological, geriatric, or community-based experience is preferred.

Mobile/Home-Based Care Expectations

Because this position involves providing care in patients' homes, the Physical Therapist must be able to:

· Arrive at scheduled visits within the expected timeframe.

· Manage travel time and maintain an efficient daily schedule.

· Carry and transport necessary clinical equipment and supplies.

· Adapt treatment approaches to different home environments and available space.

· Maintain a safe and professional environment during every patient visit.

· Communicate promptly regarding cancellations, scheduling changes, or patient concerns.

· Respect patients' homes, privacy, routines, and individual preferences.

· Demonstrate sound clinical judgment when working independently in the community.

Documentation and Compliance

The Physical Therapist is responsible for completing all required clinical documentation accurately and within established timeframes, including:

· Initial evaluations

· Treatment notes

· Reassessments

· Progress reports

· Recertifications, when applicable

· Discharge documentation

· Home exercise programs

· Communication with referring providers

· Other documentation required by the organization, payer, or applicable regulations

Job Type

Full-time – 1099 Independent Contractor

Pay Structure (1099)

· Guaranteed base pay: $1,080 per week

· Base compensation is calculated at $45 per patient visit, based on a minimum of 6 patient visits per day.

· $45 per additional patient visit for visits beyond the daily base of 6.

· Compensation is subject to the terms of the independent contractor agreement.

Schedule

4/10 Schedule

· Four 10-hour workdays per week

· Typical start time: 7:30 AM–8:30 AM, depending on patient scheduling and geographic coverage.

· Daily schedule may vary based on patient locations, visit duration, and patient needs.

Work Location

Mobile/Home-Based – Hemet/Temecula Region

The Physical Therapist will travel to assigned patients' homes throughout the designated service area.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a clinically confident, compassionate, and self-motivated Physical Therapist who enjoys working one-on-one with patients and families. The successful candidate will be comfortable making clinical decisions independently, adapting treatment to the patient's home environment, and providing high-quality care while maintaining excellent documentation and communication.

This position is an excellent opportunity for a Physical Therapist who values autonomy, flexibility, meaningful patient relationships, and community-based care

title: Staff AI Engineer (Data & Intelligence function)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff AI Engineer (Data & Intelligence function) based in Canada .

This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on turning large-scale operational, product, and customer data into intelligent systems and actionable insights. You will build retrieval, knowledge graph, inference, and agentic capabilities on top of a modern data platform. The role spans data, observability, AI, and platform engineering, with the scope evolving alongside organizational priorities. You will create shared capabilities that multiple teams can rely on to build intelligent products and workflows. Much of the work involves designing and shipping production systems while establishing technical patterns and standards for other engineers. You will work closely with product, platform, engineering, and business leaders in an environment that values rapid iteration and practical experimentation. This is an opportunity for a senior individual contributor to shape AI engineering practices while delivering measurable business impact.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, build, test, and ship production AI systems as an active hands-on engineering contributor.
  • Lead the development of high-performance customer context retrieval capabilities using semantic search, indexing, embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, and knowledge graph approaches.
  • Build systems that allow agents to identify customers and retrieve comprehensive context efficiently from multiple data sources.
  • Develop inference and signal-processing layers that read from an Iceberg-based lakehouse, generate scored insights, and expose reliable signals through contracts that other teams can consume.
  • Transform signals such as churn risk, usage or entitlement mismatches, and expansion opportunities into automated workflows that drive appropriate actions, incorporating human review where required.
  • Select the appropriate technical approach for each workload, balancing large language models, smaller specialized or fine-tuned models, and deterministic software while managing inference costs.
  • Establish evaluation and observability practices for AI systems, including tracing, prompt and model versioning, dataset-driven testing, and evidence that signals are reliable before they are acted upon.
  • Define reusable engineering patterns and shared capabilities that enable other teams to build effectively on the organization’s AI and data infrastructure.
  • Partner with engineering and business leaders to translate strategic objectives into scalable, production-ready systems.
  • Adapt quickly to unfamiliar technical contexts, technologies, codebases, and evolving AI frameworks while maintaining a strong focus on delivering useful production outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    • You have 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years shipping AI or machine learning systems into production.
    • You have strong software engineering fundamentals and deep proficiency in at least one language used for AI and data engineering, with Python being the primary language for ML and insights.
    • You are highly proficient with data at scale, including advanced SQL, a transformation framework such as dbt, and distributed query engines operating over lakehouse or warehouse storage.
    • You understand query optimization, partitioning, cost management, and the practical challenges of working with large-scale data platforms.
    • You have production experience with retrieval and context engineering, including embeddings, vector search, hybrid or graph retrieval, and measuring retrieval quality and effectiveness.
    • You have experience modeling entities and relationships across multiple data sources, particularly where this supports customer context and intelligent systems.
    • You have built and operated agentic systems and durable workflows using tool calling, state, memory, and human-in-the-loop patterns, with experience in Temporal, LangGraph, or equivalent technologies.
    • You understand how to evaluate and observe AI systems through tracing, prompt and version management, dataset-driven testing, and other appropriate engineering practices.
    • You have cloud deployment experience, preferably with AWS, including containerized services and responsibility for managing inference costs.
    • You hold a B.S. in Computer Science or have equivalent practical experience.
    • You have experience creating shared data or ML capabilities that other engineering teams can build upon.
    • Experience with smaller or fine-tuned models, model distillation, high-volume observability data, OpenTelemetry, data governance, lineage, access controls, or data residency is highly valuable.
    • Experience in enterprise SaaS, CMS environments, or complex digital platforms is beneficial.
    • You are comfortable using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot and technologies such as MCP to connect intelligent systems with real-world tools and services.
    • You communicate complex AI system designs effectively to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
    • You have a strong senior individual contributor track record, with a reputation for high-quality code and system design and an ability to mentor others through technical leadership and example.
    • You demonstrate adaptability, intellectual curiosity, strong ownership, and a builder mentality, with the ability to use AI as an integral part of your engineering workflow.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive healthcare coverage designed to support employees and their families.
      • Wellness programs and resources supporting physical and mental well-being.
      • Flexible time-off policies that allow employees to take time away when needed.
      • Parental leave and family-focused support.
      • Recognition programs that celebrate employee contributions and achievements.
      • Opportunities to work with large-scale data platforms, AI systems, agentic workflows, and modern cloud technologies.
      • Exposure to complex enterprise data, observability, retrieval, inference, and intelligent automation challenges.
      • Significant opportunity to influence shared engineering capabilities and AI development practices across multiple teams.
      • A hands-on environment that supports experimentation, continuous learning, and rapid iteration.
      • Career development opportunities within a global technology organization focused on innovation and AI-enabled transformation.

Take Your Railcar Repair Skills on the Road

Road & Rail Services is seeking an experienced Traveling Railcar Repair Technician based in Fulton County, Georgia. This is a field-based opportunity for a skilled railroad professional with previous freight railcar repair experience, welding capabilities, and the flexibility to travel to different work locations.

This position is intended for someone who already understands the fundamentals of freight car inspection and repair. Previous railcar repair experience and welding experience are required. This is not an entry-level opportunity.

You'll use your existing skills to identify defects, complete authorized repairs, and help ensure rail equipment meets required safety and service standards.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Complete approved repairs to railcar components and equipment

Maintain accurate inspection and repair documentation

Operate company vehicles and equipment as assigned

Keep work areas organized and free of unnecessary hazards

Complete repairs according to company, customer, and applicable AAR requirements

Follow all site-specific and railroad safety procedures

Experience Required

We're looking for candidates who can bring established railcar maintenance knowledge to the position and perform field assignments with limited supervision.

Qualified applicants should have:

Professional freight railcar repair or maintenance experience

Hands-on welding experience, including stick welding

Familiarity with freight railcar components and repair practices

Strong mechanical troubleshooting abilities

Experience using welding equipment, hand tools, and power tools

Ability to understand repair instructions and complete required documentation

Ability to work independently while maintaining quality standards

Valid driver's license

Willingness and ability to travel

Reliable attendance and a safety-first approach

$28.00–$34.00 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.

Road & Rail Services offers:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance

401(k) with company matching

Weekly safety incentive opportunities

Career development and advancement opportunities

Promote-from-within culture

title: Certified Sterile Processing Technician (CSPD) Part-Time
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Responsible for the proper care and handling of all general and specialty instruments including the cleaning, decontamination, instrument identification, assembly, packaging and distribution, and sterilization of surgical instrumentation.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Decontaminates, assembles and packages all instruments following established protocols as well as perform necessary repairs, reassembles and stores specialized surgical instruments. Prepares all order requests as necessary for replacement parts for instruments and additional equipment as necessary or upon request of physicians.
Maintains a clean and safe environment by adhering to Standard Precautions and Infection Control practices. Staff will don proper Personnel Protective equipment (PPE), follows protocols for decontamination process referencing Instructions for Use (IFU) supplied by the manufacturers.
Identifies instruments for all specialties and assures proper function. Follows protocol for repair or replacement of instruments that are not functioning properly. Assembles and packages all instrumentation and sets according to dept. protocol. Utilizes equipment according to the manufacturer’s recommendations and hospital policy.
Operates steam autoclaves, ETO and Gas Plasma sterilizers. Maintains appropriate logs and records relating to the sterilization process, including the Ethylene Oxide Aeration Records, Sterilizer Load Records, and Biological Monitoring Records.
Responds to problem calls from the Operating Room and performs preliminary investigation. Determines priority level of instrumentation and equipment requests and other hospital needs. Directs services in a competent and professional manner while assuring OR priorities are completed in a timely manner.

Performs all functions according to established policies, procedures, regulatory and accreditation requirements, as well as applicable professional standards. Provides all customers with an excellent service experience by consistently demonstrating our core and leader behaviors each and every day.

NOTE: The essential functions are intended to describe the general content of and requirements of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. Specific tasks or responsibilities will be documented as outlined by the incumbent's immediate manager.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma or GED and BLS certification required.
Requires current national certification as a SPD Technician, Certified Registered Central Service Technician or Surgical Instrument Processor and relevant experience with sterilizing instruments which qualifies the candidate for the national certification exam or certified registration.

Must have mechanical aptitude with the ability to break down moving parts, clean, lubricate and reassemble, problem solve incomplete trays and missing instrumentation and have effective organizational, communication and human relation skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

description:
Director, Shinshinim & Israel Engagement

Jewish Educational Services (JES), an agency of The Associated Jewish Federation of Baltimore, seeks an exceptional relationship-builder, educator, and community leader to serve as the Director, Shinshinim & Israel Engagement.
This highly visible leadership role oversees JES’s Shinshinim program and broader Israel engagement efforts. The Shinshinim Director, with the support of the JES team, mentors a cohort of Israeli young adults serving throughout the community, cultivates partnerships with schools and organizations, engages host families and lay leaders, and creates meaningful opportunities for connection between Baltimore and Israel.
The successful candidate will be passionate about Israel, Jewish communal life, leadership development, and the power of personal relationships.

What You'll Do
Lead and Support the Shinshinim Cohort

Mentor and support a cohort of Israeli young adults, fostering their personal growth, leadership development, and success throughout the year.
Create meaningful learning, professional development, and community engagement experiences.
Serve as a trusted coach and advocate, helping participants navigate challenges and maximize their impact.

Advance Israel Engagement

Strengthen connections between Baltimore and Israel through educational programs, cultural experiences, and community initiatives.
Collaborate with educators, clergy, professionals, and lay leaders to expand meaningful opportunities for Israel engagement.

Build Community Partnerships

Cultivate strong relationships with schools, synagogues, camps, and community organizations.
Partner with community stakeholders to enhance the reach, impact, and effectiveness of Shinshinim programming.
Serve as a trusted resource and connector across the community.

Engage Host Families and Lay Leaders

Recruit, support, and engage host families, volunteers, alumni, and community advocates.
Staff and partner with the Shinshinim Lay Leadership Committee to support program vision, strategy, and success.

Provide Strategic Leadership

Oversee all aspects of program planning, implementation, budgeting, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
Manage key partnerships with the Jewish Agency for Israel (JAFI), the Baltimore-Ashkelon Partnership, and other stakeholders.
Measure and communicate program impact while identifying opportunities for growth, innovation, and expanded community engagement.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required.
Five or more years of experience in Jewish communal service, education, nonprofit leadership, youth engagement, Israel engagement, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience supervising, mentoring, and developing young adults.
Outstanding relationship-building, communication, and facilitation skills.
Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to navigate complex stakeholder relationships with professionalism and diplomacy.
Passion for Jewish communal life, Israel, and leadership development.

Preferred Qualifications

Hebrew language proficiency.
Experience living, studying, or working in Israel.
Experience in Jewish education, camps, youth movements, Hillel, synagogue, or community-based organizations.
Experience managing budgets, grants, and partnerships.

About Jewish Educational Services
Jewish Educational Services (JES), an agency of The Associated Jewish Federation of Baltimore, promotes and strengthens Jewish education in Baltimore by supporting families, educators, schools, and community institutions.
