title: Senior Product Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer based in Brazil.

This is a senior product design opportunity focused on shaping AI-powered experiences for millions of musicians worldwide.
You will design across Web, Desktop, TV, Mobile, and plugins, creating a cohesive ecosystem for learning, practicing, rehearsing, and music production.
The role combines strong product thinking, systems thinking, research, interaction design, and exceptional visual and interaction craft.
You will turn complex AI and audio capabilities into intuitive experiences that feel powerful without feeling complicated.
Working closely with Product, Engineering, AI, Data, and Marketing, you will help define problems, validate ideas, and ship meaningful value quickly.
The environment is highly collaborative, distributed, and action-oriented, with significant autonomy and low ceremony.
This role is especially suited to a designer who actively produces music and deeply understands professional audio workflows, DAWs, and plugins.

Accountabilities:

  • Design experiences across Web, Desktop, TV, and Mobile, maintaining consistency and coherence as musicians move between platforms.
  • Create products and workflows that support musicians and producers in practicing, learning, rehearsing, writing, recording, and producing music.
  • Translate complex AI and audio capabilities into simple, intuitive, and immediately understandable user experiences.
  • Conduct and synthesize research with musicians across different skill levels and use cases, turning insights into actionable product direction.
  • Contribute to and evolve the design system, ensuring scalable and consistent experiences across multiple platforms.
  • Move rapidly from early concepts and sketches to high-fidelity and coded prototypes, using interaction and motion to resolve design questions when needed.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, AI, Data, Marketing, and senior leadership to align priorities, communicate design rationale, and deliver features efficiently.
  • Navigate different levels of the organization, from user conversations and engineering collaboration to executive-level presentations and strategic product discussions.
  • Give and receive direct, specific design critique that raises the quality and consistency of the overall product experience.
  • Balance simplicity, scalability, technical feasibility, and user value when making product and design decisions.
  • Contribute to a culture of ownership, experimentation, continuous improvement, and daily delivery of meaningful user value.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of experience designing complex software products that are used regularly by real customers, supported by a strong portfolio demonstrating the ability to make powerful technology feel simple.
    • Deep, hands-on experience producing music using professional tools, with a genuine understanding of creative workflows from personal experience.
    • Strong fluency with DAWs and VST/AU plugins, including knowledge of professional audio workflows such as recording, MIDI, mixing, routing, and signal flow.
    • Experience designing or building music instruments, effects, plugins, or related creative software is a strong advantage.
    • Experience designing AI-native products or working with the unique UX challenges associated with probabilistic systems.
    • Ability to move quickly between design fidelities, from rough sketches to interactive and coded prototypes, including motion and interaction animation when appropriate.
    • Comfort working in ambiguous, zero-to-one environments where problems, specifications, design systems, or established playbooks may not yet exist.
    • Strong mastery of interaction design patterns, with the ability to select appropriate patterns, adapt them across platforms, or create new patterns when necessary.
    • Ability to maintain coherent experiences across Web, Desktop, TV, and Mobile.
    • Strong written communication skills and the ability to clearly explain the reasoning behind design decisions.
    • Proven ability to conduct user research independently and translate customer observations into product decisions rather than simply design deliverables.
    • Experience using code-based prototyping as a regular part of the design process.
    • Familiarity with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.
    • High degree of autonomy, curiosity, ownership, and comfort making thoughtful trade-offs in fast-moving environments.
    • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to communicate effectively across technical, product, and creative disciplines.
    • Ability to work effectively in distributed, cross-time-zone teams where written communication and asynchronous decision-making are essential.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Develop and maintain LoRaWAN module AT command firmware across multiple hardware variants
Own the LoRaWAN MAC layer library — Class A/B/C operation, multicast, FOTA, ADR, regional parameter compliance
Implement and validate LoRaWAN specification compliance including Class B beacon timing, ping-slot scheduling, and multicast
Port and maintain Zephyr RTOS board support packages including board definitions, device drivers, and subsystem integration
Develop custom LoRaWAN sensor applications using Mbed OS and Zephyr RTOS for customer-specific deployments
Bring up and validate new hardware variants and component changes across the product line
Design and execute comprehensive host-based test suites using CppUTest and Zephyr Twister
Maintain bootloaders and FOTA update infrastructure for secure field updates
Optimize power consumption for battery-operated devices targeting ultra-low-power sleep modes
Support LoRa Alliance technical working group contributions (L2 protocol, payload schema)

title: Senior Architect (Major Aviation Infrastructure)
description:
Position Summary

WW+P is seeking a Senior Architect to join our Toronto Studio and support the delivery of a major aviation infrastructure project.

The successful candidate will possess strong technical expertise, advanced Revit proficiency, and significant experience developing and leading architectural design and construction documentation packages from Schematic Design through Issued for Construction (IFC). Working under the direction of a Project Manager and Technical Lead, the Senior Architect will be responsible for coordinating architectural deliverables, leading production teams, managing technical design development, and supporting multidisciplinary project coordination in a complex airport environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of architectural design and technical documentation from Schematic Design (SD) through Design Development (DD), Construction Documents (CD), and Issued for Construction (IFC).
  • Produce, coordinate, and review complex architectural drawing packages using Revit.
  • Develop technical solutions that satisfy project requirements, code compliance, operational constraints, and constructability considerations.
  • Coordinate architectural design and documentation with structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, baggage handling, security, and specialty consultants.
  • Participate in design reviews, interdisciplinary coordination meetings, and stakeholder workshops.
  • Review consultant drawings and models to identify conflicts and resolve coordination issues.
  • Support quality assurance and quality control reviews at key project milestones.
  • Assist in responding to RFIs, reviewing shop drawings, and supporting construction administration activities.
  • Mentor intermediate and junior architects, technologists and BIM staff.
  • Support project planning, work-sharing, and production scheduling to meet project milestones and deadlines.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, accessibility requirements, airport standards, and project-specific design criteria.

Key Outcomes

  • Leads the production of coordinated, high-quality architectural deliverables.
  • Maintains model integrity and drawing quality across all project phases.
  • Supports successful delivery of major airport infrastructure projects within schedule and quality expectations.
  • Serves as a trusted technical resource for project teams and clients.
  • Professional degree in Architecture from an accredited institution.
  • Licensed Architect (OAA) or eligible for registration in Ontario is considered an asset.
  • Minimum 10-15 years of professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering projects from SD through IFC documentation.
  • Extensive experience preparing and coordinating construction documents for large, complex projects.
  • Advanced proficiency in Revit is required.
  • Strong understanding of BIM workflows, model management, and interdisciplinary coordination.
  • Thorough knowledge of the Ontario Building Code, National Building Code, accessibility requirements, and industry standards.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary consultant teams.
  • Construction Administration experience is considered an asset.
  • Aviation, transportation, healthcare, institutional, or large public infrastructure experience is preferred.

Core Competencies

  • Strong technical and construction documentation skills.
  • Advanced Revit and BIM proficiency.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and quality management.
  • Strong organizational and coordination skills.
  • Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across large multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proactive problem solver with sound technical judgment.
  • Ability to balance design intent, schedule requirements, and constructability considerations.
  • Self-motivated, accountable, and adaptable in a fast-paced project environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Aviation, transit, or other operationally complex infrastructure projects.
  • Progressive Design-Build (PDB), Design-Build, P3 or other alternative delivery models.
  • Large-scale renovation, expansion, or phased construction projects.
  • Projects requiring continued operations during construction.
  • Experience coordinating highly serviced and technically complex facilities.

WW+P offers a competitive salary and benefits package, including:

  • Full Health and Dental benefits, including a $1000 Health and Wellness Spending Account.
  • Parental Leave top-up of 75% for 13 weeks*
  • A generous Professional Development Allowance of $1500, as well as covering licensing fees.
  • A Group Retirement Savings Plan with a matching component.
  • A generous amount of vacation, sick and personal time, as well as a studio-wide closure over the holidays in December.
  • Flexible work hours; and
  • Engaging and fun social events, with opportunities to participate throughout the year including ski days, holiday parties, weekly forums, design work shops and more!

*after 6 months of service

The salary range for this role is $100,000 to $120,000 commensurate based on experience and level.

How do I apply?

Candidates may apply through our HR platform.

As an employer committed to employment equity, WW+P encourages applications from members of equity-seeking communities, including women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities/expressions. We encourage members of equity-seeking groups to self-identify within the cover letter in their application.

If you require any form of accommodation during the application process, please let us know how we can assist.

title: Coordinator, East D-Camps (13-Month Contract)
description:
About Us
Our vision at Diabetes Canada is a world free from the effects of diabetes. That’s why we work together to improve the lives of those living with diabetes – sharing knowledge and resources, supporting health-care professionals to improve patient care, advocating for change through policy, and funding research to advance treatments and discover a cure.

Living with diabetes is a complex and often relentless journey, testing the resilience of every individual affected. Diabetes Canada is here to help—providing tools, resources, and support to make that journey easier.

Join us in leading with strength and compassion - so no one faces diabetes alone.
About the Role

We’re seeking a Coordinator, D-Camps to support our Mission Team and our Diabetes Camp program. The Coordinator will be responsible for providing leadership to the summer camp programs and year-round program operations and ensures that program delivery is in alignment with the guiding principles of the D-Camps National Guidelines and any relevant provincial camping association standards.

This position is responsible for all program areas of camp and directly supports the seasonal leadership team during program operations by developing quality programs, purchasing, contributing to the hiring of all seasonal staff, and facilitating inter-departmental cooperation to ensure a successful D-Camps program experience.

Contract Duration: 13-Months

Location: Our National Office is located at 1000–170 University Avenue, Toronto, Ontario. For this role we have a flexible work arrangement policy in place allowing the individual to work from home during the non-camp programming season. During the camp season this role is required to be on-site at all scheduled camp program locations they are responsible for.

Compensation: The hiring salary range for this role is $75,000–$80,000 annually, commensurate with experience and alignment with the requirements of the position.

What You’ll Do

Coordinates, plans and implements D-Camps programs (including but not limited to digital events, summer camp, leadership development programs, family camps, weekend events, Diabetes Canada events, and alumni events) in accordance with program plans, as established and scheduled by the Sr Manager, D-Camps.
Coordinates, plans, and implements D-Camps programs and responsible for the representation and promotion of Atlantic D-Camps to the local, provincial, and relevant camping communities.
Functions as Program Lead for all assigned year-round programs with responsibility for the supervision and evaluation of program staff at these programs, supervising the hiring, on-boarding and payroll for staff and volunteers in accordance with DC’s policies and procedure.
Engages in operational planning and collaborates with others to ensure high standards of service and program delivery
Working in partnership with all D-Camps staff and volunteers to ensure alignment with D-Camps national guidelines and provincial camping association standards
Exploring opportunities and innovative practices to realign the existing area camping and youth programs, targeting best practices and ensuring efficient use of resources.
Ensures the culture and community at camp is focused on a positive experience for all campers, staff, and volunteers; cultivates relationships with alumni and camp families responding to guardian and participant survey results and suggesting appropriate changes each season based on feedback.
Manage the contract relationship with third-party providers who support program operations (i.e. facility rentals, food service providers, transportation providers, etc.)
Ensures that all requirements for peer reviews, audits and Ministry requirements are met through staff training, program setup, surveys, and staff management as well as ensuring all health and safety, risk management plans and all audit requirements are met.
Manage inventories of equipment and supplies.
Oversee and coordinate all communications with camper families, staff, and volunteers; coordinating efforts of the camp program applications and registration software (CampBrain)
With support and guidance from the Sr. Manager, D-Camps, ensure that all program related expenses are in line with the budget requirements and adaptations are made throughout the season to remain on budget.
Support with the communication, marketing, and social media initiatives, including the D-Camps social media platforms and the collection of photos, videos, and/or other materials to support camp initiatives
Understand the legal responsibility and oral imperative to recognize and report suspected child abuse to the Children’s Aid Society.
Participate in training, and train or ensure training is provided to employees, contractors & volunteers on safe job procedures, safety policies and procedures, reporting requirements and emergency procedure protocols.
Other duties as assigned.

Note: This role is not limited to the responsibilities listed above and may include other duties as required.

Team Leadership
This role currently provides leadership and oversight to camp instructors and camp volunteers.

What You Bring

Undergraduate degree or diploma in relevant discipline
3-5+ yrs. camp experience with both staff and volunteer supervision and management expertise
Direct experience working with children or youth
Direct experience working with children, youth, or families living with Type 1 Diabetes an asset
Standard First Aid
Well-developed interpersonal and relationship building skills; ability to establish rapport and excellent communication with members, volunteers and staff
Demonstrated strong leadership skills developed through progressively responsible experience in a supervisory role; ability to encourage, motivate staff and volunteers, acknowledge and appreciate contributions; takes the opportunity to be involved in partnerships and collaborations
Commitment to fostering a positive, inclusive, and collaborative work environment
Responsive to needs of stakeholders
Proven ability to work constructively as a team member in a complex organizational setting
Commitment to fostering a positive, inclusive, and collaborative work environment.
Demonstrates an understanding of and commitment to Diabetes Canada’s mission, vision, and core values.

Working Conditions:

Occasional evening and weekend work
The role is expected to travel and be on-site during camp seasons
Candidate must have a valid driver's license and vehicle

Why Join Us?
At Diabetes Canada, you’ll play a meaningful role in making a difference every day for people living with or at risk of diabetes. We’re a national organization with an entrepreneurial spirit, where your contributions are valued, recognized, and rewarded.

What We Offer:

Impactful Work Environment: Be part of a high-performing, collaborative team committed to building a healthy, engaged, and mission-driven workplace culture.
Flexibility: Enjoy the benefits of a flexible work agreement that supports remote and hybrid schedules.
Comprehensive Benefits: Receive competitive compensation plus a group benefits package, including health and dental coverage.
Wellness Support: Access to a mental wellness app with guided meditations and self-paced learning to support your overall well‑being.
Enhanced Time Off: Enjoy additional paid holidays beyond provincial statutory holidays, as well as a paid office closure at the end of each year.
Employee Engagement & Recognition: Be part of a culture that celebrates contributions at all levels through our rewards and recognition platform (WorkTango), enabling peer-to-peer, team, and manager-to-employee appreciation.
Inclusive Culture: Join an organization that celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive environment where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive.

Our Core Values:
ACE-IT: Agility, Collaboration, Excellence, Integrity, Taking Initiative
These values guide how we work together, support our communities, and advance our mission every day.

About the Application Process
If you are already on Diabetes Canada’s job posting site, click on the “Apply” button found at the top-left of this screen. You will be required to complete a very brief questionnaire and submit your résumé and cover letter. If you are not on DC’s job posting site, go to the webpage: https://www.diabetes.ca/careers and click on “View Job Openings”.

If you experience any issues with the application process, please contact us at: dchr@diabetes.ca

Additional Information

You must be legally eligible to work in Canada. Where applicable, you must hold a valid work permit or study permit that allows you to fulfill the requirements of this role.
Diabetes Canada welcomes applications from all qualified individuals, including people of all genders, Indigenous Peoples, persons with disabilities, and members of visible minorities. We value a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve.
We are committed to providing accommodations during the recruitment process. If you require any support or adjustments, please let us know.
We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
Please note that this posting is to fill an existing vacancy at Diabetes Canada.

title: Supervisor(a) de Montagem BOPe
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Supervisor(a) de Montagem BOPe based in Brazil.

This role is responsible for supervising the assembly and installation of electrical Balance of Plant (BOPe) systems across hydroelectric power plant projects.
You will coordinate field activities to ensure projects meet contractual requirements, technical standards, quality expectations, and planned timelines.
Working closely with site and construction management, you will help organize manpower, tools, equipment, and other resources needed for successful execution.
The position combines hands-on technical supervision with strong coordination of contractors and project stakeholders.
Safety, technical documentation, quality control, and continuous performance improvement will be central to your day-to-day responsibilities.
You will also contribute to customer training, technical support, and the sharing of lessons learned to strengthen future project execution.
The role offers a dynamic environment with frequent travel to national and international project locations.

Accountabilities:

  • Supervise the assembly and installation of electrical Balance of Plant (BOPe) systems in hydroelectric power plants and small hydroelectric power plants (UHEs and PCHs), ensuring compliance with schedules, contractual requirements, technical standards, and quality expectations.
  • Collaborate with site and construction managers to plan activities sequentially and ensure the availability of qualified manpower, tools, equipment, and other required resources.
  • Monitor the competence and performance of contractors and third parties, ensuring execution strictly follows established procedures, technical specifications, and quality guidelines.
  • Ensure all field activities comply with applicable safety standards and local regulations, protecting personnel, equipment, and project assets.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date technical drawings and documentation, issuing non-conformance reports (NCRs) when required and coordinating technical solutions with engineering teams.
  • Deliver training to customer teams on system operation and provide ongoing technical support during and after the assembly process.
  • Analyze field processes and share lessons learned with engineering and project teams to improve efficiency, quality, and execution on future projects.

    • Requirements

    • Completed technical education in Mechanical, Electrical, Electrotechnical Engineering, or a related field.
    • Previous experience as a BOPe assembly supervisor in hydroelectric power plant projects.
    • Strong technical understanding of assembly and installation activities within hydroelectric generation environments.
    • Ability to supervise contractors, coordinate field teams, and ensure compliance with technical, quality, and safety requirements.
    • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with site management, construction teams, contractors, customers, and engineering functions.
    • Intermediate Spanish proficiency.
    • Intermediate English proficiency is considered an advantage.
    • Willingness and availability to travel frequently, including to national and international project locations.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time remote position with project-based field activities.
      • Opportunity to work on hydroelectric power generation projects in dynamic project environments.
      • Exposure to national and international project locations and multidisciplinary teams.
      • Technical and customer-facing responsibilities with opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
      • Relocation assistance is not provided.

title: Superintendent - Temporary
description:
Summary
Balfour Beatty Construction is seeking a Superintendent to join our team in Scottsdale, AZ, on a temporary basis. Experience with tenant improvements, interiors and similar work is preferred. This individual will focus on JOC work in the Phoenix market involving interiors and tenant renovations. Occasional after-hours work will be required, so this individual needs to be willing to work nights and/or weekends as needed.
The Superintendent manages designated field activities associated with the project and supervises designated field construction work by subcontractors and employees. The Superintendent assists the project team to ensure the project is built on time, within budget, and in accordance with Balfour Beatty Construction’s policies and procedures and the focus on our vision and purpose through Service, Talent and Choices.
Essential Functions
Project Financial Responsibilities

Reviews and updates progress and cost reports, schedules, and requirements for completion on a regular basis to support and assist the Project Manager/Senior Superintendent.

Preconstruction Services

Participates in preconstruction planning, when possible, regarding the project schedule and budget. Reviews project estimates and cost control system at the beginning of the project.

Project Start-up and Scheduling

Understands project specifications, the contract, and the contract’s general conditions, and confirms that all materials and subcontract work comply with contract documents and quality specifications.
Ensures all materials are properly tested according to specifications, and ensures all test results are properly recorded.

Project Administration, Operations and Close-out

Directs and coordinates subcontractor and Balfour Beatty Construction field personnel in designated areas of expertise.
Assists the Senior Superintendent in communicating a consistent level of expectations and direction with subcontractors and employees, regarding schedules, construction methods, company policies and procedures, permits, safety, quality control and other performance standards.
Collaborates with Senior Superintendent to ensure project site and company assets are secure, and maintains a safe and respectful working environment at all times by implementing safety, EEO, risk management, training, and quality control programs.
Attends weekly project progress meetings with all subcontractor representatives and understands the upcoming week’s work to be accomplished.
Assists Senior Superintendent in ensuring the project closeout process is finalized to settle all financial obligations, demobilize all resources, and transition the project to the customer.

Promote Customer Relations

Builds effective relationships with customers, design team, subcontractors, suppliers, and user groups that reflect and support company core values and meets or exceeds the customer’s expectations.

Culture, Leadership and Employee Development

Promotes the Creed. Communicates vision and purpose through Service, Talent, and Choices.
Serves as a role model and promotes professional behavior.
Participates in personal career development by attending operations training programs and takes direct accountability for training and developing direct reports.
Supports community, client and subcontractor relations and events to enhance the company’s image and build relationships.
Builds and stretches people and self by providing challenging assignments, achievable and motivational development plans, and ongoing actionable and candid feedback that help employees achieve career goals.
Acts in a manner of integrity that shows support for the company, its values, and the employees, while maintaining constant focus on meeting or exceeding customer requirements and expectations.

Perform other related duties as needed.
Working Conditions

The majority of work is completed on job sites in an office trailer or in an existing structure. Due to daily condition changes on construction projects, when employees are outside of the office trailer or structure, they must wear appropriate personal protective equipment as required by the company's safety policies and as required for weather conditions.
The project team and/or team member may need to move to other projected work geographic locations, if necessary.
This position involves working nights and weekends, along with the possibility of overnight travel for weeks at a time.

Education, Experience and Knowledge

B.S. in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field is preferred.
4 to 7 years of experience with at least 3 of those years in a Superintendent role.
Makes decisions under tight deadlines.
Organizes people, tools, and equipment and plan/manage multiple activities to accomplish desired results.
Exhibits commitment to quality by evaluating project-related processes and making necessary changes, using customer input to make improvements, and meeting or exceeding internal and external customer expectations.
Demonstrates proficiency using a personal computer (PC) and company communication tools, such as email, internet, and Microsoft products (e.g., Word, Excel, Office, Outlook).

Preferred Experience

Tenant improvements, interiors and similar work.

title: Physical Therapist (PT) – Mobile/Home-Based Care
description:
Overview

We are seeking a skilled, compassionate, and dependable Physical Therapist (PT) to provide high-quality physical therapy services to patients in their homes throughout the S. Los Angeles region.

The Physical Therapist will travel to patients' homes to perform comprehensive evaluations, develop individualized plans of care, provide skilled therapeutic interventions, monitor patient progress, and educate patients and caregivers on strategies to improve mobility, function, safety, and independence.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in a home-based environment, has strong clinical judgment and communication skills, and is passionate about delivering patient-centered care.

This is a 1099 independent contractor position.

Duties and Responsibilities

· Travel to patients' homes throughout the assigned service area to provide physical therapy services.

· Perform comprehensive physical therapy evaluations in the patient's home environment.

· Assess strength, range of motion, balance, gait, mobility, coordination, endurance, pain, functional limitations, and ability to safely perform activities of daily living.

· Evaluate the patient's home environment and identify potential safety and fall risks that may impact mobility and independence.

· Develop individualized plans of care based on evaluation findings, physician orders/referrals, patient needs, clinical judgment, and functional goals.

· Establish measurable short-term and long-term functional goals.

· Provide skilled physical therapy interventions appropriate to the patient's diagnosis and functional limitations, including:

o Therapeutic exercises

o Therapeutic activities

o Neuromuscular re-education

o Gait and mobility training

o Balance and coordination training

o Functional strengthening

o Manual therapy when clinically appropriate

o Transfer training

o Fall prevention and safety training

· Train patients in the safe use of assistive devices such as walkers, canes, and other mobility equipment.

· Develop and instruct patients in individualized home exercise programs.

· Educate patients and caregivers regarding diagnosis, treatment, exercises, mobility, safety, fall prevention, and strategies to promote independence.

· Monitor patient response to treatment and make appropriate clinical modifications to the plan of care.

· Perform reassessments and communicate changes in patient condition or functional status as appropriate.

· Coordinate care with physicians, nurses, caregivers, physical therapist assistants, occupational therapists, and other healthcare professionals.

· Communicate effectively with referring providers regarding patient progress, concerns, and recommendations.

· Complete accurate, timely, and thorough documentation for evaluations, daily treatment visits, reassessments, progress reports, and discharge summaries.

· Maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations, professional standards, payer requirements, and company policies.

· Recognize changes in patient condition that may require physician notification, additional medical evaluation, or modification of treatment.

· Maintain patient confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries at all times.

· Provide compassionate, respectful, and professional care to patients and their families in the home setting.

Requirements

· Current and valid California Physical Therapist license in good standing.

· Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program.

· Strong knowledge of anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, biomechanics, and rehabilitation principles.

· Strong clinical reasoning and patient assessment skills.

· Ability to independently perform comprehensive PT evaluations and develop appropriate plans of care.

· Experience treating patients with orthopedic, musculoskeletal, neurological, balance, gait, weakness, mobility, and/or functional limitations preferred.

· Strong knowledge of therapeutic exercise, gait training, balance training, functional mobility, neuromuscular re-education, and fall prevention.

· Excellent patient assessment and acute/chronic pain management skills.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work independently and effectively manage a mobile patient caseload.

· Must be punctual, dependable, organized, and professional.

· Comfortable entering and providing care in patients' homes and working with patients and caregivers in a home-based environment.

· Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.

· Ability to travel throughout the assigned service area.

· CPR/BLS certification preferred or required according to company policy.

· Previous home health, mobile therapy, outpatient, orthopedic, neurological, geriatric, or community-based experience is preferred.

Mobile/Home-Based Care Expectations

Because this position involves providing care in patients' homes, the Physical Therapist must be able to:

· Arrive at scheduled visits within the expected timeframe.

· Manage travel time and maintain an efficient daily schedule.

· Carry and transport necessary clinical equipment and supplies.

· Adapt treatment approaches to different home environments and available space.

· Maintain a safe and professional environment during every patient visit.

· Communicate promptly regarding cancellations, scheduling changes, or patient concerns.

· Respect patients' homes, privacy, routines, and individual preferences.

· Demonstrate sound clinical judgment when working independently in the community.

Documentation and Compliance

The Physical Therapist is responsible for completing all required clinical documentation accurately and within established timeframes, including:

· Initial evaluations

· Treatment notes

· Reassessments

· Progress reports

· Recertifications, when applicable

· Discharge documentation

· Home exercise programs

· Communication with referring providers

· Other documentation required by the organization, payer, or applicable regulations

Job Type

Full-time – 1099 Independent Contractor

Pay Structure (1099)

· Guaranteed base pay: $1,080 per week

· Base compensation is calculated at $45 per patient visit, based on a minimum of 6 patient visits per day.

· $45 per additional patient visit for visits beyond the daily base of 6.

· Compensation is subject to the terms of the independent contractor agreement.

Schedule

4/10 Schedule

· Four 10-hour workdays per week

· Typical start time: 7:30 AM–8:30 AM, depending on patient scheduling and geographic coverage.

· Daily schedule may vary based on patient locations, visit duration, and patient needs.

Work Location

Mobile/Home-Based – S. Los Angeles Region

The Physical Therapist will travel to assigned patients' homes throughout the designated service area.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a clinically confident, compassionate, and self-motivated Physical Therapist who enjoys working one-on-one with patients and families. The successful candidate will be comfortable making clinical decisions independently, adapting treatment to the patient's home environment, and providing high-quality care while maintaining excellent documentation and communication.

This position is an excellent opportunity for a Physical Therapist who values autonomy, flexibility, meaningful patient relationships, and community-based care

title: MKE Security Officer
description:
Position Definition

Covenant Aviation Security (CAS) is seeking professional Security Officers to support airport security operations at Milwaukee-Mitchell International Airport (MKE). Security Officers play a critical role in maintaining a safe and secure environment by controlling access to restricted areas, verifying credentials, conducting inspections, monitoring activity, and enforcing security procedures in accordance with airport regulations and company policies. This position serves as a visible security presence and requires individuals who demonstrate professionalism, vigilance, strong customer service skills, and a commitment to safety and security.

Company History

Founded in 2002, Covenant Aviation Security (CAS) was established to provide a higher standard of transportation security following the events of September 11, 2001. CAS pioneered a customer-focused security model built on a highly trained, professional workforce supported by competitive wages, benefits, and ongoing development.
Today, CAS is the largest private contractor providing Screening Partnership Program (SPP) services to the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) and an industry leader in aviation security solutions. Through its commitment to safety, compliance, operational excellence, and customer service, CAS provides comprehensive security and screening services for airports, airlines, and government agencies across the United States.

Employment Compensation & Benefits

Covenant Aviation Security offers a competitive compensation package, with a starting hourly rate of $21.00 per hour.

In addition, employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support their health, well-being, and financial security, including:

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (effective the first day of the month following sixty (60) days of continuous employment)
401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Matching Contributions
Paid Time Off (PTO)
Company-Paid Life Insurance
Voluntary Supplemental Life Insurance
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
Company-Furnished Uniforms (where applicable)

Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and plan provisions and may be modified at the Company's discretion.

Schedule & Hours

6:00 AM to 2:00 PM- Saturday & Sunday
or
2:00 PM to 10:00 PM- Saturday and Sunday

Essential Functions

Appear on post on time per the assigned schedule, fit for duty, and in the required uniform.
Maintain a professional presence, vigilance, and situational awareness at all times.
Control access to designated airport facilities, secured areas, and restricted locations.
Verify identification credentials, badges, and access authorizations in accordance with established procedures.
Inspect persons, property, deliveries, and vehicles as required by post orders and security protocols.
Monitor activity within assigned areas and report unusual, suspicious, or unauthorized activity.
Conduct post inspections, equipment inspections, and review pass-down information to maintain operational awareness.
Prepare accurate daily activity logs, reports, incident reports, and other required documentation.
Respond appropriately to incidents, emergencies, and security concerns and notify supervisors as required.
Provide exceptional customer service while interacting with airport employees, contractors, visitors, and the traveling public.
Maintain knowledge of all applicable post orders, directives, procedures, and operational requirements.
Perform vehicle inspections in accordance with post orders and security procedures.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

High School Diploma or GED.
Minimum of eighteen (18) years of age.
Minimum of one (1) year of security, military, law enforcement, airport operations, or related experience.
Possess a valid Unarmed Private Security Permit issued by the Wisconsin Department of Safety and Professional Services (DSPS).
Ability to obtain and maintain all required airport credentials, badges, and access privileges.
Ability to comply with airport and company appearance standards. Visible facial and body piercings are prohibited while in uniform. Tattoos on the head, face, and exposed areas of the neck must be covered at all times. Obscene, gang-related, ethnic or racially derogatory, or otherwise inappropriate visible tattoos are prohibited.
Demonstrate proficiency in speaking, reading, writing, and understanding English, with the ability to effectively communicate verbally and in writing, follow written and verbal instructions, provide professional customer service, and complete computer-based reports and required documentation.
Ability to learn and apply security procedures, post orders, and operational requirements.
Ability to successfully complete all required training and assessments.
Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in access control, screening, patrol, or security operations.
One (1) or more years of experience performing vehicle and property search activities in a security, military, law enforcement, airport, or related environment.
Experience preparing incident reports and maintaining security documentation.
Experience working in a fast-paced public environment.

Competencies

Customer Service Orientation
Professionalism
Attention to Detail
Situational Awareness
Communication Skills
Integrity
Teamwork
Adaptability
Problem Solving

Accountability

Physical Demands

May require standing, sitting, walking for various, possibly extended periods of time.
Must be able to bend, stoop, and kneel while conducting vehicle inspections and other required search activities.
Conduct physical inspections of personal property in accordance with TSA regulations.
Operate X-ray equipment, Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) equipment, and other approved screening technology.
May be required to climb inside and bend under vehicles for vehicle inspections (example, construction dump trucks, etc.).
Physically, mentally, and emotionally capable of performing all duties required for their assigned post/duties.
Capable of performing normal or emergency duties requiring moderate to arduous physical exertion, such as standing or walking/ patrolling for entire shift(s), climbing stairs, running and self-defense.

May be required to lift, carry, push, or pull objects weighing up to 50 pounds.
Must be able to safely work in outdoor environments for extended periods of time while exposed to varying weather conditions.
Be able to perform the duties of their position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Work Environment

Work is performed in both indoor and outdoor airport environments. Security Officers are routinely assigned to exterior access control points, interior access control points, and vehicle gates.
Employees are responsible for monitoring, screening, and searching personnel, vehicles, deliveries, and other property accessing the airfield and restricted areas of the airport. Duties may require prolonged exposure to outdoor conditions, including extreme temperatures, snow, ice, wind, rain, direct sunlight, and other weather conditions common to Wisconsin.
Guards may work in close proximity to vehicle traffic, aircraft activity, and other operational airport environments. Employees must remain alert, professional, and capable of performing assigned duties safely and effectively in all environmental conditions.

title: Executive Program Director (RTC/OP)
description:
Position Summary:
The Executive Director is responsible for the supervision and management of the treatment program they work directly out of as Program Director in addition to oversite of additional Program Directors/Administrators and sites. The Executive Director supervises anywhere from 3-6 programs overall. This is RTC and OP programs. This includes oversite of all facilities functions, staff, and patients.

Essential Job Functions:

Oversees and ensures quality of all aspects of the three to 6 programs they manage and takes initiative to make improvements.
Conducts separate weekly treatment team meetings at each location to ensure consistent and effective communication, including proper oversight of patient progress and to ensures a team approach is being utilized.
Communicates with referral sources and outpatient providers for continuity of care upon admission, midpoint, and discharge.
Facilitates patient transfers to higher level of care, as needed.
Participates in clinical outreach and facilitates program tours as needed.
Provides on-call support to facility and communicates with the On-Call Administrator as needed.

title: Navigate Sales Engineer
description:
Job Summary:
The Sales Engineer is a core member of the go-to-market team, serving as a trusted technical and strategic partner to prospects, customers, and internal stakeholders. The Sales Engineer partners with the Sales team to drive the sale of core mPulse portal solutions. The Sales Engineer serves as the critical bridge between buyer needs and complex solutions, combining product expertise with strong communications skills to establish technical fit. Collaboration is essential to ensure proposed solutions align with product capabilities and market demands. By demonstrating how Navigate provides a single, integrated portal suite that brings together members, providers, employers, brokers, and plans, the Sales Engineer helps advance opportunities toward successful close.

Work with the Sales Executive throughout the sales cycle from discovery through opportunity closure in support of sales productivity.
Participate in client meetings as needed both virtually and in-person.
Bring subject matter expertise to sales opportunities by staying current on product, technology, and market changes that may impact customer buying decisions.
Contribute to deal strategy discussions and internal opportunity reviews to promote successful outcomes.
Speak the language of the buyer by adapting communication and delivery to varying stakeholder groups, clearly connecting needs/problems to the capabilities of the product.
Own the readiness of demo environments and deliver tailored product demonstrations that align with customer use cases, clearly articulating business value, operational impact, and competitive differentiation.

Support effective handoff to implementation teams.
All other duties as assigned.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse stakeholders at all organizational levels.

Communicate complex ideas in simple, clear, business-focused terms.
Technical competence blended with sales acumen.

Project management and coordination across workstreams and stakeholder groups.
Position solutions competitively and address concerns/questions in real-time to provide immediate clarity.

Collaborative mindset with a focus on advancing sales opportunities.
Process-oriented with ability to identify, recommend, and carry out process changes.

title: IV Therapy Wellness Partner
description:
IV Therapy Wellness Partner
Location
Verona, NJ		Company
IV Nutrition		Employment Type
Part-Time and PRN
Summary
At IV Nutrition, we believe wellness is built through relationships, education, consistency, and personalized support — not simply through a single service or visit.
We are hiring an IV Therapy Wellness Partner to provide exceptional clinical care while building meaningful relationships with clients and helping them understand and stay engaged in their personalized wellness journey.
What You'll Do
Clinical Care & Safety
  • Start IVs and administer IM injections safely and efficiently
  • Monitor clients throughout treatment to ensure comfort and safety
  • Prepare IV drips and manage treatment flow throughout the day
  • Document treatments, client responses, and clinical notes accurately
  • Maintain strict adherence to clinical protocols and safety standards
Client Wellness Journey
  • Get to know each client's wellness goals during every visit, not just their requested service
  • Help clients understand how a given therapy connects to what they're actually trying to achieve
  • Recognize when a client's needs may have changed and flag it to the Clinic Director or Assistant Clinic Director
  • Support continuity by making sure clients understand their next recommended step
Client Education
  • Educate clients on therapies, supplements, and wellness benefits
  • Answer client questions clearly and honestly, without pressure
  • Share your own growing knowledge of wellness, nutrients, and functional health as you learn
Relationship-Based Client Experience
  • Create a welcoming, professional environment for every client
  • Communicate clearly and build trust throughout each visit
  • Address client questions and concerns with professionalism and empathy
  • Build the kind of rapport that turns a first-time visitor into a regular
Protect the Client Journey
  • Maintain accurate documentation so the next team member has full context on a client
  • Support a seamless handoff between shifts and staff members
  • Help ensure no client falls through the cracks between visits
Clinic Operations
  • Track, manage, and restock inventory as needed
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of clinical areas
  • Support scheduling and overall clinic efficiency
Team Partnership
  • Work closely with the Clinic Director and Assistant Clinic Director
  • Support team goals and daily operational priorities
  • Assist with training and onboarding as needed
  • Contribute to a positive, team-focused work environment
Growth & Leadership Development
  • Demonstrate accountability, initiative, and strong work ethic
  • Participate in team meetings, training, and development
  • Take ownership of responsibilities beyond basic role expectations
Qualifications
Licensure & Certification
  • Active, current New Jersey Registered Nurse (RN) license required
  • New Jersey requires RN-level licensure to perform IV therapy and vascular access outside a licensed EMS agency; LPN, Paramedic, and EMT credentials do not qualify for this role in this state
  • IV Therapy Certification
  • CPR/BLS certification
Experience
  • 1+ year of clinical, emergency, or infusion experience preferred
  • Experience in wellness, functional medicine, client education, hospitality, or relationship-based healthcare is a plus
Skills & Attributes
  • Strong IV and injection skills
  • Excellent bedside manner and client-care approach
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Natural ability to build relationships and establish trust
  • Comfortable educating and engaging clients
  • Curious and motivated to continually learn about wellness and the human body
  • High attention to detail and documentation accuracy
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Calm, professional, and solution-oriented under pressure
  • Strong work ethic, reliability, and personal accountability
  • Interest in wellness, preventative care, and functional medicine
Compensation & Benefits
  • Hourly Pay: $34–$39/hour, based on experience
  • Tips and commission opportunities
  • PTO (for team members meeting eligibility requirements)
  • Monthly service allowance plus an employee discount on IV Nutrition services
  • A full breakdown of compensation amounts and eligibility details will be provided as part of your formal offer
Working Conditions
  • Part-time schedule, approximately 16-20 hours per week
  • PRN schedules also available depending on staffing needs
  • 8–10-hour shifts, including some Saturdays and Sundays as needed
  • Clinic environment with frequent and direct client interaction
Is This Role for You?
You Might Be a Perfect Fit If...
  • You're a people person.
Clients feel at ease the moment you walk in. You're warm, curious, and genuinely love getting to know people.
  • You're an IV pro.
You're confident, precise, and calm under pressure — even with tough sticks.
  • You live the wellness lifestyle.
Health and longevity aren't just buzzwords to you — they're things you actually think about and prioritize for yourself.
  • You're detail-oriented.
Accurate charting, thorough assessments, and safety are non-negotiables you take pride in.
  • You're a natural educator.
You love explaining how the body works and helping clients understand what they're putting into it and why.
  • You want the impact to extend beyond the IV.
You want to know why a client is receiving a service, not simply how to administer it, and you find purpose in helping them work toward meaningful goals.
This Role Is Not for You If...
  • You want responsibility to begin and end with starting an IV
  • You view client treatment time as personal downtime
  • You prefer to disengage once the clinical task is complete
  • You're uncomfortable initiating conversations or educating clients
  • You prefer a task-based clinical environment over a relationship-based client experience
Reality Check
Yes, you will start IVs — but starting the IV is only one part of your job.
You are here to become a trusted partner in each client's wellness journey, not simply to administer a treatment and move on.
Clients will vary in difficulty. Some will be anxious. Some will require extra attention. You are responsible for delivering a consistent, high-quality experience every time.

title: Podcast Video Producer - The Lazy CEO
description:
About The Lazy CEO:

Jane Lu is an Australian entrepreneur best known as the founder and CEO of Showpo, a global online fashion brand. The Lazy CEO Podcast, focuses on entrepreneurship, business growth, mindset, and personal development. Jane interviews founders, industry leaders, and experts about how they built successful brands, while also sharing honest insights into leadership, scaling a business, and balancing ambition with life.

The Position:

Jane Lu aka The Lazy CEO is entering a new stage of growth, and YouTube is where that growth lives. We're bringing The Lazy CEO podcast fully in-house, and we want someone who can drive it forward by thinking video-first at every step, not just recording audio with a camera running.

You'll own the guest relationship from first contact through to published episode, produce the show live on recording days, and shoot and produce every episode as YouTube-ready, long-form video. You'll manage distribution and socials across the week, and be the primary point of contact for the iHeart partnership.

We want a YouTube-first creative who can carry the podcast under one consistent, elevated standard of production.

Day to day you will be responsible for:

  • Own guest outreach, scheduling, and all pre-recording communication, keeping the guest pipeline at least 4 weeks ahead at all times.

  • Brief guests ahead of recording, manage logistics for on-site recording days, and act as producer in the room during live recording.

  • Shoot and produce full-length podcast episodes as YouTube-ready, long-form video, thinking video-first at every stage of production.

  • Act as primary editor for every episode, both the full-length video and the audio mix, from raw recording through to a polished, publish-ready final cut.

  • Drive the content calendar for the podcast, including themes, angles, and segment ideas that push the content forward.

  • Review all podcast content for quality, pacing, and brand alignment before it goes anywhere near an audience.

  • Work with the offshore editor to brief, review, and sign off short-form social edits.

Who are you?

  • A portfolio you can share that shows video-first podcast production, alongside a genuine understanding of how long-form content performs on YouTube.

  • Experience in in Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro for long-form video, Audition for podcast audio), with strong sound design, mixing, and colour correction skills.

  • A genuine self-starter who takes ownership without needing to be chased, and is energised rather than overwhelmed by juggling multiple episodes, edits, and deadlines at once.

What's in it for you?

  • Hybrid work environment - 3 days from home and 2 in the office in brand new Waterloo offices!
  • 50% staff discount, monthly staff sample sales, dog-friendly office, plus discounts at places such as Peaches Pilates studios and the cinema!
  • Paid parental leave
  • Showpo paid 24/7 GP access through our Updoc employee healthcare benefit! (Including prescriptions and referrals sent straight to your phone)
  • Enjoy financial advice and discounts through our Commbank Workplace Banking Program We encourage our team to make time for fun - from Games Night and Parties to Friday bubbles and our “I S**t Rainbow” recognition awards
  • Plus: brekkie bar, Showpo Coffee Club, Showpo Wellness Club
    What matters to us - we support The Hunger Project through our donations, staff sample sales, yearly edits and awareness.
  • We were recently the first ever business in Australia to gain our "Endometriosis friendly" workplace accreditation through Endometriosis Australia ensuring we further support our employees health need
Are you the YouTube Podcast Producer we're looking for?! Click apply to find out more...

title: Staff Product Engineer, Enterprise AI
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Product Engineer, Enterprise AI based in Canada.

This is a high-impact product engineering role focused on building an open-source, enterprise-ready AI platform.
You’ll work across the full stack to turn ambiguous product ideas, user needs, and enterprise requirements into shipped capabilities.
The role spans AI-powered chat, search, research, workflow automation, administration, integrations, and enterprise workflows.
You’ll own features from concept and technical planning through launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
You’ll collaborate with product, design, engineering, enterprise-facing teams, and open-source contributors in a globally distributed environment.
The position offers significant autonomy and requires strong judgment across usability, reliability, security, maintainability, and speed.
You’ll also help establish reusable engineering patterns and feedback loops that enable the product to scale effectively.

  • Own complex product features end-to-end, from concept and technical planning through implementation, launch, adoption, and post-launch iteration.
  • Translate product direction, user needs, partner feedback, and enterprise requirements into practical technical plans and complete product experiences.

  • Develop AI-powered capabilities spanning chat, search, research, workflow automation, administration, integrations, and enterprise use cases.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to accelerate implementation while maintaining high standards for security, quality, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Evaluate usage, qualitative feedback, support signals, quality issues, and adoption patterns after launch to guide improvements.
  • Instrument features or collaborate on measurement approaches that provide insight into adoption, reliability, and product value.
  • Identify product gaps, edge cases, technical risks, and opportunities to improve user experiences.
  • Write clear, maintainable, well-tested code and contribute reusable product and engineering patterns that make future development more efficient.
  • Help strengthen an engineering culture centered on ownership, experimentation, quality, user value, and practical execution.

    • Requirements:

    • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial Staff-level ownership, leadership, and impact in production environments.

title: Yarn Reclaim Operative
description:
Job Title: Yarn Reclaim Operative

We are looking for a Yarn Reclaim Operative to join our growing team in Hawick to reclaim, process and prepare yarn for reuse, ensuring accurate identification and availability for production.

This is a full-time permanent position, working 38 hours a week on dayshift.

Rate of pay for this role is £13.45 per hour.

Full training will be provided, but if you have experience in this role or something similar, your expertise will be highly valued and welcomed.

About the Role

You will be:

Reclaiming yarn by winding back faulty garment panels onto bobbins and cones
Transferring yarn from small bobbins to large cones, including splicing yarn where required
Labelling cones accurately with yarn quality, shade, batch and location details
Weighing completed cones and recording information on daily sheets
Storing completed cones in the correct yarn store locations
Twisting yarn to correct twist requirements
Maintaining accurate records and documentation
Lubricating and waxing cones

About you

You will need

Excellent colour vision
High levels of attention to detail
Good concentration to stay focused for long periods of time
Excellent teamwork and communication skills

About Us

Founded in 1797, Johnstons of Elgin is an innovative, luxury clothing brand celebrating 225 years of experience in working with the world’s finest fibres. Across three centuries, our family-owned company has carefully sources cashmere and fine woollen fibres from around the world, applying the latest technology and highest quality craft expertise in our very own vertical Scottish mills. Employing over 1,000 staff, our valued employees and communities are at the heart of everything we do, producing unique, high-quality designs that are made to last. Our brand is focused on sustainability, working with natural, renewable, and biodegradable fibres and we are committed to maintaining a minimal environmental footprint.

Johnstons of Elgin is proud to be an equal opportunity employer wholeheartedly supporting the principles of equality and diversity to build an inclusive workforce. Our aim is to embed diversity and inclusion in everything we do to create an environment where our employees feel safe to be their whole authentic self without having to downplay or change parts of their identity. We celebrate diversity in all its forms, which goes beyond those characteristics protected by law to include everything that makes us unique, from our backgrounds and experiences to our personalities and ways of thinking.

We endeavour to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities and encourage any candidate who requires assistance to contact us at hr@johnstonsofelgin.com.

title: Student Assistant - Digital Content Creation & Storytelling
description:
Do you want to kick-start your career while contributing to fossil freedom?
We're looking for a creative and motivated Student Assistant in Digital Content Creation & Storytelling to help bring the stories of our Digital Engineering teams to life.

We are now looking for a Student Assistant to support the Digital Engineering department within Business Area Wind. In this role, you will help showcase the people, innovations and digital solutions that support renewable energy production across our European markets.

Working closely with engineers, specialists and leaders, you will create engaging content that strengthens communication, knowledge sharing and employee engagement across the organization. From interviews and video production to AI-generated content and creative storytelling, you will help transform complex technical topics into content that is informative, engaging and easy to understand.

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with content creation, video production, storytelling and emerging AI technologies while building a portfolio of meaningful work in an international environment.

You will be based in Kolding, Denmark, and collaborate with colleagues across Denmark, Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won't only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Your role

In this role, you will help strengthen communication, knowledge sharing and engagement across Digital Engineering. You will be responsible for creating compelling content that highlights the work of our teams and supports internal branding initiatives across BA Wind. From developing creative concepts to producing finished content, you will play an active role throughout the entire content creation process.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

  • Developing creative content ideas and storytelling concepts for internal communication channels
  • Planning and producing short-form videos, interviews, photo stories and other engaging content formats
  • Conducting interviews and transforming technical topics into compelling stories
  • Filming and editing content from concept to final delivery
  • Creating AI-generated visuals, videos and other creative assets when traditional filming is not possible
  • Publishing and adapting content for different channels and target audiences
  • Supporting internal campaigns and communication initiatives across the Digital Engineering organization
  • Maintaining a consistent visual identity while following Vattenfall brand guidelines
  • Supporting the planning and management of content calendars and communication activities
  • Exploring new digital tools, trends and content formats to continuously improve engagement

Who are you?

You are a creative and curious student who enjoys combining storytelling, technology and visual communication. You have a passion for content creation and thrive when transforming ideas into engaging formats that capture attention and inspire others.

You enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders, are comfortable working independently, and have a natural ability to identify interesting stories and communicate them in a clear and engaging way. You are eager to learn, willing to experiment with new technologies and excited about working in an international environment where innovation is part of everyday life.

Next to this you bring:

  • Are enrolled in a relevant programme such as Media, Communication, Journalism, Film Production, Marketing or Digital Design, ideally with 2–3 years remaining
  • Have strong storytelling and copywriting skills, with the ability to adapt content for different audiences and digital channels
  • Have experience creating and editing video content using relevant production equipment and tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Camtasia
  • Understand social media and short-form content, have a strong visual eye and can create engaging content in line with brand guidelines
  • Are curious about AI-powered tools and eager to explore new technologies and creative trends
  • Are fluent in English and bring a proactive, structured and self-motivated approach to your work

We look forward to receiving your application!

Location:

Kolding, Denmark

Our offer

Are you looking for more than just a job? Our involvement at every stage of projects means you'll be able to find your element working with the power of wind and solar in a role where your skills and experience will be leveraged to the maximum.

You'll benefit from limitless opportunities to grow in your element through learning and development and to expand your horizons working across our diverse portfolio.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths.

The scale of our ambition means we need to bring together people from many different backgrounds and experiences. You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

We welcome your application in English no later than 30.09.2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Fire Sprinkler Technician
location: Williston, VT, US; VT, US; Burlington, VT, US
description:
Responsible for inspection, service and repair of Wet, Dry, Pre-action, Deluge and Foam systems; Testing, rebuilding and/or replacing Backflow Preventers. Responsible for identifying trouble areas and performing service in an efficient and professional manner to ensure that sprinkler systems are operating properly. We seek a self-motivated, customer service-oriented lead technician. The ideal candidate will be organized, professional, and a good communicator. This important position will establish a rapport and build positive relationships with our customers.
Up to $10,000 sign-on bonus based on experience!
Responsibilities include:
Sprinkler and Backflow Systems Installation, Repair, & Service:

Perform fire sprinkler inspections and services per NFPA and engineering guidelines.
Inspect and service wet, dry, pre-action, deluge and foam systems as needed.
Repair and/or replace all sprinkler systems components.
Repair, replace and rebuild backflow preventers as necessary.
Verify proper communication with monitoring station when working on a monitored system after repair.
Perform system tests to verify alarm & sprinkler systems are working properly upon completion of repair.
Report Deficiencies to Department Manager.

Job, Inventory, and Vehicle Preparation Duties:

Prepare sprinkler pipe, using threader when needed, and stock truck with inventory required to perform the job.
Work efficiently and utilize resources to complete jobs in a timely manner.
Perform basic vehicle maintenance and keep work truck clean and organized.
Manage inventory and tools for each job to assure proper parts and tools are on hand.
Collaborate with general contractors as necessary.
Complete NFPA certification and life safety testing, maintaining current knowledge of NFPA code.

Essential Functions

Perform disassembly, inspection and repair of sprinkler and backflow valves (once receiving license).
Verify proper communication with monitoring station when working on a monitored system after repair.
Perform system tests to verify alarm & sprinkler systems are working properly upon completion of repair.
Perform visual inspection of sprinkler and fire suppression systems checking the systems components from ground level.
Perform inspection of wet, dry, pre-action, deluge and foam systems.
Exercise, turn, and lubricate sprinkler system valves.
Read gauges and record information, noting deficiencies and ensuring pressures are within acceptable levels.
Run main drain tests on all risers.
Perform testing of control valve function.
Trip, observe, and reset Dry Valves.
Test RP, DC, & RVB Backflow system functions and note deficiencies.
Perform water flow testing on sprinkler system.
Prepare sprinkler pipe, using threader when needed, and stock truck with inventory required to perform the job.
Complete NFPA certification and life safety testing, maintaining current knowledge of NFPA code.

Qualifications

High School Diploma or equivalent.
TQP License is required.
Minimum of 2-3 years field experience in Fire Sprinkler Inspections and service.
Must have or be able & willing to attain state Sprinkler and/or Backflow License.
Ability to adhere to, implement, and follow safety guidelines and procedures at all times.
Possess a valid driver’s license and driving record that meets company requirements.
Fire and /or Life Safety Systems experience
Must possess strong written and verbal communication skills.
Must be able to exercise effective time management skills (prioritize, work on a time-line).
Must have a strong mechanical aptitude.
Must be able to visually inspect and service sprinkler and backflow systems.
Must be able to recognize alarm sights and sounds.
Strong working knowledge of NFPA codes.
May (often will) require ability to effectively use a Sprinkler Pipe Threader .
Must be able to effectively use backflow tester, pipe wrench, various lifts and common pipe fitting tools.
Must be able to safely and effectively use general hand tools and power tools\Must be capable of using various Arial lifts and boom trucks.
Must be able to lift and carry a minimum of 75 pounds.
Must be able to push and pull greater than 75 pounds as needed.
Must be able to safely use and climb a ladder and reach a height of at least 24 feet.
Must be able, on a regular basis, work comfortably at a height of greater than 26 feet. (common elevation of systems is 26 feet and higher.)

Preferred Qualifications

3-5 years of proven success in performance of Sprinkler inspection, installation, and service is highly preferred.
NICET Certification in Inspection & Testing of Water-Based Systems and/or Water-Based Systems Layout, preferred.

Monitor inventory levels and help identify potential stock shortages, excess inventory, or demand fluctuations.
Collaborate with sales, marketing, product management, and operations teams to gather information that impacts demand forecasts.
Assist with forecast accuracy tracking and root-cause analysis of forecast variances.
Support data cleansing, master data maintenance, and process improvement initiatives.
Participate in cross-functional meetings and contribute recommendations based on data analysis.
Complete special projects and other duties as assigned.

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Operations Management, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Self-motivated with a willingness to learn and take initiative.
