title: Patient Services Coordinator
description:
AI Note-Taking Disclosure: We may use an AI-assisted tool during this interview for note-taking and documentation purposes. AI is not used to make hiring decisions or independently evaluate or select candidates. All employment decisions are made by members of our hiring team based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and overall fit for the position.

Patient Services Coordinator

SynergenX | Low T Center | HerKare

Are you outgoing, organized, and someone who loves working with people? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are exactly the same?

SynergenX, Low T Center, and HerKare are nationally recognized leaders in hormone replacement therapy, weight management, and targeted wellness services—and we’re looking for an energetic Patient Services Coordinator to join our growing team!

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to build a career in healthcare, gain valuable experience, and become an important part of a patient-focused team.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

  • Two weeks of paid training to help set you up for success

  • Fast-paced, people-focused environment

  • Opportunity to grow your experience in the healthcare industry

  • Work alongside experienced providers and clinical professionals

  • Competitive benefits and employee perks

  • Be part of a growing organization focused on helping patients look and feel their best

The Role

As a Patient Services Coordinator (PSC), you are the first impression and the face of the clinic. From the moment a patient walks through the door until they leave, you help create a welcoming, organized, and seamless experience.

This role is perfect for someone who can multitask, communicate confidently, stay organized, and keep a positive attitude even when things get busy.

You’ll manage front desk operations, coordinate appointments, assist patients with billing and insurance questions, collect payments, support clinic operations, and help ensure every patient receives exceptional service.

Our PSCs also play an important role in patient satisfaction and retention, so we’re looking for someone who enjoys building relationships and making people feel comfortable and valued.

What You'll Do

  • Welcome patients with a friendly, professional attitude and provide an excellent check-in and check-out experience

  • Check patients in and room them for appointments

  • Review and explain patient billing, insurance coverage, Explanation of Benefits (EOBs), and out-of-pocket costs clearly and confidently

  • Help resolve patient billing and insurance questions with professionalism and compassion

  • Accurately enter and update patient demographics, insurance information, and account details

  • Answer incoming calls promptly and professionally and route calls or messages appropriately

  • Collect and process patient payments accurately

  • Monitor clinic emails, text messages, and faxes throughout the day and ensure timely follow-up

  • Perform bi-monthly inventory based on clinic needs

  • Keep clinic supplies, snacks, and supplements organized and stocked

  • Complete bank deposits twice weekly and maintain accurate daily End-of-Day records

  • Support providers and clinic staff with administrative and clerical needs

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and patient-friendly front desk and waiting area

  • Attend monthly, quarterly, or annual meetings as needed

  • Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and all clinic policies

What We're Looking For

We want someone who is dependable, personable, confident, and ready to learn. The right candidate enjoys interacting with patients and can handle a busy clinic environment while staying organized and professional.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree preferred

  • Previous healthcare, medical office, front desk, or customer service experience preferred

  • Excellent communication and customer service skills

  • Comfortable discussing payments, insurance benefits, and patient account information

  • Strong computer and electronic communication skills

  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail

  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment

  • Professional, friendly, and patient-focused attitude

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive patient information

  • Must successfully pass a criminal background check

  • Must be flexible with clinic hours and available to work 2–3 Saturdays per month

Clinic Hours

Monday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Tuesday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM
Wednesday: 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM
Thursday: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Friday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Saturday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM

Saturday availability is required approximately 2–3 Saturdays per month.

Benefits & Perks

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Disability insurance

  • 401(k) with up to 5% company match

  • Paid time off

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Scrubs provided

  • Employee discounts for you plus one

  • Paid training

  • Opportunities for growth within a growing healthcare organization

Ready to Grow With Us?

If you're energetic, dependable, organized, and passionate about creating a great patient experience, we want to meet you!

Come grow your healthcare career with SynergenX, Low T Center, and HerKare and become part of a team that's making a difference in patients' lives every day.

title: M61 - Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer to maintain, enhance, and support a portfolio of enterprise digital products and platforms.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will work across the full technology stack, contributing to both frontend and backend development while ensuring existing applications remain stable, secure, and maintainable.

You will write, review, and ship production code, troubleshoot and resolve defects, implement security patches, support application and platform migrations, and collaborate with engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

Some applications within the portfolio are also undergoing modernisation, migration, or transition, providing opportunities to work across both existing systems and newer technology environments.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Development

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain frontend and backend applications across multiple codebases.
  • Build and maintain applications using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, backend APIs, services, and relational databases.
  • Write clean, maintainable, secure, and production-ready code.
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain appropriate engineering quality standards.

Application Maintenance & Support

  • Maintain the stability and reliability of existing digital products and applications.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application defects and production issues.
  • Perform security patching, infrastructure upkeep, monitoring, and technical maintenance.
  • Provide L2/L3 application support and conduct root-cause analysis where required.
  • Monitor application health, logs, metrics, and system performance.

Migration & Modernisation

  • Support application migrations, technology upgrades, and platform modernisation initiatives.
  • Assist with the migration of legacy applications to newer platforms and architectures.
  • Support application transition, retirement, or handover activities where required.
  • Ensure minimal disruption to existing services throughout migration and transition activities.

Cloud, DevOps & Observability

  • Support cloud-hosted applications and containerised environments.
  • Work with Docker and CI/CD pipelines for application deployment and delivery.
  • Analyse application logs and metrics using AWS services such as ECS and CloudWatch.
  • Work with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry for tracing, metrics, and logs.

Documentation & Collaboration

  • Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, operational procedures, and handover materials.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product teams, business stakeholders, and external partners.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, technical discussions, and delivery planning.
  • Take ownership of application stability, maintainability, and overall engineering quality.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of hands-on Full Stack Software Engineering experience.
  • Strong experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks, preferably React.
  • Experience developing and integrating backend APIs and services.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.
  • Comfortable working across multiple programming languages and existing codebases.
  • Working knowledge of cloud-hosted applications and environments.
  • Experience with Docker and containerised deployments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.
  • Experience troubleshooting applications through logs, metrics, and monitoring tools.
  • Familiarity with AWS ECS, CloudWatch, and/or OpenTelemetry is advantageous.
  • Proficiency with Git, code reviews, and engineering quality gates.
  • Solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile delivery methodologies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale or high-availability digital platforms.
  • Experience with application modernisation, migration, or legacy system retirement.
  • Experience providing L2/L3 production application support.
  • Familiarity with secure coding practices, security patching, and compliance requirements.
  • Previous experience working within complex, highly regulated, or large-scale environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Self-directed: Able to quickly understand unfamiliar applications and codebases.
  • Pragmatic: Balances delivery speed, maintainability, and engineering quality.
  • Adaptable: Comfortable working with changing priorities and applications undergoing migration or transition.
  • Collaborative: Works effectively with engineers, product teams, business stakeholders, and external partners.
  • Ownership-driven: Takes responsibility for the stability, security, and quality of the applications under their care.
  • Problem solver: Able to investigate technical issues independently and drive them through to resolution.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Java (Hybrid — Denver Metro preferred)
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer, Java
Location: Denver, CO preferred (Hybrid)

About FusionAuth

FusionAuth is a fast-growing startup and leading provider of customer identity and access management (CIAM) software headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Our mission is to make authentication and authorization simple and secure for every developer. Our product helps businesses securely manage customer identities and access, ensuring a safe user experience for some of the largest brands in the world. We are committed to delivering exceptional value and satisfaction to our clients through top-notch service and support. With a great team and strong investors, we are expanding our team to help accelerate our growth and take FusionAuth to the next level.

Job Summary

FusionAuth is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and extend our Java-based platform, trusted by thousands of organizations and downloaded over 10 million times. You will design and ship complex features end to end, from technical design through release, and apply protocol knowledge (OAuth 2.x, OpenID Connect, SAML) that customers rely on for correct, secure implementations.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real influence. You will review code for correctness and architectural fit, mentor Software Engineers on debugging and testing approaches, and identify tech debt before it slows the team down. You will partner directly with Product, DevSuccess, and Support to translate technical tradeoffs into decisions the business can act on.

Every feature you ship runs across customer-managed, self-hosted, and dedicated cloud deployments, so backward compatibility and upgrade paths matter on every change. This position reports to the Engineering Manager.

Responsibilites:

  • Feature development: Design and build complex features end-to-end, from technical design through release. Write high-quality, secure, well-tested production code.
  • Technical design: Author Technical Design Documents (TDDs) and provide architecture recommendations on designs led by others.
  • Code and design review: Serve as reviewer of record for parts of the codebase. Review for correctness, test quality, and architectural fit.
  • Testing: Design test approaches for complex features, write end-to-end tests for critical paths, and evaluate test quality during code review.
  • Debugging and troubleshooting: Diagnose and fix multithreaded and concurrency issues. Handle complex issues, including on-call rotation for critical customer issues (off-hours support required, though not the norm).
  • Database: Optimize queries using indexes and constraints. Understand ORM tradeoffs and have basic NoSQL familiarity.
  • Security: Apply least-privilege principles and understand timing attacks and encryption basics (PKI vs. symmetric).
  • AI-augmented development: Use LLMs as part of the SDLC, including code review assistance, documentation drafting, and refactoring. Help the team rethink how work gets done with AI in the loop.
  • Technical roadmap: Identify areas of tech debt and propose focus areas for the team.
  • Cross-functional communication: Present designs and tradeoffs to Product, DevSuccess, and Support. Translate technical constraints for non-engineering partners.
  • Technical influence: Influence team decisions through clear reasoning. Support and sometimes lead knowledge-sharing sessions on FusionAuth's architecture.
  • Customer engagement: Join customer calls to discuss specific technical topics and support complex integration questions.
  • Documentation: Write clear, thorough documentation for the features you ship.

Qualifications

If you meet most of the required qualifications below but not all of them, apply anyway. Skills transfer, and we'd rather talk to you than miss you over a checklist.

Required

  • Experience: 8-10 years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex features from design through release.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, or demonstrable experience with a broad set of theoretical topics.
  • Java: Advanced Java skills, including threading, concurrency, and performance profiling.
  • Object-oriented design: Strong object-oriented design and implementation skills.
  • Web fundamentals: Solid understanding of the full web stack (HTTP, TCP/IP, REST, and related protocols).
  • Database depth: Real working knowledge of relational databases: query optimization, indexing strategy, and schema design beyond ORM abstractions.
  • Testing: Experience designing test approaches for complex features and writing end-to-end tests, not just unit tests.
  • Full-stack range: Comfortable working up and down the stack, including cloud infrastructure, backend services, and JavaScript on the front end.
  • AI tooling: Comfortable using Claude Code, or a comparable AI-assisted development tool, as part of your daily workflow.
  • Work location: FusionAuth is headquartered in the Denver metro area, and we value the collaboration that comes from working together in person. We strongly prefer candidates local to the Denver metro who can be onsite 1-2 days per week. We're open to candidates in other locations who are willing to travel to our office approximately once per quarter.

Preferred:

  • Distributed systems: Experience building highly available, high-performance, multi-threaded, API-first applications.
  • Auth protocols: Working knowledge of OAuth 2.x grant types, OIDC protocol depth, and authentication enterprise integration patterns.
  • Kubernetes: Experience writing a basic manifest or Helm chart, with some familiarity with container orchestration in production.
  • CI/CD: Experience writing GitHub Actions workflows or comparable CI/CD pipelines.
  • Quantitative approach: Strong, data-driven approach to solving problems.
  • Learning speed: Quick learner, comfortable mastering new technologies and skills rapidly.
  • Communication style: Holds clear technical opinions while staying open to better evidence or team input.
  • Pragmatism: Appreciates first-principles thinking, but knows when to stop theorizing and start building.
  • Startup adaptability: Adaptable to the pace and ambiguity common in a roughly 50-person startup.

Compensation:

  • $140k - $180k expected base salary/OTE range*
Onsite Perks & Campus Benefits

When you join FusionAuth’s Denver team, you’ll enjoy a modern campus experience designed for productivity, wellness, and community:

  • Newly upgraded amenity spaces including a sleek tenant lounge and café with booth seating and collaborative workspaces.
  • Access to a fitness studio, showers, lockers, and secure bike storage.
  • Regularly stocked in-suite kitchen with a variety of snacks and beverages to keep you fueled throughout the day.
  • Onsite café offering chef-driven menus with fresh, locally sourced, organic, and non-GMO options to suit diverse dietary needs. Easy ordering via app.
  • 3-acres of green space, including communal parks and picnic areas, connected to miles of jogging, biking, and recreation trails.
  • Yoga in the circle and wellness programs to enhance work-life balance.
  • Dedicated outdoor workspaces and patio gathering areas.
  • Ample on-site parking, easy freeway access, and high-speed fiber internet.
  • Sustainability-minded campus and community initiatives, including support for regenerative agriculture programs.

Enjoy a high-tech business environment that inspires creativity and energizes your workday—all just minutes from the heart of Denver and Boulder.

*Pursuant to various state laws, we must display the pay range for this job. Since we are willing to hire within a broad spectrum of qualifications, this range is broad. The expected base salary may be adjusted based on individual qualifications, role, level and location.

Benefits

For full-time team members, we offer:

  • Comprehensive health insurance including medical, dental, and vision coverage, with the company covering the majority of your medical premiums to keep your costs low
    • Fully employer-paid High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) option paired with a Health Savings Account (HSA), including employer contributions
  • Basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage fully paid by the company for essential financial protection
  • Voluntary life insurance options to provide additional financial protection for you and your loved ones
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) to save pre-tax dollars on eligible expenses
  • 401(k) plan with company match to help you save for retirement
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) plus paid company holidays to support work-life balance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential counseling and support services
  • Professional growth and development opportunities to boost your career journey
  • Eligibility for performance-based bonuses or variable compensation tied to individual, team, or company results

Important Details

  • Application Submission: We value authentic, thoughtful responses. Copy/pasted or AI-generated answers to application questions that don’t reflect your own experience may disqualify your application.
  • In-Person Interview: Please be aware that participating in an in-person interview is encouraged so we can get to know each other. FusionAuth reimburses reasonable travel and lodging expenses associated with onsite interviews.
  • Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

If you are passionate about technology that solves real-world customer problems, and want to join a company that is moving the industry forward, FusionAuth is a perfect fit for you!

title: Remote PhD Data Science Intern – Media Mix Modeling
description:

Location: Remote

About the Role

FocusKPI is seeking a highly motivated PhD Data Science Intern to join our team for a three-month, full-time engagement focused on the research, development, and advancement of Media Mix Modeling (MMM) algorithms.
This is a hands-on, research-oriented role for someone with a strong foundation in statistics, econometrics, economics, or a closely related quantitative discipline who is interested in applying rigorous statistical methodology to real-world marketing and business problems.
The ideal candidate will have deep theoretical knowledge combined with practical experience developing statistical models end-to-end—from problem formulation and data preparation through model development, validation, interpretation, and production implementation.
The intern will work closely with senior data scientists and leadership to evaluate and enhance our MMM methodology, explore new modeling approaches, and translate advanced statistical techniques into scalable analytical solutions.

What You Will Do

  • Research and evaluate statistical and econometric approaches for Media Mix Modeling and marketing effectiveness measurement
  • Develop, test, and enhance MMM algorithms across the full modeling lifecycle
  • Work with time-series, panel, and observational marketing data to develop robust models of media response and business outcomes
Explore methodologies for:
    • Media response curves and saturation effects
    • Adstock and carryover effects
    • Incrementality and causal inference
    • Channel interaction and synergies
    • Seasonality, trends, and external factors
    • Model regularization and variable selection
    • Uncertainty estimation and statistical inference
    • Bayesian and frequentist modeling approaches
  • Develop model diagnostics and validation frameworks to assess model stability, predictive performance, statistical significance, and business interpretability
  • Conduct simulation and experimentation to understand algorithm behavior under different data-generating conditions
  • Compare alternative modeling methodologies and identify opportunities to improve model accuracy, robustness, and interpretability
  • Translate research findings into production-ready algorithms and analytical workflows
  • Work with real client datasets and understand the practical challenges of applying MMM to imperfect business data
  • Collaborate with senior data scientists to document methodology, assumptions, limitations, and results
  • Contribute to the development of next-generation MMM capabilities within FocusKPI

Required Qualifications

  • PhD in Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a closely related quantitative field
Strong theoretical foundation in:
    • Statistical modeling
    • Econometrics
    • Regression and multivariate analysis
    • Time-series analysis
    • Probability and statistical inference
    • Optimization
  • Strong understanding of causal inference and observational data
Demonstrated ability to develop statistical models end-to-end, including:
    • Problem formulation
    • Data preparation and feature engineering
    • Model specification
    • Estimation
    • Model diagnostics
    • Validation
    • Interpretation
    • Implementation
  • Strong programming skills in Python
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets
  • Ability to translate mathematical and statistical concepts into practical algorithms
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with senior technical team members

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with Media Mix Modeling (MMM)
  • Experience with marketing measurement, marketing analytics, or advertising data
  • Experience with Bayesian hierarchical models
  • Experience with causal inference, experimentation, or uplift modeling
  • Experience with time-series econometrics
Familiarity with:
    • Bayesian inference / MCMC
    • State-space models
    • Regularization
    • Constrained optimization
    • Nonlinear regression
    • Response curve estimation
    • Monte Carlo simulation
  • Experience with modern statistical computing frameworks such as PyMC, Stan, NumPyro, JAX, scikit-learn, statsmodels, or equivalent
  • Experience taking research concepts and converting them into reusable production code

title: Distribution Specialist
description:
SUMMARY
Distribution Specialist to help scale and optimize our global distributor network. This role is ideal for a data-driven, detail-oriented professional with a passion for channel operations and strategic growth. Responsibilities will center around distribution program responsibilities assuring continuity in customer support, quoting, and sales coordination while taking on broader strategy of both partner recruitment and process implementation, ultimately having full program ownership.
Designed as a growth opportunity, this role offers a clear path toward becoming a full-time Distribution Manager, with increasing exposure to analytics, contract management, and Sales.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Own distributor KPIs (sales, margins, forecast accuracy, inventory turns, quote-to-order conversion) and provide leadership with regular reporting, insights, and corrective action recommendations.
Build and maintain Power BI dashboards to consolidate distributor data across SAP, CRM, Budde Marketing, and internal reporting tools, ensuring accuracy and visibility.
Analyze distributor sales, quoting history, and margin trends to drive pricing strategies, identify gaps, and support decision-making.
Ensure system data integrity across platforms, troubleshooting discrepancies and streamlining reporting workflows.
Conduct weekly and monthly reporting cycles on distributor performance, highlighting wins, risks, and compliance with program standards.
Manage distributor contracts, including pricing tiers, MOQs, expirations, and alignment with corporate policies.
Oversee distributor program activities such as inventory monitoring, forecast reviews, and quarterly performance evaluations.
Maintain and improve tools and documentation, including a Distributor Program Playbook outlining program guidelines, pricing structures, and go-to-market practices.
Collaborate with marketing and product teams to support product launches, promotions, and distributor communications.
Cultivate distributor relationships through outreach, site visits, and participation in industry events
Drive continuous improvement in reporting accuracy, distributor performance tracking, and the overall effectiveness of the distribution program.
Crush numbers.

ACDI-0125

3+ years of experience in inside sales, distribution support, channel operations, or customer-facing roles
Proven experience working with CRM and ERP systems; familiarity with tools like Power BI, Salesforce, or SAP is highly desirable
Experience supporting distributor networks, managing quotes, and collaborating cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and product teams
Demonstrated ability to balance tactical execution with strategic thinking in a fast-paced, global environment

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Proficient in MS Office Suite and SharePoint.
Expertise in order management, inventory control, and shipment coordination

Proficient in CRM and ERP systems (e.g., Salesforce, SAP)

ACDI-0125

description:
Position Summary:
As a member of the Social Services Team reporting to the Social Services Manager, the Patient Navigator is responsible for assisting high-risk and vulnerable patient populations navigate medical and non-medical services. The Patient Navigator increases access to care by identifying psychosocial barriers with the goal of aligning resources to improve access to healthcare and health outcomes. Under the supervision of the Patient Navigation Supervisor, the Patient Navigator will assist with patient retention and engagement by promoting and offering SYHealth programs and services, providing assistance with health issues impacting the community, and health advocacy, etc.
Essential Functions of the Job:

Perform in-depth screening for internal and external community programs for the purpose of educating, navigating and connecting patients with needed services.
As a Patient Navigator, services will be provided via telecommunications and in person at specific clinic sites.
Obtain verbal consent and/or written authorization from patients and create patient profile on the Community Information Exchange (CIE) system.
Use active listening and conversational intent in all interactions to provide high –quality confidential connections to resources and services to all SYHealth patients.
Using needs assessment, identify programs and resources to assist patients based on the social determinants of health utilizing the PRAPARE Tool.
Actively listen to clients to develop a strategy that identifies solutions to barriers to access.
Accurately document all patient interactions and unmet needs into NextGen to assist in the identification of gaps in services that can be addressed organizationally.
Offer patients internal appointments, for example, social work, behavioral health and/or other needed services. Also utilize direct referral function on CIE.
Comply with Community Information Exchange regulations and complete all CIE trainings.
Collaborate with Social Services Department and participate in year-round community/charitable events.
Keep all activities in line with the core values and contribute to the positive culture of SYHealth.
Maintains accurate records of all activities performed and submits pertinent reports by due dates.
Represent SYHealth in an effective and professional manner and maintains positive working relationships with the general public, clients, patients, co-workers and other agencies.
Adheres to SYHealth and all department’s policies and procedure protocols.

Maintains established departmental policies and procedures, objectives quality assurance programs, safely, environmental and infection control standards.

Associates Degree in social work or other related fields. Experience can be considered in lieu of education requirements.

CA Driver’s license and access to privately owned insured vehicle.

Data Tracking & Management

Professional Development

  • Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending workshops, reviewing professional publications, and establishing networks.

The Director provides enterprise leadership for the CAP’s digital communications ecosystem, including website content strategy and governance, email, social media, search, analytics, audience development, multimedia, and emerging digital platforms.

The position establishes standards, facilitates integrated planning, and uses audience insights and performance data to improve engagement, strengthen the CAP brand, and demonstrate measurable organizational impact. The Director leads the digital communications team and serves as a strategic advisor to colleagues and cross-functional partners.

Specific Duties

Primary duties and responsibilities:
Strategic Communications:

Lead the development and execution of integrated communications strategies supporting the CAP’s mission, enterprise priorities, member engagement, customer engagement, advocacy, and reputation.
Translate organizational priorities into audience-centered communications objectives, channel strategies, messaging frameworks, and measurable outcomes.
Advise senior leaders and internal partners on digital communications opportunities, risks, audience needs, and emerging trends.
Ensure coordination across strategic communications, marketing, creative services, advocacy, membership, education, and business units.

Digital Communications Strategy and Governance:

Establish and lead the CAP’s enterprise digital communications strategy across web, email, social media, search, multimedia, podcasts, and emerging channels.
Develop governance standards, publishing practices, editorial workflows, and accountability measures that promote consistent, accessible, accurate, and high-quality digital communications.
Lead a website distributed content model by providing strategic direction, consultation, standards, training, and oversight to content contributors across the organization.
Define channel roles and audience journeys to ensure that digital platforms work together as an integrated ecosystem.

Website, Search, and Digital Experience:

Provide strategic oversight for CAP.org content, including governance, information architecture, content quality, user experience, accessibility, search optimization, and continuous improvement.
Partner with technology, user experience, product, marketing, and business teams to identify and prioritize enhancements to digital functionality and audience experience.
Ensure digital content is current, accurate, audience-centered, accessible, and aligned with CAP brand and editorial standards.
Lead the communications approach to search visibility, including SEO and evolving answer-engine and generative-engine optimization practices.

Audience Engagement, Analytics, and Optimization

Establish goals, KPIs, measurement frameworks, and reporting practices for the CAP’s digital communications channels and campaigns.
Use quantitative and qualitative audience insights to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and improve content, channels, campaigns, and user journeys.
Present performance metrics, findings, and actionable recommendations to communications leadership, senior executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Guide audience segmentation, testing, personalization, and channel optimization strategies to improve engagement and organizational impact.
Connect digital communications performance to organizational objectives rather than reporting channel activity alone.

Team, Operations, and Innovation

Lead, coach, and develop digital communications staff while establishing clear priorities, roles, workflows, and performance expectations.
Manage digital communications resources, vendors, agencies, contracts, and provide input on budgets.
Promote collaboration, experimentation, and responsible adoption of new technologies.
Monitor developments in artificial intelligence, search, content distribution, platform algorithms, privacy, and audience behavior, recommending appropriate responses for the CAP.
Ensure digital communications practices comply with applicable accessibility, privacy, copyright, brand, and organizational policies.

Knowledge/Skills Required/Preferred

Expertise in enterprise digital communications strategy across web, email, social media, search, podcast, and multimedia channels.
Demonstrated experience establishing digital governance, content standards, workflows, and shared accountability.
Strong understanding of audience-centered content strategy, user experience, accessibility, SEO/AEO/GEO, analytics, and digital measurement.
Ability to translate analytics and digital trends into clear strategic recommendations for senior leadership.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives through influence, consultation, and relationship-building.
Understanding of audience segmentation, testing, personalization, content distribution, and channel optimization.
Familiarity with content management systems, email platforms, social media management tools, analytics platforms, and digital collaboration tools.
Knowledge of emerging artificial intelligence applications and their implications for content development, search, governance, and communications.
Experience overseeing vendors, agencies, and contracts.
Strong editorial judgment and the ability to communicate complex medical, scientific, or organizational subjects clearly.

Education/Experience

Education:

A bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, marketing, or a related field is required.

Experience:

A minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in strategic communications, digital communications, content strategy, digital marketing, or a related field, including experience leading teams and enterprise-level digital initiatives.
Experience in a medical association, health care organization, professional society, or similarly complex, mission-driven organization is preferred.

Skills:

Strong leadership and team management abilities.
Proficiency in digital media tools, analytics platforms, and content management systems.
Crisis management experience and a proven ability to communicate effectively under pressure.

Additional Criteria

title: Cloud Security Specialist
description:
As a Cloud Security Specialist, you will lead the integration of security practices within our R&D department. You will be helping our development teams to design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable, and efficient software architecture. You will ensure that security is baked into every step of the software development lifecycle. Your work will directly impact the security posture of our applications and services, ensuring the integrity and reliability of our deployments.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the design and implementation of secure software architecture, CI/CD pipelines for .NET applications on Azure, integrating security best practices and tools to ensure code quality and security.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the development teams as well as collaborate to establish a security-focused roadmap.

  • Assist with internal penetration testing duties and security assessments for our cloud infrastructure and applications, identifying vulnerabilities and implementing effective mitigation strategies.

  • Help design and deploy robust authentication systems, enhancing the security of user data and access controls.

  • Drive the integration of DevSecOps practices into the development lifecycle, ensuring continuous security from code to cloud.

  • Collaborate with development teams to incorporate .NET security features and best practices into application design and deployment.

  • Stay updated on the latest in security threats, vulnerabilities, and mitigation technologies, adapting our strategy to continuously protect against risks.

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation on security configurations, procedures, and audits.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to our teams on DevSecOps best practices, tools, and technologies.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with all regulatory and industry security standards and certifications.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer or similar role with a strong focus on security and DevSecOps practices, preferably in an Azure environment.

  • Knowledge and experience of penetration testing tools and methodologies, along with a deep understanding of authentication protocols, application security, and web security principles.

  • Proficient in designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines, with a solid grasp of tools like SonarQube, ensuring code quality and security.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft and .NET ecosystem security features, best practices, and the integration of security into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor teams in the adoption of DevSecOps practices.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently or as part of a team.

  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with the capability to guide and influence technical teams and stakeholders.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g CISSP, Security+, A+, OSCP, OSCE, OSWE, Azure Security Engineer, DevSecOps, etc.) are highly desirable.

  • Fluency in English, French is a plus.

Working conditions:

  • Contract: Permanent, full-time (40h/week)

  • Working mode: Hybrid or remote

    • Occasional in-office presence may be required during the year (for events or team meetings, for example).

    • Candidates must reside in the province of Quebec.

  • Remote work and flexibility (supporting work-life balance)

  • RRSP contribution

  • Healthcare insurance from day one

  • Paid time off: 3 weeks + 1 additional week between Christmas and New Year

  • Annual training allowance to support your professional development

  • An onboarding program to help you get familiar with our environment and the digital healthcare field

  • All IT equipment is provided, with additional gear if needed

  • Internal growth opportunities (promotions, internal mobility)

  • Support from a wellness and social committee, with initiatives to foster team cohesion, mental health, and employee well-being

  • A company culture focused on transparency, collaboration, and innovation

  • Join a dynamic and innovative environment where your work has a real and wide-reaching impact, helping to modernize healthcare in Canada and internationally

title: Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) – Mobile/Home-Based Care
description:
Overview
We are seeking a skilled, compassionate, and dependable Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to provide high-quality physical therapy services to patients in their homes throughout the Las Vegas region.

The Physical Therapist Assistant will work under the direction and supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist to provide skilled therapeutic interventions, implement established plans of care, monitor patient response and progress, reinforce home exercise programs, and educate patients and caregivers on strategies to improve mobility, function, safety, and independence.
The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently within the scope of PTA practice in a home-based environment, has strong communication and interpersonal skills, and is passionate about delivering patient-centered care.
This is a 1099 independent contractor position.

Duties and Responsibilities
  • Travel to patients' homes throughout the assigned service area to provide physical therapy treatment under the direction of the supervising Physical Therapist.
  • Review the patient's established plan of care, treatment goals, precautions, and relevant clinical information prior to providing treatment.
  • Provide skilled physical therapy interventions in accordance with the Physical Therapist's plan of care, including:
    • Therapeutic exercises
    • Therapeutic activities
    • Neuromuscular re-education
    • Gait and mobility training
    • Balance and coordination training
    • Functional strengthening
    • Transfer training
    • Fall prevention and safety training
    • Manual therapy when appropriate and within the PTA's scope of practice
    • Functional mobility and activity training
  • Assist patients with improving strength, range of motion, balance, coordination, endurance, gait, mobility, and functional performance.
  • Train patients in the safe and appropriate use of assistive devices such as walkers, canes, and other mobility equipment as directed by the Physical Therapist.
  • Implement and reinforce individualized home exercise programs established by the Physical Therapist.
  • Educate patients and caregivers regarding prescribed exercises, mobility strategies, safety precautions, fall prevention, positioning, transfers, and strategies to promote independence.
  • Monitor patient response to treatment and recognize changes in pain, functional status, mobility, tolerance, or overall condition.
  • Communicate significant changes in patient condition, response to treatment, progress, concerns, or barriers to the supervising Physical Therapist in a timely manner.
  • Provide feedback to the Physical Therapist regarding patient progress and response to the established plan of care.
  • Assist the Physical Therapist with reassessments and other clinical follow-up activities as appropriate and permitted within the PTA's scope of practice.
  • Modify treatment activities within the established plan of care as appropriate and within the PTA's scope of practice, while communicating clinically significant changes to the supervising Physical Therapist.
  • Reinforce proper body mechanics, transfer techniques, positioning, and safety strategies with patients and caregivers.
  • Adapt treatment approaches to the patient's home environment, available space, equipment, functional abilities, and individual needs while following the established plan of care.
  • Coordinate care and communicate professionally with Physical Therapists, physicians, nurses, caregivers, occupational therapists, and other healthcare professionals as appropriate.
  • Communicate promptly regarding patient concerns, cancellations, scheduling changes, or other issues that may affect care.
  • Complete accurate, timely, and thorough documentation for daily treatment visits and other required clinical documentation.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations, professional standards, payer requirements, PTA supervision requirements, and company policies.
  • Recognize changes in patient condition that may require notification of the supervising Physical Therapist, referring provider, or other healthcare professional.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries at all times.
  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and professional care to patients and their families in the home setting.


Requirements
  • Current and valid Physical Therapist Assistant license in good standing.
  • Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program.
  • Strong knowledge of anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, biomechanics, therapeutic exercise, and rehabilitation principles.
  • Strong understanding of physical therapy treatment techniques and functional mobility principles.
  • Ability to safely and effectively implement a Physical Therapist's established plan of care.
  • Knowledge of therapeutic exercise, gait training, balance training, functional mobility, neuromuscular re-education, strengthening, transfer training, and fall prevention.
  • Strong observation and patient monitoring skills.
  • Ability to recognize and appropriately communicate changes in patient condition or functional status.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively manage a mobile patient caseload while maintaining appropriate communication with the supervising Physical Therapist.
  • Must be punctual, dependable, organized, and professional.
  • Comfortable entering and providing care in patients' homes and working with patients and caregivers in a home-based environment.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.
  • Ability to travel throughout the assigned service area.
  • CPR/BLS certification preferred or required according to company policy.
  • Previous home health, mobile therapy, outpatient, orthopedic, neurological, geriatric, or community-based experience is preferred.


Mobile/Home-Based Care Expectations
Because this position involves providing care in patients' homes, the Physical Therapist Assistant must be able to:
  • Arrive at scheduled visits within the expected timeframe.
  • Manage travel time and maintain an efficient daily schedule.
  • Carry and transport necessary clinical equipment and supplies.
  • Adapt treatment approaches to different home environments and available space.
  • Maintain a safe and professional environment during every patient visit.
  • Communicate promptly regarding cancellations, scheduling changes, patient concerns, or changes in patient status.
  • Respect patients' homes, privacy, routines, and individual preferences.
  • Demonstrate sound clinical judgment within the PTA's scope of practice when working independently in the community.
  • Maintain appropriate communication with the supervising Physical Therapist regarding patient progress, concerns, and changes in condition.


Documentation and Compliance
The Physical Therapist Assistant is responsible for completing all required clinical documentation accurately and within established timeframes, including:
  • Daily treatment notes
  • Patient response to treatment
  • Progress toward established functional goals
  • Exercises and interventions performed
  • Patient and caregiver education
  • Home exercise program instruction and reinforcement
  • Communication with the supervising Physical Therapist
  • Documentation of changes in patient condition or functional status
  • Other documentation required by the organization, payer, supervising Physical Therapist, or applicable regulations


The PTA must practice within the scope of the California Physical Therapist Assistant license and applicable supervision requirements and must follow the established plan of care developed by the supervising Physical Therapist.

Job Type
Full-time – 1099 Independent Contractor

Pay Structure (1099)
  • Guaranteed base pay: $840 per week
  • Base compensation is calculated at $35 per patient visit, based on a minimum of 6 patient visits per day.
  • $35 per additional patient visit for visits beyond the daily base of 6.
  • Compensation is subject to the terms of the independent contractor agreement.
Schedule
4/10 Schedule
  • Four 10-hour workdays per week
  • Typical start time: 7:30 AM–8:30 AM, depending on patient scheduling and geographic coverage.
  • Daily schedule may vary based on patient locations, visit duration, and patient needs.


Work Location
Mobile/Home-Based –Las Vegas Region
The Physical Therapist Assistant will travel to assigned patients' homes throughout the designated service area.

Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is a clinically capable, compassionate, dependable, and self-motivated Physical Therapist Assistant who enjoys working one-on-one with patients and families.
The successful candidate will be comfortable providing care in patients' homes, implementing established plans of care, adapting treatment activities to the patient's home environment, monitoring patient response, communicating effectively with the supervising Physical Therapist, and maintaining excellent documentation.
This position is an excellent opportunity for a Physical Therapist Assistant who values autonomy, flexibility, meaningful patient relationships, and community-based care while working as an integral member of a collaborative physical therapy team.

Up to occasionally, dependent on location, required to climb stairs, step stool and /or ladders.

Performs other tasks and duties as assigned.

This job description is not meant to be an all-inclusive list of duties, responsibilities and requirements, but constitutes a general definition of the position's scope and function within our company. Builds community within and outside of New Seasons Market and New Leaf Community Markets. Works in stores and other offsite events and locations as needed to support our core business and community.
Works cooperatively and positively with fellow team members, customers and vendors spiriting a respectful workplace where everyone is welcome.

Demonstrates ability to manage own time and models a flexible work style. Shifts tasks as priorities and circumstances change based on needs and conditions of department. Creative with problem-solving and is solutions-oriented.

Communication style is confident, informative, adaptive to different styles and effective.

Adheres to work and food safety policies set forth by the company and all local, state and federal regulatory agencies. Contributes to store and office cleanliness, maintains equipment.
Observes all company rules and policies. Understands and complies with specific department or location guidelines, tasks and responsibilities.

What you Bring as a Candidate:

Minimum 2 years experience in Meat and Seafood retail management required, including ordering and inventory management experience.

Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel and PowerPoint, with skills to learn new computer programs and systems. Experience working with food service inventory software highly preferred.
Excellent organizational and project coordination skills, with an eye for process improvement. Previous project management experience a plus.
Experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with ability to respond to urgent job responsibilities as they arise and flexible when priorities redirect.
Excellent interpersonal skills, including tact and diplomacy, to collaborate, negotiate and communicate effectively and professionally with cross-functional partners at all levels in the company.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise good judgment around sensitive information.
Valid driver’s license and vehicle required, with ability to travel regularly to store locations and other sites throughout the Portland Metro area.

Physical and Environmental Work Space: Work occurs in office, a variety of off-site environments and in a grocery store environment which includes surfaces that can be wet and slippery, moderate noise level, and temperature extremes in controlled environments in the cooler and freezer, and depending on location, working outside in all temperatures. title: UX Researcher & Service Designer
description:
Key Responsibilities:
  • Run discovery with agency teams to understand how they currently form ideas, gather information, and arrive at requirements for digital products.
  • Map the end-to-end process from the initial business idea to the defined requirement, surfacing where teams get stuck, lose information, or diverge.
  • Identify patterns, friction points, and unmet needs across teams, and synthesize them into clear, structured insights.
  • Translate findings into design principles and requirements that inform the concept and design of a supporting tool or agent.
  • Prototype and test process interventions or concepts to validate whether they help teams reach buildable clarity.
  • Facilitate workshops to frame problems, align stakeholders, and pressure-test emerging concepts.
Qualifications & Skill Sets:
  • At least 5 years of experience in service design, UX research, or product discovery, with experience shaping ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Strong generative research and synthesis skills, with the ability to turn messy, scattered inputs into structured insights.
  • Comfortable designing for process and workflow problems, not only interface problems.
  • Confident in workshop facilitation and stakeholder engagement.
  • Ability to work independently in an exploratory 0-to-1 context where the end product is not yet defined.
  • Interest in or exposure to AI-assisted tools or agents is an advantage.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Writer based in United States.

The Senior Technical Writer will transform complex technical concepts, architecture decisions, and system designs into clear, accurate, and accessible documentation.
You will support technical programs involving Salesforce, AWS, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, databases, and CI/CD environments.
Your work will span requirements documentation, solution designs, operating models, technical diagrams, and supporting artifacts.
You will collaborate directly with architects, engineers, security specialists, database teams, and federal stakeholders to capture decisions and technical requirements.
The role requires more than strong writing—you will need to understand architecture and technical diagrams well enough to create, interpret, and update them.
You will help establish consistency, quality, version control, and accessibility across critical documentation deliverables.
This is a fully remote opportunity for a technically curious writer who can work independently while partnering effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

Accountabilities

  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, DevSecOps Engineers, Cybersecurity teams, Database Administrators, and other technical stakeholders to understand complex solutions across Salesforce and AWS environments.
  • Produce and maintain requirements documentation that supports solution design, technical decisions, and program delivery.

title: Growth Engineer
description:
Please read first

  • This is a full-time, in-person role based in San Francisco (Presidio). We work from the office five days a week.

  • You must be based in the Bay Area or willing to relocate before starting.

  • We require US work authorization, but are open to O-1 or J-1 visa sponsorship for exceptional candidates.

About Sauna by Wordware

Every tool you use was built as an island, so you became the glue between them. You carry a name from Gmail into the CRM, a time from the CRM into Calendly, a note from Calendly into a doc. AI showed up and mostly became an eleventh window to paste into.

Sauna is a hybrid of AI and software standing on one shared brain. It holds your context and hands you real software built on top of it. You talk to it like a chatbot and use what it builds like an app: software for the path you repeat, AI for the edge that never repeats. Keep it to yourself, or share the brain with your team.

The clearest way to see it is a tool doing what its whole category cannot. An ordinary Calendly shows a stranger your free slots. Your Calendly writes the invite email itself, because it knows how the two of you know each other, and it offers a board member the slot over your gym block, because it knows which of your busy hours bend and for whom.

Wordware is the team behind it, backed by Spark Capital, Felicis and Y Combinator. We build from an office in the Presidio, across from Crissy Field beach.

About the Role

You'll own the engineering that helps people discover Sauna, try it and become customers: the website experiments, tracking, integrations and internal tools behind our growth work.

You'll work closely with our marketers to choose useful experiments, build them and understand the results. That means understanding the product and its economics well enough to question an idea, propose a better approach and explain the tradeoffs. You'll take work from a rough brief through production, testing the customer journey and the data it produces.

Marketing owns campaign strategy, media budgets and creative production. You own the technical systems and measurement those decisions depend on. Product owns activation and retention priorities; you'll partner on instrumentation and experiments that cross into the product.

Your first 30 days

Get close to the product and map how a customer moves from an ad or landing page through signup, meaningful use and payment. Audit the tracking along that path, agree the event definitions with Growth and Product, and fix the gaps that prevent reliable decisions.

Ship a focused website or funnel experiment with its measurement in place. Establish a baseline the team can inspect, including where attribution is incomplete and how trial and inference costs affect acquisition economics.

What You'll Do

  • Own acquisition tracking end to end. Define meaningful conversion events with Growth and Product, implement browser and server-side tracking, and connect campaign attribution to signups, product usage and payments. Build and maintain integrations with Meta Conversions API, Google Ads conversion tracking and GTM, including consent handling, event deduplication and monitoring.

  • Ship website and funnel experiments. Build landing pages, forms and conversion flows in TypeScript and React. Work with marketing and design to make the messaging, offer and experience fit Sauna, then test the complete journey across devices before release.

  • Make the numbers dependable. Use SQL and PostHog to investigate funnels and cohorts. Reconcile ad-platform reports with product and billing data, catch missing or duplicated events, and explain what we can and can't conclude. Include trial and inference costs when evaluating acquisition economics.

  • Turn hypotheses into tested releases. Choose a success metric and guardrails before shipping, implement experiments, read results with appropriate statistical care, and recommend what to keep, change or stop. Know when traffic is too low for a confident conclusion.

  • Build tools that remove recurring growth work. Connect our analytics, billing, CRM and marketing systems. Use Sauna and AI coding tools to build useful automations, with clear failure handling and a way for the team to inspect and correct the output.

  • Own what you ship. Write tests, review generated code, document important decisions and monitor systems after release. Work with product engineers on security and architecture, and keep the growth stack understandable as it changes.

Who You Are

Minimum:

  • You've shipped production software across frontend, backend and data. You're comfortable with TypeScript/JavaScript, React, APIs, webhooks and SQL, and can diagnose problems across that whole path.

  • You've implemented conversion tracking and ad-platform integrations yourself. You understand how conversion signals influence campaign optimization and can trace a missing or duplicated event to its source.

  • You've instrumented an event-based analytics system such as PostHog, and used the data to make a real growth or product decision.

  • You understand funnels, attribution and acquisition economics. You can explain why you chose a metric, what could mislead you and how you'd check it.

  • You use AI tools actively and take responsibility for their output. You can explain the code and configuration you ship, verify assumptions and adapt an approach to the product in front of you.

  • You work independently, communicate clearly with nontechnical teammates and care about the details of the customer experience.

Bonus (but not required):

  • Experience growing a usage-based product and accounting for trial or inference costs.

  • Customer-facing tools you've built that generate qualified demand.

  • Experience shipping technical SEO infrastructure or automating growth operations.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary: $150,000–$250,000 , depending on experience and how much of the role you can own from day one, plus meaningful early-stage equity.

Standard Wordware benefits: medical, dental and vision; daily lunch and dinner in the office; 401(k); gym budget; the Presidio office with a sauna and the beach across the road.

How to apply

Tell us about one growth system or experiment you personally built. What did you implement, why did you choose that approach, how did you verify it worked, and what changed as a result? Include a link or concrete evidence where you can, without sharing confidential information.

The Process

  1. Application: Complete the application form and answer the question above. Attaching a resume is optional.

  2. 15-minute intro call: Align on location, motivation and logistics.

  3. Technical growth deep-dive: Walk through a system you've built, the decisions behind it and how you verified the results. Work through a growth engineering problem together.

  4. Final conversation: We answer your questions and scope the work trial.

  5. Work trial: Paid, in person, usually a few days to two weeks. Work on a real project with us and see whether the fit works for both sides.

title: Manufacturing Material Planner

Operating 23 manufacturing facilities across four continents—including the United States, the United Kingdom, India, and Brazil—JCB produces a diverse portfolio of more than 300 products. These include telescopic handlers, backhoe loaders, excavators, wheel loaders, compact excavators, skid steer loaders, compact track loaders, access aerial work platforms, rough terrain forklifts, and tractors.

At the heart of JCB’s success are its people. As a family-owned business, we are accountable to our customers—not shareholders—which gives us the flexibility to focus on long-term innovation and delivering real value. This independence allows us to continuously develop advanced technologies and integrate them into equipment designed to perform in the toughest environments while maximizing customer productivity.

At JCB, we stand behind our products—and our name—with pride and commitment to quality.

This position is responsible for planning and regulating machine parts and current inventory level. This role ensures that each day's scheduled run of parts occurs without incident. The individual is responsible for assisting Production Control management and Manufacturing management to achieve its daily targets by keeping up with demand, forecasting needs, and managing/building strong relationships with JCB North America’s suppliers and vendors.

Manage and coordinate a large volume of parts on a daily basis

Liaise with other areas to ensure resolution of any known supplier/material issues

Ability to work in a high-stress environment.

Collaborative approach to resolving issues impacting various groups across the enterprise.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer based in United States .

This is a senior product design opportunity focused on shaping AI-powered experiences for millions of musicians worldwide.
You will design across Web, Desktop, TV, Mobile, and plugins, creating a cohesive ecosystem for learning, practicing, rehearsing, and music production.
The role combines strong product thinking, systems thinking, research, interaction design, and exceptional visual and interaction craft.
You will turn complex AI and audio capabilities into intuitive experiences that feel powerful without feeling complicated.
Working closely with Product, Engineering, AI, Data, and Marketing, you will help define problems, validate ideas, and ship meaningful value quickly.
The environment is highly collaborative, distributed, and action-oriented, with significant autonomy and low ceremony.
This role is especially suited to a designer who actively produces music and deeply understands professional audio workflows, DAWs, and plugins.

Accountabilities:

  • Design experiences across Web, Desktop, TV, and Mobile, maintaining consistency and coherence as musicians move between platforms.
  • Create products and workflows that support musicians and producers in practicing, learning, rehearsing, writing, recording, and producing music.
  • Translate complex AI and audio capabilities into simple, intuitive, and immediately understandable user experiences.
  • Conduct and synthesize research with musicians across different skill levels and use cases, turning insights into actionable product direction.
  • Contribute to and evolve the design system, ensuring scalable and consistent experiences across multiple platforms.
  • Move rapidly from early concepts and sketches to high-fidelity and coded prototypes, using interaction and motion to resolve design questions when needed.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, AI, Data, Marketing, and senior leadership to align priorities, communicate design rationale, and deliver features efficiently.
  • Navigate different levels of the organization, from user conversations and engineering collaboration to executive-level presentations and strategic product discussions.
  • Give and receive direct, specific design critique that raises the quality and consistency of the overall product experience.
  • Balance simplicity, scalability, technical feasibility, and user value when making product and design decisions.
  • Contribute to a culture of ownership, experimentation, continuous improvement, and daily delivery of meaningful user value.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of experience designing complex software products that are used regularly by real customers, supported by a strong portfolio demonstrating the ability to make powerful technology feel simple.
    • Deep, hands-on experience producing music using professional tools, with a genuine understanding of creative workflows from personal experience.
    • Strong fluency with DAWs and VST/AU plugins, including knowledge of professional audio workflows such as recording, MIDI, mixing, routing, and signal flow.
    • Experience designing or building music instruments, effects, plugins, or related creative software is a strong advantage.
    • Experience designing AI-native products or working with the unique UX challenges associated with probabilistic systems.
    • Ability to move quickly between design fidelities, from rough sketches to interactive and coded prototypes, including motion and interaction animation when appropriate.
    • Comfort working in ambiguous, zero-to-one environments where problems, specifications, design systems, or established playbooks may not yet exist.
    • Strong mastery of interaction design patterns, with the ability to select appropriate patterns, adapt them across platforms, or create new patterns when necessary.
    • Ability to maintain coherent experiences across Web, Desktop, TV, and Mobile.
    • Strong written communication skills and the ability to clearly explain the reasoning behind design decisions.
    • Proven ability to conduct user research independently and translate customer observations into product decisions rather than simply design deliverables.
    • Experience using code-based prototyping as a regular part of the design process.
    • Familiarity with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.
    • High degree of autonomy, curiosity, ownership, and comfort making thoughtful trade-offs in fast-moving environments.
    • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to communicate effectively across technical, product, and creative disciplines.
    • Ability to work effectively in distributed, cross-time-zone teams where written communication and asynchronous decision-making are essential.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time remote position.
      • Competitive compensation.
      • Flexible paid time off (PTO).
      • Paid parental leave.
      • Physical and mental health support through Moises Care.
      • Learning and development opportunities.

Specifications

  • Team Building: Capable of developing strong interpersonal networks and trust within the organization.
  • Safety Culture: Adheres to the NuScale Safety culture and is expected to model safe behavior and influence peers to meet high standards.
  • Quality Assurance: Demonstrated understanding and implementation of quality assurance regulations, standards and guidelines of 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, 10 CFR 21, and NQA-1 preferred.

Required to demonstrate a strong aptitude in technical writing and have good communication, computer, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Must possess exceptional organization skills and an ability to manage complex projects with multiple work phases.

Maintain, coordinate, and optimize preventive maintenance (PM) schedules to ensure equipment reliability and regulatory compliance.

Experience Qualifications

2–5 years of experience in maintenance planning, manufacturing operations, MRO inventory management, or a related field.
Experience utilizing CMMS platforms such as SAP PM, Maximo, Fiix, eMaint, or equivalent systems.
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Working knowledge of mechanical and electrical equipment components.
Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis. (Required)
Experience working in a GMP, FDA-regulated, or other highly regulated manufacturing environment. (Preferred)

Skills and Abilities

Ability to work in manufacturing and warehouse environments.
Occasional lifting of materials up to 40 pounds.
Ability to stand, walk, bend, and climb stairs as required.
Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).

title: Packaging Engineer
description:
Position: Packaging Engineer. Location: Cork, Ireland.
PACIV, a global leader in industrial automation solutions with offices in Ireland, the United States and Puerto Rico, and serving the Life Science, Food & Beverage (F&B) and Utilities industries, is looking for an experienced Packaging Engineer for a F&B project. This is a site-based role.
You will be responsible for end‑to‑end packaging engineering execution, leading the workstream through installation, integration, commissioning, performance testing, and operational readiness. You will ensure all packaging systems are delivered safely, on time, and in full, aligned to project milestones, quality expectations, and Company Engineering Standards.
In this role, you will take technical ownership of the execution, integration, and commissioning of aseptic/ESL filling systems including filler/closer, cap and container sterilization, and capping/sealing ensuring all equipment and associated hygienic utilities are delivered safely, on time, and in full to the required specifications. You will ensure these systems are installed, commissioned, and qualified to the highest standards, resolving technical issues as they arise during construction and start‑up. Your expertise will be essential in ensuring the facility meets Company’s expectations for safety, quality, efficiency, and innovation as it progresses toward start‑up and operational readiness.
As part of the plant project team, you will play an important role in technical execution, commissioning readiness, documentation, and troubleshooting during start‑up.

Responsibilities of the Role
Technical Ownership – Fillers
  • Act as the technical owner for aseptic/ESL filling systems, including filler/closer, cap & container sterilization, and capping/sealing.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for all filler‑related technical decisions, ensuring alignment with Company standards and best practices.

Project Execution & Commissioning
  • Lead the installation, integration, commissioning, and qualification of filler systems and their interfaces with downstream/EOL equipment.
  • Execute the filler commissioning and start‑up strategy, including FAT/SAT, IQ/OQ/PQ, performance testing, and ramp‑up to target OEE.
  • Troubleshoot filler performance issues during construction, commissioning, and start‑up to ensure safety, quality, capacity, efficiency, and hygiene zoning compliance.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with Operations, Quality, R&I, EHS, Maintenance, and Supply Chain to ensure filler readiness, trial execution, and efficient changeovers (SMED).
  • Act as the primary technical interface with EPCM partners, OEMs, and construction teams for filler installation sequencing, utilities tie‑ins, and commissioning plans.

CAPEX Support & Governance
  • Provide technical leadership for the filler CAPEX package, supporting scope definition, cost forecasting, scheduling, and reporting.
  • Contribute to risk management and change control processes for filler‑related scope.

Procurement & Supplier Management
  • Lead the technical elements of tenders for filler systems (URS/SoW, bid evaluations, clarifications, technical alignment).
  • Collaborate with Global, Regional Engineering and C&P (CAPEX Procurement) on supplier selection, performance guarantees, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage OEM engagement throughout FAT/SAT, onsite commissioning, training, and documentation delivery.

Standards, Compliance & Safety
  • Ensure filler systems comply with Company global standards, GMP/HACCP, aseptic/hygienic design principles, and regulatory requirements.
  • Embed Safety by Design and quality‑focused engineering in all aspects of execution and commissioning; ensure proper validation and technical documentation.

Operational Readiness & Handover
  • Develop or support filler‑related SOPs, sterilization/cleaning routines, PM plans, and spare parts lists.
  • Support structured handover to Operations/Maintenance, including training, troubleshooting guides, and performance baselines; document lessons learned.

Reporting & Decision Support
  • Provide clear, structured updates on filler‑related progress, risks, commissioning readiness, and mitigations to the Project Director and leadership team.
  • Support strategic and operational decisions with timely technical insights and data.
Requirements
Candidates must have a valid EU Work Permit and Irish residency
Please no agencies

Education
  • BSc in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Food Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical discipline.


Experience/Skills Required
  • 4+ years of packaging experience in F&B, pharmaceutical, or related regulated process manufacturing sector.
  • Strong experience with aseptic/ESL filling and high‑hygiene packaging technologies.
  • Proven track record leading CAPEX or greenfield/brownfield industrial projects.
  • Experience with commissioning and qualification (FAT/SAT, IQ/OQ/PQ).
  • Ability to interpret engineering documents (P&IDs, PFDs, layouts, technical specs).
  • Strong troubleshooting skills during installation and startup.
  • Understanding of automation and process control (PLC/SCADA).
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and external engineering partners.
  • Effective communication with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to lead technical discussions with vendors.
  • Commitment to a safety‑first culture.

title: Software Engineer, Search Ads in AI Experiences

Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads.   • Own projects end-to-end from initial idea to design, analysis, and implementation.
