title: Software Development Engineer II - Frontend
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Development Engineer II - Frontend based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to build the frontend foundations of a global commerce platform designed to support millions of small and medium-sized businesses.
You will create customer-facing experiences across storefronts, checkout, catalogs, subscriptions, invoices, and contracts.
The work combines frontend engineering depth with a strong focus on performance, resilience, accessibility, and internationalisation.
Your interfaces will operate across 150+ countries, including challenging network conditions, slower devices, and embedded third-party environments.
You will have significant ownership over performance budgets, observability, offline capabilities, and the quality of the overall user experience.
Working in a largely greenfield environment, you will collaborate closely with product and design teams while helping shape modern commerce capabilities.
The role also provides opportunities to mentor junior engineers and contribute to a fast-moving, remote-first engineering culture.

Accountabilities:

  • Build and ship high-quality commerce experiences, including storefronts, checkout, product catalogs, subscription management, invoices, and customer-facing documents.
  • Develop frontend experiences that can be embedded into other applications using approaches such as module federation, iframes, and white-label hosts while maintaining isolation, fast loading, and graceful degradation.
  • Own frontend performance budgets end to end, monitoring Core Web Vitals, bundle size, rendering costs, hydration, and main-thread activity, and measuring performance continuously through CI and production tooling.
  • Build installable and offline-tolerant progressive web applications using service workers, thoughtful caching strategies, background synchronization, and reliable offline behavior.
  • Deliver accessible experiences aligned with WCAG 2.2 AA, including semantic markup, keyboard navigation, focus management, and screen-reader support.
  • Support comprehensive internationalisation and localisation across languages, currencies, tax requirements, address formats, locale-aware formatting, and right-to-left layouts.
  • Instrument frontend applications with real-user monitoring and OpenTelemetry to identify performance and reliability regressions before they significantly impact customers.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to translate requirements into polished, scalable experiences.
  • Mentor junior engineers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to engineering standards and continuous improvement.

    • Requirements:

    • 2+ years of experience building and operating production frontend applications, with strong ownership of real-world software systems.
    • Deep knowledge of Vue.js, including its reactivity model, component composition, rendering behavior, and the performance implications of architectural and implementation choices.
    • Strong frontend performance expertise, with hands-on experience using Lighthouse, Chrome DevTools, and performance profiling tools to identify, measure, and resolve regressions.
    • Practical knowledge of service workers and caching strategies, including precaching, runtime caching, versioning, invalidation, and reliable offline behavior.
    • Experience with client-side state management and local caching at scale, using TanStack Query or an equivalent solution, including cache keys, staleness, invalidation, and optimistic updates.
    • Strong understanding of accessibility as part of the development process, including semantic HTML, focus management, keyboard navigation, screen-reader behavior, and WCAG 2.2 AA.
    • Experience with internationalisation and localisation, including message extraction, pluralisation, locale-aware currency and date formatting, and RTL layouts.
    • Familiarity with modern frontend tooling and module federation, including technologies such as Rspack and Vite, as well as bundle analysis and code splitting.
    • Strong attention to frontend craftsmanship, with the ability to identify and resolve subtle issues such as alignment inconsistencies, janky scrolling, layout shifts, and degraded experiences on throttled connections.
    • Comfortable consuming typed backend contracts such as ConnectRPC/protobuf and reasoning about API contracts, error handling, and client-side failure states.
    • Excellent debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex frontend issues and deliver practical solutions.
    • Experience with the broader technical environment is valuable, including Go, ConnectRPC, Buf, GCP/GKE, Pub/Sub, ESLint, OpenTelemetry, and progressive web application technologies.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on a global commerce platform designed to support millions of businesses and significant transaction volumes.
      • Exposure to greenfield engineering initiatives with limited technical debt and opportunities to influence architecture and product direction.
      • Work on challenging frontend problems involving performance, accessibility, resilience, localisation, offline functionality, and embedded experiences.
      • Remote-first working environment designed to support distributed teams across multiple countries.
      • Collaboration with product, design, and engineering professionals in a fast-paced, ownership-oriented culture.
      • Opportunities to mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical standards and engineering practices.
      • Continuous learning and professional development through exposure to modern frontend technologies and large-scale distributed systems.
      • Opportunity to build software that directly influences customer experiences, conversion, and business outcomes.

title: Partnerships Internship

We empower both the food and retail industries to expand their revenue and simplify their operations, creating seamless experiences for businesses to sell anywhere and deliver everywhere. Join us in this exciting journey, where your contributions will directly impact how businesses connect with their customers in a rapidly evolving global market.

Why this isn't your average internship

Deliverect connects third-party delivery platforms (like Uber Eats, Just Eat, Glovo, etc.) to restaurants' POS systems, automating the online order flow. We are a fast-growing SaaS company operating globally, simplifying online food delivery management so restaurants can focus on what they do best: crafting great food.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented Partner Trainee fluent in Italian to join our team in Spain. If you want to kickstart your career in the tech/SaaS industry and learn how a global partnership ecosystem works, this is your place!
Forget making coffee or printing PDFs. As our Partner Trainee, you’ll sit in the driver’s seat of our expansion in Southern Europe. You’ll learn how a global SaaS company actually operates, solve real business challenges, and become the go-to contact for our partners.

If you want to fast-track your career in tech and see the direct impact of your work every single day, this is your launchpad.

  • Data & CRM Management: Keep our CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) and internal databases up to date with partner information, contracts, and interaction logs.

  • Tech-Curious: You don't need to write code! You just need a healthy curiosity about how modern software works and zero fear of learning new digital tools.

  • Fast Learner & Doer: You have a "get things done" attitude, strong organization skills, and love solving puzzles.

  • Background: Currently studying or recently graduated in Business, Hospitality, International Trade, IT, or a related field.

  • Passion for Tech & Food: A genuine interest in startups, food-tech, or the restaurant industry is a massive plus!

  • 📈 Real Career Rocket Fuel: We don't hire trainees just for temporary help. High performers regularly transition into full-time permanent roles as we scale.

  • 🎓 1-on-1 Mentorship: Work alongside industry experts who actually care about your professional growth and will coach you daily.

  • 🌍 Vibrant International Vibe: Join a diverse, fun, and highly energetic multicultural team in Spain.

  • 🏡 Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the best of both worlds with a mix of remote flexibility and collaborative office days.

  • 🍕 Perks & Culture: Free coffee, daily office snacks, epic team-building events, and an environment where your ideas are actually heard.


Join Our Innovative Journey:

At Deliverect, we're not just building a platform; we're redefining how restaurants and retailers connect with their customers globally. We're looking for agile, ambitious, and resourceful team members who are excited to tackle complex challenges, take calculated risks and contribute to innovative solutions that shape the future of commerce.

Solve Meaningful Challenges- Contribute to tackling some of the most significant challenges in the global tech industry, directly impacting the way businesses operate worldwide.

title: Clinician – School-Based Mental Health Program
description:
About the Role
Wood’s Homes is seeking a skilled and collaborative Clinician to join the William Taylor Learning Centre School-Based Mental Health Program. Working in partnership with the Calgary Board of Education, you will support children, youth, and families within a dynamic learning environment where education and mental health treatment come together.
This role is ideal for a graduate-level clinical professional who values relationship-based practice, interdisciplinary teamwork, and creative approaches to treatment. You will provide direct clinical services while working closely with young people, families, school staff, program colleagues, and community partners to promote meaningful progress.
Why This Opportunity Stands Out

School-based mental health services: provide treatment in an environment where clinical care and learning are closely connected.
A dynamic learning environment: adapt your approach to the strengths, needs, and circumstances of each young person and family.
Partnership in practice: work collaboratively with the Calgary Board of Education and an interdisciplinary program team.
Youth and family work: deliver family, individual, and group interventions and therapy.
Treatment with creativity: use thoughtful, flexible, and evidence-informed approaches to engage young people and support change.
Professional growth: contribute to consultation, training, specialized projects, and your own ongoing development.

Key Responsibilities

Provide direct treatment services to a caseload of children, youth, and families through family, individual, and group intervention and therapy.
Complete assigned client assessments and prepare written assessment reports in accordance with case management guidelines.
Maintain timely, high-quality records of ongoing clinical work in accordance with professional and organizational requirements.
Work as an active member of interdisciplinary clinical and school-based teams.
Build strong, respectful relationships with youth, families, school partners, community resources, and program colleagues.
Provide clinical consultation to Wood’s Homes programs as assigned and help strengthen clinical skill and knowledge.
Support staff, practicum student, and community professional training when requested.
Communicate actively with community resources regarding Wood’s Homes clients and programs.
Participate in research and specialized projects as assigned.
Engage actively in clinical and administrative supervision and ongoing professional development.
Complete required health and safety training and promptly report hazards, unsafe conditions, and incidents.

What You Bring

A master’s or PhD degree in Psychology, Social Work, Family Nursing, Art Therapy, or a related field.
Current registration, or active pursuit of registration or certification, with the appropriate professional association.
Where applicable, eligibility for licensure under Alberta’s Health Professions Act and a commitment to professional standards, guidelines, and ethics.
Demonstrated clinical experience, with supervisory and program development experience considered an asset.
Sound clinical judgment and the ability to respond effectively to diverse program and client needs.
Strong relationship-building skills and emotional intelligence.
Professional, clear, and timely written and verbal communication.
The ability to work collaboratively, make informed decisions, and contribute positively within a dynamic environment.
The ability to produce timely, high-quality clinical documentation and reports.

Additional Requirements

Current proof of professional registration may be required for certain degrees or disciplines.
A valid Alberta Class 5 or Class 5 GDL driver’s license, automobile insurance with $2 million liability coverage, and a driver’s abstract with no more than six demerits.
Ability to work in settings that may include schools, community locations, and other program environments.
Comfort working in situations that may involve emotional intensity, conflict, or crisis.

Who Will Thrive Here
You are a grounded and creative clinician who sees young people and families as partners in treatment. You enjoy clinical work that is active, relational, and connected to the realities of a school day. You can bring structure and sound judgment while remaining flexible, curious, and responsive. Most importantly, you want your work to help young people participate more fully in learning, relationships, and community life.

title: Director of People and Culture
description:
Position Summary

Galvanize USA is seeking a Director of People and Culture. In our eighth year and as we cross the 40-employee mark, we're looking for a solutions-oriented leader who can help our organization run well day to day, enforcing and maintaining the people & culture systems already in place while spotting the gaps that need new ones. This person brings a positive, creative energy and stays calm under pressure. The best candidate will turn to data to understand opportunities for improvement and will approach staff with a coaching mentality that helps build a healthy, high-functioning workplace.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a member of the leadership team, strengthening our responsive human resources strategy with strong feedback loops for hiring, engaging, developing, and retaining talent
  • Support people managers and optimize our performance management process to drive accountability and help team members to feel empowered, trusted, and effective in their roles
  • Propose, design, and lead measurable strategic initiatives to address gaps with a focus on our values of innovation, equity, community, teamwork, continuous learning, and compassion & care
  • Proactively lead the organization through change, with deep understanding of how to create buy-in and drive adoption of new processes
  • Craft learning and development programs that empower and inspire staff members to reach goals
  • Deliver manager and organization-wide trainings
  • Coach and mentor teammates to foster a culture of empathy, deep listening, and feedback to connect more deeply across differences
  • Design clear systems for thoughtful growth by supporting hiring managers through the entire employee lifecycle from recruitment to offboarding
  • Create meaningful moments to connect through the design of team retreats, all-team meetings, and other initiatives
  • Support team members in understanding and maximizing their benefits, including leave and reintegration planning for Galvanize’s sabbatical program
  • Build and maintain user-friendly systems that organize policies, internal communications, and documentation
  • Manage comprehensive compensation reviews with an outside vendor every 2-3 years
  • Lead the design, distribution and analysis of regular pulse, annual engagement and other surveys, summarizing results for leadership and staff, tracking trends over time.
  • Monitor and analyze org-wide people trends surfacing findings and flagging areas that need leadership attention
  • Act as day-to-day liaison with Hopewell Fund’s HR team on technical, administrative, and employee relations needs, ensuring smooth coordination between the organization and the fiscal sponsor.
  • Manage, support, and develop direct reports, contractors, and vendors, including setting clear expectations, providing feedback and coaching, and ensuring effective collaboration and accountability, when applicable.
  • All employees of Hopewell Fund are required to complete timesheets every two weeks
  • Perform other duties as needed

Required Qualifications and Experience:

  • A strong track record of developing values-driven people and culture strategies with measurable outcomes
  • Clear examples of coaching teammates to foster a culture of inclusion, trust, and accountability in a remote-first environment
  • A proactive and data-driven approach for developing processes that inspire high performance, deep collaboration, and retention
  • Demonstrated experience rolling out user-friendly systems effectively, with the ability to clearly articulate processes and drive adoption across the team
  • Deep understanding of how to craft and maintain thoughtful systems for the entire employee lifecycle, from recruitment to offboarding
  • Experience leading performance management processes that cultivate a culture of continuous learning, productivity and growth
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to effectively prioritize and remove barriers to implementation
  • Commitment to ensuring diversity, equity, and inclusion is at the heart of both our people operations strategy and program delivery
  • Experience building adaptable systems and navigating change successfully as an organization grows
  • Dedication to Galvanize USA’s mission to empower women to build an America that works for everyone
  • Candidates must be authorized to work in the US. We are not able to sponsor visas at this time.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ability to travel as needed (typically, 2-4 times/year)
  • Experience designing or coordinating engaging team retreats or all-staff events
  • Familiarity with Leapsome or other people engagement platforms
  • Familiarity with JazzHR or other applicant tracking systems

Compensation & Benefits

The starting salary range for this position is $128,000-$132,000. Placement within this band will be determined based on years of prior experience and relevant skills. To adhere to an internal compensation policy, offers to new hires are non-negotiable.

Galvanize USA also offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision insurance for employees (and their families). Employees are able to enroll in the 401k retirement plan and are eligible for a 3% automatic contribution and up to a 3% employer match on 401k contributions. Employees are also eligible for pre-tax transportation benefits. Employees will receive 120 hours of vacation time, 80 hours of health leave, up to 2 days of casual leave, and 20 hours of volunteer leave annually. Employees will also receive 13 paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Employees are eligible for 12 weeks of paid family and medical leave after 90 days of employment

How to Apply

Submit a resume and reply to the custom application questions. Preference will be given to applications submitted before September 28.

About Galvanize USA

Galvanize USA is a nonpartisan civic empowerment program with a mission to build an America that works for everyone. The division in politics today is causing more and more women to step back from civic engagement. We believe there is a different way forward – one that is rooted in meaningful connection and where we get the support we need, feel less alone, and learn & grow together. We use data-driven research to support our audience in building strong communities, defending against disinformation, and meaningfully engaging in civic life. To learn more, visit .

Employees of Galvanize USA also work part-time for a coordinated 501(c)(4) project, Galvanize Action. Galvanize Action identifies, engages, and moves moderate women in rural, small town, and suburban America to reliably support progress. To learn more, visit galvanizeaction.org.

Hiring Statement

Galvanize USA is a project of Hopewell Fund, a 501(c)(3) public charity that incubates new and innovative public-interest projects and grant-making programs. Hopewell Fund is committed to attracting, developing and retaining exceptional people, and to creating a work environment that is dynamic, rewarding and enables each of us to realize our potential. Hopewell Fund’s work environment is safe and open to all employees and partners, respecting the full spectrum of race, color, religious creed, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, political affiliation, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and all other classifications protected by law in the locality and/or state in which you are working.

Galvanize Action is a project of Sixteen Thirty Fund, a 501(c)(4) social welfare organization.

E-Verify

Hopewell participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with employees’ Form I-9 information to confirm authorization to work in the United States. Job candidates and employees authorized to work may not be discriminated against on the basis of national origin or citizenship status.

title: Physical Therapist (PT) – Mobile/Home-Based Care
description:
Overview

We are seeking a skilled, compassionate, and dependable Physical Therapist (PT) to provide high-quality physical therapy services to patients in their homes throughout the Las Vegas region.

The Physical Therapist will travel to patients' homes to perform comprehensive evaluations, develop individualized plans of care, provide skilled therapeutic interventions, monitor patient progress, and educate patients and caregivers on strategies to improve mobility, function, safety, and independence.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in a home-based environment, has strong clinical judgment and communication skills, and is passionate about delivering patient-centered care.

This is a 1099 independent contractor position.

Duties and Responsibilities

· Travel to patients' homes throughout the assigned service area to provide physical therapy services.

· Perform comprehensive physical therapy evaluations in the patient's home environment.

· Assess strength, range of motion, balance, gait, mobility, coordination, endurance, pain, functional limitations, and ability to safely perform activities of daily living.

· Evaluate the patient's home environment and identify potential safety and fall risks that may impact mobility and independence.

· Develop individualized plans of care based on evaluation findings, physician orders/referrals, patient needs, clinical judgment, and functional goals.

· Establish measurable short-term and long-term functional goals.

· Provide skilled physical therapy interventions appropriate to the patient's diagnosis and functional limitations, including:

o Therapeutic exercises

o Therapeutic activities

o Neuromuscular re-education

o Gait and mobility training

o Balance and coordination training

o Functional strengthening

o Manual therapy when clinically appropriate

o Transfer training

o Fall prevention and safety training

· Train patients in the safe use of assistive devices such as walkers, canes, and other mobility equipment.

· Develop and instruct patients in individualized home exercise programs.

· Educate patients and caregivers regarding diagnosis, treatment, exercises, mobility, safety, fall prevention, and strategies to promote independence.

· Monitor patient response to treatment and make appropriate clinical modifications to the plan of care.

· Perform reassessments and communicate changes in patient condition or functional status as appropriate.

· Coordinate care with physicians, nurses, caregivers, physical therapist assistants, occupational therapists, and other healthcare professionals.

· Communicate effectively with referring providers regarding patient progress, concerns, and recommendations.

· Complete accurate, timely, and thorough documentation for evaluations, daily treatment visits, reassessments, progress reports, and discharge summaries.

· Maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations, professional standards, payer requirements, and company policies.

· Recognize changes in patient condition that may require physician notification, additional medical evaluation, or modification of treatment.

· Maintain patient confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries at all times.

· Provide compassionate, respectful, and professional care to patients and their families in the home setting.

Requirements

· Current and valid California Physical Therapist license in good standing.

· Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program.

· Strong knowledge of anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, biomechanics, and rehabilitation principles.

· Strong clinical reasoning and patient assessment skills.

· Ability to independently perform comprehensive PT evaluations and develop appropriate plans of care.

· Experience treating patients with orthopedic, musculoskeletal, neurological, balance, gait, weakness, mobility, and/or functional limitations preferred.

· Strong knowledge of therapeutic exercise, gait training, balance training, functional mobility, neuromuscular re-education, and fall prevention.

· Excellent patient assessment and acute/chronic pain management skills.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work independently and effectively manage a mobile patient caseload.

· Must be punctual, dependable, organized, and professional.

· Comfortable entering and providing care in patients' homes and working with patients and caregivers in a home-based environment.

· Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.

· Ability to travel throughout the assigned service area.

· CPR/BLS certification preferred or required according to company policy.

· Previous home health, mobile therapy, outpatient, orthopedic, neurological, geriatric, or community-based experience is preferred.

Mobile/Home-Based Care Expectations

Because this position involves providing care in patients' homes, the Physical Therapist must be able to:

· Arrive at scheduled visits within the expected timeframe.

· Manage travel time and maintain an efficient daily schedule.

· Carry and transport necessary clinical equipment and supplies.

· Adapt treatment approaches to different home environments and available space.

· Maintain a safe and professional environment during every patient visit.

· Communicate promptly regarding cancellations, scheduling changes, or patient concerns.

· Respect patients' homes, privacy, routines, and individual preferences.

· Demonstrate sound clinical judgment when working independently in the community.

Documentation and Compliance

The Physical Therapist is responsible for completing all required clinical documentation accurately and within established timeframes, including:

· Initial evaluations

· Treatment notes

· Reassessments

· Progress reports

· Recertifications, when applicable

· Discharge documentation

· Home exercise programs

· Communication with referring providers

· Other documentation required by the organization, payer, or applicable regulations

Job Type

Full-time – 1099 Independent Contractor

Pay Structure (1099)

· Guaranteed base pay: $1,080 per week

· Base compensation is calculated at $45 per patient visit, based on a minimum of 6 patient visits per day.

· $45 per additional patient visit for visits beyond the daily base of 6.

· Compensation is subject to the terms of the independent contractor agreement.

Schedule

4/10 Schedule

· Four 10-hour workdays per week

· Typical start time: 7:30 AM–8:30 AM, depending on patient scheduling and geographic coverage.

· Daily schedule may vary based on patient locations, visit duration, and patient needs.

Work Location

Mobile/Home-Based –Las Vegas Region

The Physical Therapist will travel to assigned patients' homes throughout the designated service area.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a clinically confident, compassionate, and self-motivated Physical Therapist who enjoys working one-on-one with patients and families. The successful candidate will be comfortable making clinical decisions independently, adapting treatment to the patient's home environment, and providing high-quality care while maintaining excellent documentation and communication.

This position is an excellent opportunity for a Physical Therapist who values autonomy, flexibility, meaningful patient relationships, and community-based care

title: M62- Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for a portfolio of enterprise digital products and platforms.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role combining full stack development, technical leadership, application maintenance, architecture, and modernisation. You will work across multiple applications, programming languages, and codebases — ranging from legacy systems to modern technology stacks.

You will serve as a technical anchor for the portfolio, taking ownership of application stability, engineering quality, architecture decisions, and technical direction while remaining actively involved in coding and delivery.

You will also guide other engineers, establish engineering standards, and coordinate with product teams, business stakeholders, and technical teams on priorities, risks, migrations, and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Own the overall technical health and engineering quality of a portfolio of digital products.
  • Provide technical direction across multiple applications, languages, and codebases.
  • Make sound architecture and design decisions based on scalability, maintainability, security, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate technical trade-offs when modernising, migrating, or maintaining existing systems.
  • Identify technical risks and drive appropriate remediation plans.

Full Stack Development & Application Support

  • Design, develop, review, and deliver frontend and backend application changes.
  • Maintain and enhance existing applications across both modern and legacy technology stacks.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production and application issues.
  • Deliver bug fixes, security patches, infrastructure updates, and technical improvements.
  • Provide L2/L3 application support and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Ensure applications remain stable, secure, performant, and maintainable.

Migration & Modernisation

  • Lead application migration, modernisation, and technology upgrade initiatives.
  • Drive the transition of legacy applications and components to newer architectures and platforms.
  • Assess technical dependencies and determine appropriate migration approaches.
  • Coordinate migration activities across engineering, product, and stakeholder teams.
  • Support application retirement, transition, and technical handover where required.

Engineering Standards & Mentoring

  • Establish and maintain engineering standards for code quality, testing, code reviews, releases, and deployment.
  • Conduct code reviews and ensure appropriate engineering quality gates are followed.
  • Mentor and guide other engineers through technical reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.
  • Promote good engineering practices across the development lifecycle.

Cloud, DevOps & Observability

  • Support applications running within cloud-hosted and containerised environments.
  • Work with Docker and CI/CD pipelines to support reliable application delivery.
  • Analyse application logs, metrics, and system behaviour using AWS services such as ECS and CloudWatch.
  • Use observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry for tracing, metrics, and logs.
  • Drive improvements to application monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational resilience.

Documentation & Cross-Team Coordination

  • Maintain architecture documentation, technical notes, runbooks, and handover materials.
  • Ensure sufficient technical documentation exists to support long-term maintainability and knowledge transfer.
  • Coordinate with engineers, product teams, business stakeholders, and external partners.
  • Communicate technical risks, dependencies, priorities, and delivery considerations clearly to stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Minimum 7 years of hands-on Full Stack Software Engineering experience, including experience in a Senior or Lead Engineer capacity.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
  • Strong hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks, preferably React.
  • Strong experience designing and developing backend APIs and services.
  • Experience working with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.
  • Proven ability to navigate, troubleshoot, and enhance applications across multiple languages and codebases.
  • Experience working with both modern and legacy systems.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and application design principles.
  • Ability to make technical and architectural decisions and evaluate engineering trade-offs.
  • Solid knowledge of cloud-hosted applications and infrastructure.
  • Experience with Docker and containerised deployments.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.
  • Experience troubleshooting applications using logs, metrics, tracing, and monitoring tools.
  • Familiarity with AWS ECS, CloudWatch, and/or OpenTelemetry.
  • Strong proficiency with Git, code reviews, testing practices, and engineering quality gates.
  • Deep understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Experience coordinating technical work across multiple teams and mentoring less experienced engineers.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting large-scale or business-critical digital platforms.
  • Experience leading application modernisation or migration initiatives.
  • Experience with legacy system migration, transition, or retirement.
  • Experience providing L2/L3 production support for enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with secure coding practices, security patching, and compliance requirements.
  • Previous experience working within complex, highly regulated, or large-scale environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Technical leadership: Able to provide direction and influence engineering decisions across teams.
  • Self-directed: Comfortable taking ownership and leading without close supervision.
  • Pragmatic: Makes sensible engineering trade-offs between speed, quality, risk, and maintainability.
  • Adaptable: Comfortable navigating changing priorities, legacy environments, and system transitions.
  • Collaborative: Builds strong working relationships with engineers, product teams, stakeholders, and external partners.
  • Mentoring mindset: Willing to guide and develop other engineers through reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.
  • Ownership-driven: Takes responsibility for the stability, security, quality, and technical direction of the products under their care.

description:

About JOLT

JOLT is disrupting two industries at once, EV charging infrastructure and out-of-home advertising, across five markets, with a team that moves fast to test and deliver exciting new innovations. We don't operate like a traditional software company, and we don't want engineers who think like one.

We're building something genuinely new: an AI-native engineering culture where agentic systems, automated workflows, and intelligent tooling compound our output every week. The infrastructure we've built in the last year has transformed how the business operates. This role is about accelerating that, taking real ownership of the systems that power JOLT across markets, charging networks, and commercial partnerships.

This isn't a role for someone who just wants to close tickets. It's for a lateral thinker who looks at a manual process and immediately designs the system that makes it disappear, someone who builds like an owner and ships with confidence.



AI & Automation

Design, build, and maintain AI-driven workflows that automate real business processes — LLM integration, MCP servers, agentic pipelines, and automated ops tooling. You own technical execution end-to-end, guided by product direction.

title: Associate Technician – GE 1.5
description:
Deutsche Windtechnik (DWT) is Germany’s largest Independent Service Provider, offering a comprehensive service package for Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) from one single source.

What makes us stand out from other service companies? We offer everything from A to Z and match that with a passion for all technical services related to wind power. The objective of our engineers and technicians is to individually increase efficiency and to keep availability high at all times. It is our objective to achieve the best possible technical operation for our client’s systems and in turn offer cost-effective solutions.

We do everything possible to keep the wind turbines up and running and improve their performance, for the long term.

Deutsche Windtechnik is entering its fifth year of operations in the United States, and is headquartered in Houston, TX. As the largest and most reputable independent service provider in Germany, it is our objective to transfer and improve the same level of quality, safety, efficiency and customer service to the US market. Deutsche Windtechnik aims to become the strongest independent service provider in the US within the next 5 years, and you can be part of this success!

SCHEDULE:
Typically, from 7am to 4:30pm, Monday through Friday, some weekends and shift work. Usually, 40 hours per week with 30 minutes/1 hour lunch break unless arrangements have been agreed to by the employer and the employee. 20-25% travel required.

JOB SUMMARY:

This is a skilled position; Employees in this role perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems, understands schematics and uses appropriate diagnostic tools. The successful candidate will interpret fault reports, maintain power generation reports, service logs in the computer database, and monitor turbine performance.

ASSOCIATE TECHNICIAN SUMMARY

The technician should be able understand and utilize Deutsche Windtechnik documentation to include basic drawings and schematics, work procedures, equipment, tooling and machinery associated with routine wind turbine operation and maintenance. It expected that the technician will learn basic electrical and mechanical maintenance skills such that they will be able to perform maintenance related tasks independently, as well as provide adequate assistance to more experienced technicians in the performance of routine activities.

DEUTSCHE WINDTECHNIK CULTURE: At Deutsche Windtechnik, what sets us apart is our intense focus on our customers, employees and culture. Our Mission is to be the most trusted O&M partner to wind farm owners, while Our Vision is to empower the Americas‘ achievement of 100% renewable energy, one wind turbine at a time. How do we accomplish this? By building a team and a culture with the core values that are Transparent, Innovative, Guiding (advisor and partner), Efficient (cost conscious) and Rapid (agile and bold).

MENTAL DEMANDS:

  • Read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals
  • Write routine reports and correspondence
  • Understand and follow customary instructions in order to perform the essential functions of the position in a satisfactory manner
  • Read and interpret blueprints and schematics
  • Deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations
  • Work with minimal supervision, given proper instructions

PHYSICAL DEMAND CLASSIFICATION:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to: stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear.
  • The employee must be capable of lifting and/or moving up to 100 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Employee must be physically fit enough to free climb 250 ft multiple times a day while wearing 25+ lbs. of climbing gear under extraordinary weather conditions.
  • Must be capable of rescuing team mate anywhere in tower in the event of emergency. Must be able to work in extreme weather conditions.

DESCRIPTION OF TASKS:

  • The provision of preventative and corrective maintenance on GE 1.5 wind turbines as per DWT instructions
  • Completion of all relevant paperwork, including work order cards, checklists, etc.
  • Ensure all health and safety procedures are followed
  • Performs scheduled maintenance as required
  • Performs unscheduled maintenance consisting of troubleshooting on mechanical, hydraulic and electrical systems
  • Assist large corrective teams with replacement of major turbine components e.g. generators and gearboxes
  • Assist in all areas of site operations
  • Provide safe access and egress to all people in the work party
  • Establish and maintain general safety from the system/Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO)
  • Comply with Deutsche Windtechnik policies and procedures and customer site rules
  • Report all incidents and occurrences as per Deutsche Windtechnik Company Health and Safety policy
  • Performs routine preventive maintenance on wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems (under direction and supervision, if needed)
  • Performs wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems troubleshooting and repairs
  • Recognizes occurrences of wind turbine error codes and appropriately reports the problem
  • Assists with removal and installation of wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic components
  • Assists with heavy equipment (crane) rigging and directing
  • Performs wind turbine controller maintenance and repair
  • Completes required reports and other paperwork, some of which require computer entry
  • Assists with high-voltage system maintenance and repair
  • Maintains adherence to company policies, safety standards and good housekeeping practices
  • Maintains proper care of company tools and vehicles
  • Demonstrates the ability to learn advanced troubleshooting and repair of the wind turbines

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS:

  • High School Graduate/GED
  • Associate Degree preferred (not required)
  • Persons with Wind Energy Certifications, Military Experience, electrical and mechanical experience are highly encouraged to apply.
  • Experience 0 + 2 years in Wind Energy, electrical, mechanical and technical equipment
  • Valid driving license (NON CDL/CDL)
  • Must be able to pass a physical exam and drug/alcohol screening
  • Must be able to climb and work atop freestanding wind turbine towers that exceed 250 ft in height

EQUIPMENT, MACHINES, TOOLS USED:

Electrical Testing Equipment, Torque Wrench, Crane Rigging, Scada Systems, Computer, Computer Software, Scanner, Printer, Telephone, Copier, Fax Machine

DESCRIPTION OF WORK ENVIRONMENT:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; particulate matter and outside weather conditions. The employee can be exposed to risks of electrical hazards. The employee is occasionally exposed to hazardous chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee filling this position. Employee will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by management. Management has the right to add to, revise, or delete information in this job description. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an “at will” employment relationship.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
Deutsche Windtechnik is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, family responsibilities, pregnancy, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, transgender, sex stereotyping, protected veteran or military status, and other categories protected by federal, state or local law.

EEO is the Law
Applicants and employees are protected under Federal law from discrimination.

Whenever employees are working, operating DWT supplied vehicles, on DWT premises, or are conducting DWT related work off-site, they are prohibited from:

· Using, possessing, buying, selling, manufacturing or dispensing an illegal drug (to include possession of drug paraphernalia);

· Having alcohol or an illegal drug in their system; and

· Possessing or consuming alcohol.

title: Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) – Mobile/Home-Based Care
description:
Overview
We are seeking a skilled, compassionate, and dependable Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to provide high-quality physical therapy services to patients in their homes throughout the Jacksonville region.

The Physical Therapist Assistant will work under the direction and supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist to provide skilled therapeutic interventions, implement established plans of care, monitor patient response and progress, reinforce home exercise programs, and educate patients and caregivers on strategies to improve mobility, function, safety, and independence.
The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently within the scope of PTA practice in a home-based environment, has strong communication and interpersonal skills, and is passionate about delivering patient-centered care.
This is a 1099 independent contractor position.

Duties and Responsibilities
  • Travel to patients' homes throughout the assigned service area to provide physical therapy treatment under the direction of the supervising Physical Therapist.
  • Review the patient's established plan of care, treatment goals, precautions, and relevant clinical information prior to providing treatment.
  • Provide skilled physical therapy interventions in accordance with the Physical Therapist's plan of care, including:
    • Therapeutic exercises
    • Therapeutic activities
    • Neuromuscular re-education
    • Gait and mobility training
    • Balance and coordination training
    • Functional strengthening
    • Transfer training
    • Fall prevention and safety training
    • Manual therapy when appropriate and within the PTA's scope of practice
    • Functional mobility and activity training
  • Assist patients with improving strength, range of motion, balance, coordination, endurance, gait, mobility, and functional performance.
  • Train patients in the safe and appropriate use of assistive devices such as walkers, canes, and other mobility equipment as directed by the Physical Therapist.
  • Implement and reinforce individualized home exercise programs established by the Physical Therapist.
  • Educate patients and caregivers regarding prescribed exercises, mobility strategies, safety precautions, fall prevention, positioning, transfers, and strategies to promote independence.
  • Monitor patient response to treatment and recognize changes in pain, functional status, mobility, tolerance, or overall condition.
  • Communicate significant changes in patient condition, response to treatment, progress, concerns, or barriers to the supervising Physical Therapist in a timely manner.
  • Provide feedback to the Physical Therapist regarding patient progress and response to the established plan of care.
  • Assist the Physical Therapist with reassessments and other clinical follow-up activities as appropriate and permitted within the PTA's scope of practice.
  • Modify treatment activities within the established plan of care as appropriate and within the PTA's scope of practice, while communicating clinically significant changes to the supervising Physical Therapist.
  • Reinforce proper body mechanics, transfer techniques, positioning, and safety strategies with patients and caregivers.
  • Adapt treatment approaches to the patient's home environment, available space, equipment, functional abilities, and individual needs while following the established plan of care.
  • Coordinate care and communicate professionally with Physical Therapists, physicians, nurses, caregivers, occupational therapists, and other healthcare professionals as appropriate.
  • Communicate promptly regarding patient concerns, cancellations, scheduling changes, or other issues that may affect care.
  • Complete accurate, timely, and thorough documentation for daily treatment visits and other required clinical documentation.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations, professional standards, payer requirements, PTA supervision requirements, and company policies.
  • Recognize changes in patient condition that may require notification of the supervising Physical Therapist, referring provider, or other healthcare professional.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries at all times.
  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and professional care to patients and their families in the home setting.


Requirements
  • Current and valid Physical Therapist Assistant license in good standing.
  • Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program.
  • Strong knowledge of anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, biomechanics, therapeutic exercise, and rehabilitation principles.
  • Strong understanding of physical therapy treatment techniques and functional mobility principles.
  • Ability to safely and effectively implement a Physical Therapist's established plan of care.
  • Knowledge of therapeutic exercise, gait training, balance training, functional mobility, neuromuscular re-education, strengthening, transfer training, and fall prevention.
  • Strong observation and patient monitoring skills.
  • Ability to recognize and appropriately communicate changes in patient condition or functional status.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively manage a mobile patient caseload while maintaining appropriate communication with the supervising Physical Therapist.
  • Must be punctual, dependable, organized, and professional.
  • Comfortable entering and providing care in patients' homes and working with patients and caregivers in a home-based environment.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.
  • Ability to travel throughout the assigned service area.
  • CPR/BLS certification preferred or required according to company policy.
  • Previous home health, mobile therapy, outpatient, orthopedic, neurological, geriatric, or community-based experience is preferred.


Mobile/Home-Based Care Expectations
Because this position involves providing care in patients' homes, the Physical Therapist Assistant must be able to:
  • Arrive at scheduled visits within the expected timeframe.
  • Manage travel time and maintain an efficient daily schedule.
  • Carry and transport necessary clinical equipment and supplies.
  • Adapt treatment approaches to different home environments and available space.
  • Maintain a safe and professional environment during every patient visit.
  • Communicate promptly regarding cancellations, scheduling changes, patient concerns, or changes in patient status.
  • Respect patients' homes, privacy, routines, and individual preferences.
  • Demonstrate sound clinical judgment within the PTA's scope of practice when working independently in the community.
  • Maintain appropriate communication with the supervising Physical Therapist regarding patient progress, concerns, and changes in condition.


Documentation and Compliance
The Physical Therapist Assistant is responsible for completing all required clinical documentation accurately and within established timeframes, including:
  • Daily treatment notes
  • Patient response to treatment
  • Progress toward established functional goals
  • Exercises and interventions performed
  • Patient and caregiver education
  • Home exercise program instruction and reinforcement
  • Communication with the supervising Physical Therapist
  • Documentation of changes in patient condition or functional status
  • Other documentation required by the organization, payer, supervising Physical Therapist, or applicable regulations


The PTA must practice within the scope of the Florida Physical Therapist Assistant license and applicable supervision requirements and must follow the established plan of care developed by the supervising Physical Therapist.

Job Type
Full-time – 1099 Independent Contractor

Pay Structure (1099)
  • Guaranteed base pay: $840 per week
  • Base compensation is calculated at $35 per patient visit, based on a minimum of 6 patient visits per day.
  • $35 per additional patient visit for visits beyond the daily base of 6.
  • Compensation is subject to the terms of the independent contractor agreement.
Schedule
4/10 Schedule
  • Four 10-hour workdays per week
  • Typical start time: 7:30 AM–8:30 AM, depending on patient scheduling and geographic coverage.
  • Daily schedule may vary based on patient locations, visit duration, and patient needs.


Work Location
Mobile/Home-Based –Jacksonville Region
The Physical Therapist Assistant will travel to assigned patients' homes throughout the designated service area.

Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is a clinically capable, compassionate, dependable, and self-motivated Physical Therapist Assistant who enjoys working one-on-one with patients and families.
The successful candidate will be comfortable providing care in patients' homes, implementing established plans of care, adapting treatment activities to the patient's home environment, monitoring patient response, communicating effectively with the supervising Physical Therapist, and maintaining excellent documentation.
This position is an excellent opportunity for a Physical Therapist Assistant who values autonomy, flexibility, meaningful patient relationships, and community-based care while working as an integral member of a collaborative physical therapy team.

title: Senior Project Manager

title: Language Compliance Strategist
description:
Description and purpose of the role:
The WestJet Translation Services team is looking for a Language Compliance Strategist to manage a high volume of requests submitted by internal teams, with a strong focus on heavy post-editing of machine-translated content from English into Canadian French.
The successful candidate will review, correct and improve machine-translated content to ensure it is accurate, natural, appropriate for the context, and aligned with WestJet’s terminology and quality standards. This includes rewriting content when necessary, improving structure and readability, and determining when content requires full human translation or, in certain cases, transcreation.
This WestJetter is an experienced language professional who can work efficiently in a technology-enabled environment while providing practical guidance and support to client teams, project teams, frontline employees and WestJetters across the organization.

Key deliverables include:

Manage a high daily volume of words across multiple projects and content types (e.g., policies, procedures, training documents, etc.) while meeting tight deadlines and maintaining high linguistic quality.
Determine whether content requires post-editing, translation, or adaptation.
Translate, proofread, and adapt content when machine translation is unsuitable.
Maintain translation memories, termbases, and style guides, and improve language workflows and machine translation output.
Use tools such as Trados and Language Weaver.
Provide language guidance and collaborate with internal teams.

Professional qualifications:

At least 3 to 6 years of experience in English-to-French translation, editing or language services, with a demonstrated ability to manage high daily volumes of content in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high-quality standards and meeting multiple competing deadlines.
Strong experience with heavy post-editing of machine-translated content into publication-ready Canadian French.
Sound judgment in choosing between post-editing, translation, rewriting, and adaptation.
Exceptional French editing, rewriting and proofreading skills.
Ability to evaluate content ecosystems, workflows and governance models to identify opportunities that advance organizational francization goals.
Experience supporting francization initiatives within large, complex organizations operating in regulated environments is an asset.
Experience working with AI-powered language solutions to support translation, post-editing, content adaptation and linguistic quality assurance, with the ability to assess their effectiveness and appropriate use cases.
Strong knowledge of the French-Canadian language and culture.
Advanced experience with translation and machine-translation tools, including Trados and Language Weaver.
Degree in Translation, or a Translation Certificate combined with significant professional experience.

title: BI Analytics Engineer
description: About the roleLifetime Brands is looking for a BI Analytics Engineer to build the data products our business runs on — and to make sure people actually use them. You own reporting end to end: the pipelines that move the data, the models that shape it, and the dashboards that put it in front of decision-makers.Our data team supports 500+ users and 150+ production reports on a modern stack — Airbyte for ingestion, Snowflake as the warehouse, dbt Core for transformation, and Qlik Sense for reporting across both client- managed and Qlik Cloud. You don't need to have used every piece of it. You need to have done this kind of work somewhere, and be able to pick up the rest.The immediate focus is a major retail reporting buildout — POS and sell-through, replenishment, inventory, and on-shelf availability for one of our largest accounts — alongside a longer-running migration of legacy reporting onto dbt and Snowflake. a growing program with real room to shape how it gets built.What you will do• Partner with business stakeholders to turn open-ended questions into clear reporting requirements and meaningful KPIs.• Design and build Qlik Sense apps — load scripts, set analysis, master items — that are governed, documented, and trustworthy enough for people to use on their own.• Develop, test, and document transformation models in dbt Core on Snowflake, following dimensional modeling best practices.• Build and maintain ingestion pipelines into Snowflake with Airbyte, including incremental and CDC patterns from sources such as MSSQL/Azure SQL and SAP.• Maintain and extend our code-based pipelines — Python scripts orchestrated through scheduled GitHub Actions workflows.• Own data quality, monitoring, and reliability for everything you build, and help hold that standard across the wider reporting estate.• Act as a bridge between the BI team and the rest of the business on data sources, data access, and what's available to report on.• Teach. Show non-technical teams how to use what you've built, and bring new tools and practices back to the BI team.• Maintain documentation for the systems, processes, and decisions behind your work.• Work in Git and follow our code review and CI/CD practices.What we are looking for• 4+ years in BI engineering, analytics engineering, or data engineering — with genuine ownership of reporting, not pipelines alone.• Expert SQL and a strong grasp of dimensional and data modeling.• Production experience transforming data in a cloud warehouse. dbt on Snowflake is our stack; close equivalents count.• You've built and owned dashboards a real business audience relied on. Qlik Sense experience is a significant advantage.• Comfortable working independently and end to end, from source system to finished report.• Excellent verbal and written communication — you can explain a complex data problem to someone who doesn't work in data.• Careful, methodical troubleshooting and close attention to detail.• Bachelor's degree in a STEM field, or equivalent practical experience.Nice to have• Deep Qlik Sense expertise: load scripting, set analysis, security rules, and QMC administration across on-prem and Qlik Cloud.• Retail or CPG background — retailer data portals, syndicated and POS data sources (Circana, NielsenIQ), and EDI workflows.• Familiarity with SAP data: ECC table structures, BW InfoProviders, and IDoc/EDI extraction.• Strong Python for pipeline development, automation, and API integrations.• Experience with a modern ELT tool such as Airbyte, Fivetran, or Stitch, including CDC-based replication.• Experience supporting a large, multi-tenant reporting environment.Your first 90 daysYou'll have ramped on our stack and shipped your first reporting deliverable end to end — source system to dashboard — tested and documented well enough that the rest of the team can build on it

title: Medical Coordinator (LVN) - Per Diem
description:
“Every person deserves compassion, dignity, and the safety of a place to call home.”
Homelessness is the largest social and public health crisis in California. Illumination Health + Home is a growing non-profit organization dedicated towards disrupting the cycle of homelessness by providing targeted, interdisciplinary services in our recuperative care centers, emergency shelters, housing services and children's and family programs. IHH currently has 13+ facilities with 22+ micro-communities scattered across Orange County, Los Angeles County and the Inland Empire.

Job Description

The Medical Coordinator (LVN) is responsible for delivering high quality medical care and influencing positive outcomes for patients experiencing homelessness in the recuperative care setting. We have many schedules available for this role, including weekends and nights.

  • The pay range for this position is $34.00 - $36.00 per hour, depending on experience.
  • Workdays may vary. Part Time - Per Diem position.
  • Work site may vary based on operational needs.

Responsibilities

Client Care:

  • Perform initial intake to ensure that an appropriate care plan is established based on discharge information from the hospital or primary care notes
    • Assess health status of patient upon arrival by conducting head to toe assessment and checking vitals
    • Determine the patient’s insurance status, make follow up appointments with patient’s providers and reviewing medication list
  • Establish and maintain a care plan
    • Set weekly goals for patient to complete to assist with medical or social reintegration, verify goal completion, and assess medical needs.
  • Conduct morning, afternoon, and evening checks for all assigned clients to observe wellbeing, ensuring there is no change in medical conditions since hospital discharge.
  • Link clients to medical services when necessary (insurance, PCP, specialists, referrals).
  • Coordinate home health visits (if needed) and follow-up on medical appointments.
  • Promote health literacy by providing patient education with regards to clients’ illnesses, medications, preventative measures, treatment management and overall general health.
  • Arrange transportation for clients to and from medical appointments, as needed
  • Report emergency situations to Supervisor/Manager and document incident
    • Seek proper level of care to assess and treat medical complication
    • Initiate medical response system when appropriate
  • Support patient recuperation by providing necessary items and space needed to rehabilitate and assisting with the upkeep of the facility.

Administrative/Record Keeping:

  • Enter patient information and case notes into EHR and other documentation systems.
  • Complete and update medication, vitals, progress notes and care plan
  • Perform administrative tasks such as answering phones and filing paperwork.
  • Prepare patient reports for billing.
  • Maintain proper inventory of medical supplies and medications.

Compliance/Safety:

  • Maintain confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA guidelines, Illumination Foundation policies and DHS standards.
  • Provide patients with proper compliance forms upon admission
  • Utilize infection control measures according to OSHA standards.
  • Conduct medication reconciliation and ensure proper disposal and pickup of bio-medical/pharmaceutical waste.
  • Maintain a safe work environment by ensuring the cleanliness of the med room, wound care room, and medication storage room.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Current and non-restricted LVN license in California
  • 2 years of relevant experience.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Basic computer skills, including the ability to send and receive emails and summarize data in spreadsheets.
  • Valid CA Driver’s License.

Preferred:

  • Availability to work weekends and nights
  • Home Health nursing experience and experience working with populations dealing with addiction and behavioral health conditions.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, Calendar) and KIPU or other electronic health record systems.

Benefits

  • Medical Insurance funded by Illumination Health + Home (Kaiser and Blue Shield), depending on the plan
  • Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Life, AD&D and LTD Insurance funded 100% by Illumination Health + Home
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • 401K with Company Matching
  • 10 days vacation PTO/year
  • 6 days sick PTO/year
  • 10 days holiday PTO/year
  • Potential eligibility for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSFL) for federally qualified loans

title: Senior User Experience Designer
description:
About the Role
We are seeking a strategic, highly collaborative, and visionary Senior UX Designer for a full-time position on the Savvas UX Design team. In this role, you will lead the resolution of our most complex and ambiguous design challenges across our K–12 educational technology platforms. You will bring deep expertise in user-centered methodologies, large-scale user experience strategy, advanced visual design, and robust design systems, while mentoring team members and establishing high-quality design standards.

The UX Design team is responsible for our design system and platform functionality, covering assignments, assessments, data visualizations, reporting dashboards, administrative and operations workflows, and AI-powered teaching and learning experiences across our K–12 educational products.

What You’ll Do

End-to-End Strategic Design: Lead and define the UX strategy and execution for high-impact, foundational product initiatives, scaling methodologies across our multi-product ecosystem as needs evolve.

User-Centered Advocacy & Leadership: Champion an unyielding human-centric approach across the organization. Mentor others in user advocacy, ensuring all high-level product decisions are deeply rooted in real user needs, validated usability principles, and systematic feedback loops.

Advanced AI Feature Design: Architect intuitive, trust-building experiences for complex AI-driven capabilities. Define standard patterns ensuring AI outputs, limits, and insights are completely transparent, explainable, and contextually integrated into the user's natural workflow.

Design System Evolution: Thoughtfully govern, scale, and contribute to our design system to guarantee absolute visual and interaction consistency across all platforms and products.

Strategic Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner as a peer with leadership across Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to influence strategic roadmaps, negotiate technical feasibility, and drive the delivery of exceptional solutions.

Mentorship & Design Culture: Actively coach and mentor mid-level and junior designers, raising the bar for craftsmanship, critical thinking, and design excellence across the team.

What You Bring

Experience: 6+ years of end-to-end UX/Product Design experience leading complex initiatives across the full product development lifecycle.

Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating a proven track record of breaking down highly complex, ambiguous enterprise problems into elegant, concrete, and scalable design systems and solutions.

AI Product Mastery: Deep practical experience designing and shipping successful features that leverage advanced machine learning or AI capabilities within digital products.

AI-Enhanced Workflow: Sophisticated mastery of incorporating AI-powered tools into your regular design workflow to significantly amplify exploration efficiency, asset creation, and productivity.

Design System Governance: Expert proficiency with modern design tooling (Figma), including building, maintaining, and scaling component libraries, advanced variants, and design tokens.

Interaction & Advanced Accessibility: Authoritative understanding of global accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2), deep interaction design theory, complex responsive architecture, and complex information taxonomy.

Visual Craftsmanship: Flawless visual and interface design skills with meticulous attention to typography, data-dense layouts, micro-interactions, and visual hierarchy.

Domain Expertise: Prior experience in EdTech, enterprise SaaS, or highly data-rich platforms serving multi-tiered institutional, administrative, or operational users.

title: Geographic Information Systems [GIS] Specialist - [Research & Evaluation]
description:
Organization Overview:

The Appalachian Regional Commission (ARC) is an economic development entity of the federal government and 13 state governments focusing on 423 counties across the Appalachian Region. ARC’s mission is to innovate, partner and invest to build community capacity and strengthen economic growth in Appalachia to help the Region achieve socioeconomic parity with the nation.

Position Summary:

ARC seeks a highly organized and collaborative team player to join our Research and Evaluation Division as a Geographic Information Systems [GIS] Specialist to provide support to the ARC Research and Evaluation team with a variety of data, GIS mapping, research, and evaluation assignments in support of ARC’s Strategic Plan. Position duties support the collection, management, analysis, visualization (graphically), reporting and dissemination of geographic information and knowledge in the form of maps, databases, reports, and applications. The Research and Evaluation team conducts work, both internally and externally via commissioned contracts, to describe socioeconomic conditions in Appalachia, analyze economic development trends in Appalachia, understand geographic areas of need, and document and evaluate ARC’s programmatic investments. This information is used for ARC policy documents, workshops and events, press releases, research reports, evaluation studies, web site content, and other venues. This position works closely with the GIS Manager and the Team on database, cartographic, research, and evaluation projects to support a variety of assignments at various stages of implementation, as directed.

Required Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of research methods, quantitative analysis, general data analysis and familiarity with statistics and social sciences (economics, geography, sociology, etc.).
  • Proven knowledge of GIS mapping software (specifically Esri's ArGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online) and other data processing procedures for designing, planning and producing geographic information.
  • Strong skills presenting complex analysis and results to research team, managers, and staff across the organization as well as with external vendors and contractors using data visualizations (i.e. charts, tables, and graphs) on various software platforms.
  • Adept research methods and tools to create efficiency for reporting, GIS mapping and other analytical and computational processes.
  • Project management experience including the ability to develop and follow project timelines and deliverables.
  • Core competencies: accountability, adaptability, collaboration, communication, critical analysis.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative environment and bring an energetic and innovative approach to his or her work.
  • Bachelor's degree in geography, economics, regional planning, computer science or other related fields.
  • 0-2 years of relevant GIS experience.
  • Successful completion (prior to hire) and maintenance of background security review.
  • Ability to travel (~10%). If travel is needed, must maintain and possess a valid driver’s license.

Why ARC?
Great Benefits: ARC offers a collaborative work environment and a competitive benefits package which includes health insurance, 401(k), paid time off, commuting subsidy, and professional development This is not a federal position, however, if a federal employee is selected for this position and transfers without a break in service of more than three calendar days, he or she may be able to continue his or her retirement and life/health insurance benefits. ARC generally follows the General Schedule Salary Table of the Federal government. ARC’s grades denoted by “NF” are equivalent to the GS chart. This position is an NF-10 (locality). This position is located in Washington, DC and requires five “in-person” days in the office.

Strong Mission: Curious about the work we do at ARC? Read more about our strategic plan, Appalachia Envisioned, to check out our goals. Our team is dedicated to innovation, partnerships, and investments in the Appalachian Region to help achieve socioeconomic parity with the nation.

Equal Employment Policy
ARC is an equal employment opportunity employer and endeavors to make reasonable accommodations to the known physical or mental limitations of qualified applicants with a disability unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of ARC’s business. If an applicant believes he or she requires such assistance to complete the application or to participate in an interview, he or she should contact the Director, Human Resources. If an applicant has any questions or concerns, he or she should reach out to the Lisa Pansegrouw, Director, Human Resources at 202.884.7770 or at hr@arc.gov
