title: Field Superintendent
description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The Field Superintendent coordinates shipping, erection, field finishing, and other miscellaneous subcontractor activities with the general contractor, other project trades, and Metromont’s project team. Serves as the main point of contact between Metromont, its subcontractors, the general contractor and other members of the project team for all job site related activities.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Attend pre-construction, job site, and other meetings required to represent Metromont until Metromont’s activities in the field are complete
Coordinate Metromont’s sequence of field activities and the schedule of those activities with the general contractor, other trades on the project, and Metromont’s production and haul departments
Confirm with the general contractor that the site is sufficiently prepared before erection to support the agreed upon sequence and schedule of Metromont’s field activities including but not limited to: site access, trailer storage, crane pads and access, survey of embed plates prior to erection, coordination with other trades, etc.
Monitor compliance with Metromont’s Standard Erection Agreement and all jobsite specific requirements
Coordinate with the erector the submittal of the stability plan; setup stability review meeting within the required time frame prior to erection
Monitor Metromont’s subcontract erector for adherence to the agreed upon stability plan during construction; this includes monitoring the erector for compliance to Metromont’s backwelding and grouting standards for the project
Monitor and confirm that the erector has completed erection sequence prior to start of the project and that five day look ahead schedules are submitted in a timely manner
Setup and conduct the internal pre-erection meeting at least two weeks prior to erection start
Assure Metromont’s erector maintains the erected structure to within acceptable tolerances and is not creating extra work by damaging product during the erection phase
Monitor the erector for compliance with Metromont field safety standards and the overall site safety plan. Responsible to address any safety deficiencies and serve as Metromont’s representative to the general contractor on all field safety related issues; confirm that the erector is conducting weekly “Tool Box Talks” and that they are being submitted to Metromont
Submit repair detail requests, coordinate approval by the general contractor and/or other parties as needed, and facilitate the supply of materials and labor needed to complete on site repairs
Coordinate welding inspections through General Contractor
Provide feedback to Metromont’s production and project management teams regarding the quality of the product and erection hardware, etc.
Coordinate and schedule Metromont’s field finishing and other post erection subcontractor activities with the general contractor and other trades
Monitor the field finishing subcontractor and other subcontractors as required to perform the project’s scope of work for compliance with Metromont’s field safety standards and the site-specific safety program; address any safety deficiencies and serve as Metromont’s representative to the general contractor on all field safety related issues
Develop Metromont’s punch list of items to be completed before requesting a punch list from the general contractor and/or architect; once the subcontractor/architect punch list is issued, the field superintendent is responsible for completing that punch list per the agreed upon schedule and documenting completion of the project punch list
Submit daily reports as required by the General Contractor for the project
Document all meeting and phone conversations in written format
Submit weekly Erection Tracking Report and Deficiencies / Issues Log
Document progression of work/issues with photos
Manage deficiencies and punch list items on General Contractors management software
Must adhere to all OSHA and Metromont safety rules and regulations.

SCOPE OF AUTHORITY

Works with minimal direct supervision
In collaboration with the Project Manager, Haul Manager, Erector, General Contractor, and other members of the project team, implements decisions related to the performance of Metromont’s scope of work on the project site
Reports to the Director or Project Management

CHARACTERISTICS (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)

Decisive, capable of facilitating cooperation in a multi-organizational team setting to achieve project objectives
Proactive and forward thinking with a focus on achieving results
Comfortable with confrontation and conflict
Responds well to changing deadlines and priorities
Capable of working independently, communicating facts logically and clearly
Understands the balance of maintaining relationships while achieving results
Obtains respect of others by performance and consistently demonstrating leadership, personal responsibility and accomplishment
Able to adapt to changes in work schedules, tasks, or processes
Values and demonstrates safe working behaviors

EDUCATION AND TECHNOLOGY

Associate degree in construction science, construction management, or concrete construction
2 years of experience in the construction industry in general contracting, precast plant operations, engineering, or other related fields
Microsoft Office, project management software (Procore, Helix, Prolog, etc)

WORK ENVIRONMENT / SCHEDULE

Typically works out of a mobile office (truck) with extensive travel by car
Hours vary depending on project needs and issues

PERSONAL PROTECTION EQUIPMENT (PPE)

Safety glasses

High-visibility vest

Hard hat

Steel-toed shoes

Hearing protection

[tab to continue adding rows for addition PPE]

PPE only required with working in the plant

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This position requires sitting and standing for long periods of time, frequent lifting and bending, repetitive motion with medium force, and an ability to frequently climb up to 15 feet using stairs.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Other duties as assigned may be required. All associates are expected to conduct themselves in a manner that is consistent with Metromont’s core values and to actively participate in all company safety, training, and observation programs.

title: Senior Edge-AI SoC Design Verification Engineer, Google Cloud
description:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

In this role, you will work as part of a Research and Development team. You will build verification components, constrained-random testing, system testing, and drive verification closure. You will verify digital designs, collaborate closely with design and verification engineers on projects, and perform direct verification. You will build constrained-random verification environments that exercise designs through their corner-cases and expose all types of bugs. You will manage the full life-cycle of verification, which can range from verification planning, test execution, to collecting and closing coverage.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

  • Plan the verification of digital design blocks by fully understanding the design specification and interacting with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios.
  • Create and enhance constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology (UVM), or formally verify designs with SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and industry leading formal tools.
  • Identify and write all types of coverage measures for corner-cases.
  • Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
  • Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with creating and using verification components and environments in standard verification methodology.
  • Experience verifying digital logic at RTL level using SystemVerilog or Specman/E for FPGAs or ASICs.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with verification techniques, and the full verification life cycle.
  • Experience with Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) standard interfaces and memory system architecture.
  • Experience with performance verification of ASICs and ASIC components.
  • Experience in four or more System on a Chip (SOC) cycles.

description:

Status: Full-Time, Vacancy

Join our Team!
Southbridge Care Homes provides exceptional acquisition, management, and redevelopment services for long-term care homes and retirement communities across Ontario. Our mission is to maintain a best-in-class portfolio that consistently delivers excellence in care and services while ensuring economic sustainability.
The Director of Care (also referred to in legislation as the Director of Nursing and Personal Care) is the regulated-health-professional leader responsible for ensuring safe, high-quality, resident-centred nursing and personal care services in the long-term care home and for ensuring the home operates in compliance with the Fixing Long-Term Care Act, 2021 and its regulations. This position provides clinical leadership, oversees nursing and PSW staffing and standards of care, directs care planning and quality improvement activities, and acts as a primary contact with the Ministry, inspectors and resident/family councils on care-related matters.
Key responsibilities

  • Lead and manage all clinical programs and nursing/personal care services (including registered nursing staff, registered practical nurses and personal support workers).
  • Ensure resident care plans are developed, implemented, reviewed and revised in accordance with professional standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure the home meets legislative and regulatory obligations under the Fixing Long-Term Care Act, 2021 and applicable regulations (including documentation, reporting and cooperation with inspections).
  • Recruit, schedule and supervise nursing staff to meet required staffing levels and skill mix; participate in workforce planning to ensure safe direct care is delivered (including adherence to provincial care-hours targets and allied professional requirements).
  • Oversee clinical quality improvement, infection prevention and control activities, medication management, wound care, pain management and other clinical programs.
  • Provide clinical leadership during incidents, outbreaks, critical events and internal/external reviews; ensure timely incident reporting and follow-up.
  • Act as the clinical representative for resident/family council meetings, when invited, and respond to clinical concerns and complaints in accordance with Ministry Long-Term Care requirements, Southbridge policy and residents’ rights.
  • Maintain collaborative relationships with the Medical Director, allied health professionals, primary care providers and community partners.
  • Ensure staff are oriented, competent and maintain required professional certifications; participate in performance management and education planning.
  • Maintain accurate clinical records and support audits, accreditation and Ministry inquiries.

Mandatory qualifications (required)

Current, active registration in good standing with the College of Nurses of Ontario (CNO) as a Registered Nurse (RN).

Minimum of 5 years’ clinical experience in long-term care, gerontology, or related nursing practice, including at least 2 years in a supervisory/leadership role (or equivalent).

Demonstrated knowledge of Ontario long-term care legislation and regulations, resident rights and standards of care

Current BLS/CPR certification

Satisfactory vulnerable sector police reference check

Preferred qualifications

Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BScN) or related .

Experience with electronic resident records (e.g., PointClickCare) and quality-improvement methodologies.

Strong leadership, communication, performance management and conflict-resolution skills; experience working with family/resident councils.

Familiarity with dementia care best practices and regulatory requirements for dementia programs.

Competencies & skills

Clinical judgment and decision-making in complex cases.

Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and to translate regulatory requirements into operational practice.

Strong organizational skills and attention to documentation, reporting and compliance.

Ability to coach and develop staff, manage performance issues and lead change.

Working conditions

Shift work to provide clinical leadership across the home; on-call responsibility for clinical matters may be required.

Fast-paced environment with frequent interaction with residents, families, staff and external stakeholders.

Must be able to perform duties with appropriate use of personal protective equipment as per IPAC requirements.

Accountability & legislative compliance

This role is accountable for ensuring the home’s nursing and personal care programs comply with the Fixing Long-Term Care Act, 2021 and the General Regulation (O. Reg. 246/22), including cooperating with inspectors, participating in mandatory reporting and supporting resident rights and family council processes. The Director of Care must ensure that staffing, care-planning and clinical programs align with the Act’s requirements.

title: Home Office - Transportation - Transportation Business Analyst
description:
We're Hiring!
Transportation Business Analyst – Adult Day Health Services

Daily Pay Available

Our Mission and You
At Active Day, we provide the highest quality personalized care to seniors and adults with special needs through fun and engaging communities built upon compassion and trust. Transportation is central to that promise— helping members safely and reliably access the care and services they need. As Business Analyst – Transportation Technology, you will help ensure our transportation technology, data, and processes support consistent, efficient, and member-centered service across the organization.

Job Summary
The Business Analyst – Transportation Technology serves as Active Day’s internal subject matter expert for Route Genie, our enterprise transportation routing and management platform. This role owns system implementation support, configuration, data integrity, training, reporting, user support, and continuous improvement across Active Day’s transportation network. A key near-term priority is supporting the continued enterprise rollout of Route Genie through the end of 2026. The role connects Transportation Operations, Center teams, Route Genie, IT, Finance, Data/Analytics, Fleet, Safety, and other internal stakeholders to ensure the system is used consistently and effectively.

Qualifications

HS Diploma required. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Analytics, Supply Chain, Transportation, Operations, or a related field strongly preferred; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
Minimum 3years of experience in business analysis, systems analysis, transportation technology, logistics, operations, or a related field strongly preferred..
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to learn and become proficient in complex software platforms.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience analyzing data, building operational reports, and presenting findings to business leaders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to train users with varying levels of technical experience.
Strong organizational and project-management capabilities; ability to manage multiple implementations and priorities across a geographically dispersed organization.
Strong attention to detail, commitment to data accuracy, and ability to translate business and operational needs into system requirements.
Experience with transportation management systems, routing, dispatch, scheduling platforms, Route Genie, or multi-site system implementations preferred.
Experience in NEMT, Adult Day Services, healthcare transportation, paratransit, Medicaid transportation, Power BI, SQL, APIs, system integrations, or route optimization preferred.

Job Responsibilities

Route Genie System Ownership & SME: Become Active Day’s primary internal subject matter expert for Route Genie. Maintain a detailed understanding of system configuration, member and facility data, vehicles, drivers, scheduling, routing, dispatch, driver applications, reporting, and system administration. Serve as the first point of contact for system questions, troubleshooting, configuration needs, and operational support.
Enterprise Implementation & Adoption: Support the continued rollout of Route Genie across remaining transportation operations. Develop implementation plans, readiness assessments, data requirements, testing plans, training schedules, go-live checklists, and post-implementation support. Coordinate with Center Directors, Transportation Coordinators, Dispatchers, Drivers, NEMT Operations, IT, and Transportation leadership.
Training & User Support: Develop and deliver standardized, role-based Route Genie training for Transportation Coordinators, Dispatchers, Drivers, Center Directors, and other users. Maintain quick reference guides, SOPs, training manuals, onboarding materials, and recurring retraining based on user needs.
Data Management & Integrity: Establish enterprise data standards and monitor the accuracy and completeness of driver, vehicle, member, route, trip, and facility data. Conduct routine audits, correct data quality issues with operating teams, and define clear ownership for ongoing data maintenance.
Reporting & Analytics: Develop recurring operational and management reporting using Route Genie data. title: Client Implementation Lead
description:
This is a full-time role as Client Implementation Lead, located onsite in New York, NY.

We're looking for a customer-facing implementation leader to own the deployment of Hadrius across some of the most sophisticated financial institutions in the world. You'll lead the team who takes customers from signed contract to fully operational, configuring Hadrius around their compliance workflows, training their teams, and getting them to value as quickly as possible.

You'll sit within the larger Customer Experience organization, reporting to the Head of Customer Experience, acting as a primary liaison between our customers and our Product and Engineering teams. You'll function as a subject matter expert on the Hadrius platform, deeply understand how each customer operates, translate their requirements into a successful implementation, and manage the day-to-day execution of each client's implementation project from kickoff through go-live.

You'll be responsible for making sure customers are successfully onboarded, trained, and fully adopting Hadrius to run their compliance programs.

You will work across the organization to design and build the future of the financial system. We pride ourselves on having a culture that rewards impact and success generously. We're focused first and foremost on empowering each other to do our best work, today and into the future. You'll be on a team that works incredibly hard and seeks other exceptional people excited to do the same.

Responsibilities

First week:

  • Develop a deep understanding of the Hadrius platform, our customers, and the compliance workflows we automate
  • Learn our existing implementation process from contract signature through go-live
  • Shadow customer onboarding, configuration, and training sessions
  • Understand the integrations, data, configuration, and workflow decisions required to successfully deploy Hadrius
  • Meet with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to understand how customers move through their lifecycle
  • Begin working directly on your first customer deployment

First month:

  • Independently own customer implementations from kickoff through successful go-live
  • Function as a subject matter expert on Hadrius, advising clients on how the platform maps to their compliance and regulatory requirements
  • Configure the platform around each customer's requirements, policies, users, and operating model
  • Conduct client training sessions and manage the day-to-day client relationship throughout onboarding
  • Coordinate integrations, data migrations, testing, and launch across customer and internal teams
  • Establish and maintain clear implementation plans, procedural documentation, owners, milestones, and success criteria with every customer
  • Communicate and manage internal and external implementation requirements and expectations

First 3 months & beyond:

  • Own a portfolio of customer implementations and consistently get customers live, adopted, and realizing value
  • Constantly evaluate implementation processes and procedures for inefficiencies, and drive improvements with internal stakeholders
  • Develop deep expertise in how RIAs, broker-dealers, asset managers, and other financial institutions operate their compliance programs
  • Become a trusted point of contact for compliance leaders, providing best-practice guidance on configuration and platform use
  • Act as the liaison between customers and Product/Engineering, communicating client requirements and feedback
  • Maintain and update procedural documentation, templates, and configuration playbooks used across deployments

About You

High agency: When a customer has a problem, you don't wait for someone else to solve it. You figure out what needs to happen and drive it through completion.

Technical: You're comfortable understanding integrations, APIs, data structures, and complex software systems. You can work directly with engineers without needing to be one.

Customer obsessed: You care deeply about whether customers actually succeed with the product, not whether you've completed an implementation checklist.

Process-oriented: You can take a complicated, ambiguous customer workflow and turn it into a clear system of requirements, decisions, owners, and actions.

Consultative: You're comfortable sitting across from a senior compliance executive, understanding how their organization operates, and recommending a better way of doing things.

Relentless executor: You move quickly, follow through, and take ownership of every detail required to get a customer live.

Product-minded: You don't solve the same problem manually ten times. You recognize patterns and work with Product and Engineering to make the underlying product better.

Clear communicator: You can make complex technical and operational topics understandable to customers and internal teams.

All-in: This is not a 9-5. We have a massive opportunity ahead of us and are looking for people excited to work incredibly hard to capture it.

Team-first mentality: You work seamlessly across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success and optimize for the customer's outcome rather than functional boundaries.

Passion for our mission: You're genuinely excited about our technology and our mission to build the future of financial compliance

Qualifications

  • 2–6 years of experience in client implementation, professional services, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or another customer-facing technical role
  • Proven ability to manage complex client implementation projects from kickoff through go-live
  • Working knowledge of database concepts, data extraction, cleansing, and analysis, along with comfort working with APIs, integrations, and enterprise software
  • Excellent customer service experience and demonstrated ability to manage client relationships throughout onboarding
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort working directly with senior client stakeholders
  • Ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into software workflows and configurations
  • Previous experience in fintech, financial services, compliance, or enterprise SaaS strongly preferred
  • Experience with software releases, upgrades, and patch deployment is a plus Bachelor's Degree preferred; computer science, information technology, or a related field is a plus

Benefits

  • 401k (100% match up to 6%)
  • Healthcare, dental, vision, etc.

title: AI Lead
description:
THE ROLE

  • Partner directly with business and product teams to identify, scope, and build agentic workflows, AI agents, and reusable skills that solve real problems
  • Advise on the platform decisions for where automations and agents are hosted (e.g. n8n, Databricks Apps, Claude-based tooling), balancing speed of delivery against maintainability, cost, and governance requirements
  • Design how agents and automations access data, working out the right layer to query from (governed semantic layer vs raw source), what permissions and guardrails should sit around that access, and how to avoid duplicating data prep or creating shadow pipelines
  • Shape how data is organised to make it usable by automations in the first place — partnering with Data Engineering on cataloguing, metadata, and lineage (e.g. via OpenMetadata) so agents are working from documented, trustworthy sources
  • Establish and maintain a model for ownership and stewardship: clear stewards for data domains and business processes, and clear owners for the automations/agents built on top of them, so accountability doesn't disappear once something goes live
  • Run the governance scaffolding for AI/automation adoption — tiered autonomy classification, risk assessment, and lifecycle management (build → test → deploy → monitor → retire) — so the organisation can scale agentic tooling without losing control of it
  • Work closely with the Data Architecture & Strategy Lead to prioritise which processes get automated first against the team's active strategic initiatives

THIS PERSON IS SOMEONE WITH...

  • Strong prior experience shipping production software
  • Hands-on experience building agentic workflows and automations in tools like n8n, and working with governed data platforms such as Databricks
  • Practical experience with agent patterns: tool use, function calling, retrieval-augmented generation, multi-step orchestration, structured outputs
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation and observability and monitoring tooling (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, etc.)
  • A systems mindset — able to think simultaneously about the automation itself, the data it depends on, the platform it runs on, and who is accountable for each of those pieces
  • Experience or strong interest in data governance and metadata management (e.g. OpenMetadata, data cataloguing, lineage) and how it underpins reliable automation
  • A builder's instinct paired with a governance instinct — comfortable shipping quickly, but equally comfortable stepping back to ask "who owns this, who's accountable if it breaks, and does it need guardrails"
  • Strong stakeholder skills — able to sit with a business team, translate a manual or ad hoc process into a well-scoped automation, and bring the right people into a conversation about ownership
  • Comfort operating with a degree of ambiguity, since this is a new kind of role at Lumi and the person will help define its shape as much as fill it
  • Experience in fintech, lending, or financial services highly regarded

BENEFITS & PERKS

Wellbeing: Free counselling, seasonal activities, Wellbeing Allowance, wellness room, flu shots

Work Life: Home Workspace Allowance, Purchased Leave, Parental Leave, Parental Flex Leave, Lumi Life Leave for challenging events, breastfeeding/expressing space

Social & Food: Monthly lunches, regular celebrations, stocked kitchen, beer & kombucha on tap, board games, rooftop BBQs

Rewards & Recognition: Competitive pay, referral bonuses, shout-out recognitions

Community Support: Paid volunteer leave, celebrations, company volunteer days

Career & Growth: Rapid advancement opportunities, higher education sponsorship, hackathons

title: Software & AI Architect
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software & AI Architect based in United States.

This is a high-impact, hands-on architecture role responsible for shaping the technical foundation of an AI-native enterprise software platform.
You’ll own architecture across core software, AI capabilities, development workflows, infrastructure, security, and governance.
The role combines strategic influence with deep technical execution, requiring you to write code, prototype solutions, and ship production systems.
You’ll help define where AI can create measurable customer and business value, while building scalable capabilities around LLMs, agents, and intelligent workflows.
Working closely with product, engineering, and executive leadership, you’ll translate complex technical decisions into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.
The environment is fast-moving and growth-oriented, with significant autonomy to establish new systems and prove their value before scaling them into dedicated teams.
This is an opportunity for an experienced architect who thrives on ambiguity, values building over presenting, and wants to shape the future of enterprise AI.

Accountabilities

  • Own the end-to-end technical architecture of the product portfolio, making decisions that support scalability, security, reliability, performance, and rapid product evolution.
  • Establish engineering standards and architectural practices appropriate for enterprise, federal, and international customers handling sensitive financial and operational data.
  • Define the organization’s AI strategy and roadmap, identifying opportunities where AI can deliver meaningful customer or business outcomes and prioritizing initiatives based on measurable value.
  • Design and build AI-native product capabilities, including agentic functionality, LLM-based workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, model orchestration, prompt and agent architectures, and evaluation frameworks.
  • Develop and operate an AI-driven development lifecycle that helps engineering teams move efficiently from concepts to production-ready software.
  • Build and validate technical solutions directly within the codebase, using working prototypes and production systems to demonstrate the value of new architectural and AI initiatives.
  • Own the technical foundation for responsible AI adoption, including model and vendor evaluation, data handling, access controls, security guardrails, and integration standards.
  • Collaborate with internal AI adoption stakeholders to establish the infrastructure and controls required for secure, company-wide use of AI technologies.
  • Operate as an individual contributor initially, taking ownership of architecture and AI initiatives while identifying when proven solutions warrant dedicated teams and additional investment.
  • Partner with executive and engineering leadership on technology and AI investment decisions, connecting initiatives to measurable outcomes such as adoption, development velocity, cost efficiency, or revenue.
  • Communicate initiative progress through clear metrics, transparent status reporting, and evidence-based recommendations.
  • Build toward scalable or standalone SaaS architecture where appropriate, reducing unnecessary dependency on individual platforms while preserving enterprise-grade capabilities.

    • Requirements

    • 8+ years of software engineering or architecture experience, including direct responsibility for designing and shipping production systems at scale.
    • 3+ years of experience leading or contributing to teams in AI-native environments, with strong expertise in LLMs, RAG, agentic systems, and multi-agent architectures.
    • Demonstrated hands-on software architecture experience, including ownership and evolution of production platform architecture rather than solely reviewing other teams’ designs.
    • Proven hands-on AI architecture experience involving production LLM tooling, agentic workflows, and AI-native product capabilities.
    • Direct experience within the ServiceNow ecosystem, ideally including hands-on architecture of ServiceNow applications rather than only external integrations.
    • Experience launching systems, initiatives, or technical functions from the ground up without an established team or playbook.
    • Strong ability to operate as a hands-on individual contributor while possessing the leadership range to recruit and build a team as initiatives mature.
    • Deep engineering fluency, including the ability to write and review code and make informed architectural and technical trade-offs across conventional software and AI-native systems.
    • Working knowledge of enterprise security, data governance, AI safety, access management, and technical guardrails applicable to enterprise, federal, and international environments.
    • Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to translate technical complexity and trade-offs into actionable business decisions.
    • A strong bias toward execution, experimentation, and measurable results rather than presentation-driven progress.
    • Sound judgment and adaptability when operating in ambiguous environments where architecture and AI strategy are still being established.
    • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
    • Experience in IT Financial Management (ITFM), Technology Expense Management (TEM), FinOps, or enterprise IT cost management is preferred.
    • Experience architecting beyond a single platform dependency and developing paths toward decoupled or standalone SaaS solutions is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with FedRAMP or other federal SaaS compliance frameworks is a plus.
    • Experience in a private-equity-backed or high-growth SaaS environment is preferred.
    • Experience establishing technical foundations for company-wide AI adoption, including security guardrails, access management, or AI tooling standards, is highly desirable.
    • Must be US-based and comfortable working remotely in a remote-first environment.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive total compensation with a salary range of $200,000–$240,000 OTE.
      • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
      • Paid time off with an emphasis on work-life balance and taking time away from work.
      • 401(k) plan with employer matching.
      • Remote-first working environment for US-based employees.
      • Opportunity to shape enterprise AI architecture and technical strategy at a growth-stage organization.
      • Significant autonomy and ownership over new technology initiatives and architectural direction.
      • Opportunity to build and eventually lead a technical team as initiatives scale.
      • Work on AI, software architecture, security, and enterprise technology challenges with direct executive visibility.
      • Full-time, US-exempt position.

title: Lubrication Specialist
description:
The Lubrication Specialist is responsible for the inspection, servicing, lubrication, and preventative maintenance of heavy mining equipment and fixed plant machinery. This position plays a critical role in maximizing equipment reliability, reducing downtime, and ensuring safe and efficient mining operations. The Lubrication Specialist works closely with maintenance personnel, operators, and supervisors to maintain proper lubrication schedules and contamination control standards across the site
Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Perform routine lubrication services on stationary mining equipment including conveyors, crushers, pumps, and support equipment.
  • Inspect equipment for proper lubricant levels, leaks, contamination, wear, and abnormal operating conditions.
  • Maintain and follow preventative maintenance lubrication schedules and procedures.
  • Collect and document oil, grease, and fluid samples for analysis and reporting.
  • Operate lubrication pumps, grease systems, and related service equipment safely and effectively.
  • Ensure proper storage, handling, labeling, and disposal of lubricants and hazardous materials in accordance with environmental and company standards.
  • Monitor and maintain automatic lubrication systems.
  • Assist maintenance teams with equipment shutdowns, repairs, and servicing activities as needed.
  • Maintain accurate service records, inspection reports, and work orders using company maintenance systems.
  • Identify and report equipment issues, safety concerns, and opportunities for reliability improvement.
  • Maintain clean work areas, service vehicles, and lubrication equipment.
  • Follow all MSHA regulations, site safety procedures, lockout/tagout requirements, and company policies.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Skills and Qualifications:
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of 1–3 years of experience in industrial, heavy equipment, or mining lubrication preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of lubrication principles, contamination control, and preventative maintenance practices.
  • Experience working with heavy mining equipment and industrial machinery preferred.
  • Ability to read and interpret maintenance manuals, service schedules, and safety procedures.
  • Familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS) is a plus.
  • Ability to understand and follow verbal and written instructions.
  • Strong commitment to workplace safety.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Willingness to work overtime, weekends, rotating shifts, or holidays as needed.
  • Maybe required to work rotating shifts in a 24/7/365 operation.

Physical Demands:
To be eligible for this position, an individual must possess the following requirements to perform the essential job functions:
  • Ability to sit, stand, climb, bend, and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to safely enter and exit heavy equipment multiple times per shift.
  • Ability to work in outdoor environments exposed to dust, noise, vibration, and changing weather conditions.
  • Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Must be able to physically perform the basic life operational functions of climbing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, fingering, grasping, feeling, talking, hearing, and repetitive motion
  • Able to operate a telephone and mine phone/radio with sufficient voice and hearing to carry on a conversation for the purpose of communicating information, to management.
  • Ability to hear sufficiently to distinguish various pitches of warning alarms.
  • Able to lift up to 50 pounds periodically.
  • Must possess a valid Driver’s license and be able to operate a light vehicle.

Benefits:
  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

title: Finance & Administration Assistant
description:
Are you an organised finance professional who enjoys variety, accuracy and supporting a busy team? Discover Waitomo is looking for a Finance & Administration Assistant to join us in Waitomo and help keep our finance function running smoothly, on a part-time permanent basis.

Tourism Holdings Limited (thl) is the world's leading provider of holiday vehicles for rent and sale, operating under various brands across Australia, New Zealand, the USA, and the UK. Our brands include maui, Apollo, Britz, Mighty rentals, and more. We also design motorhomes through Action Manufacturing and create digital products via thl Digital.

About Us:
Tourism Holdings Limited (thl) is one of New Zealand’s leading tourism businesses and Discover Waitomo delivers iconic experiences including the Waitomo Glowworm Caves, Ruakuri Cave, Aranui Cave and Black Water Rafting. We are proud of our connection to the region, our relationships with mana whenua, and our values of Manaakitanga, Whanaungatanga and Kaitiakitanga.

About the Role:
Reporting to the Commercial Accountant, you will provide accurate and timely finance and administrative support across accounts payable, reconciliations, reporting and general administration. This is a varied role where your attention to detail, initiative and ability to build strong working relationships will make a real difference.

What You’ll Do:

Process supplier invoices, creditor payments and account queries accurately and on time.
Reconcile supplier statements, bank accounts and balance sheet accounts.
Process journals, accruals and general ledger transactions.
Support month-end, year-end, audit and compliance reporting, including GST and FBT.
Assist with management reports, supporting schedules and variance analysis.
Maintain accurate finance records and data within Dynamics 365 and related systems.
Provide general administration support, prepare documentation and maintain procedures.
Contribute to process improvements, finance projects and a strong culture of health, safety and wellbeing.

What You’ll Bring:

Two to three years’ experience in accounts payable, finance administration, accounting support or a similar role.
Experience with financial processing, reconciliations and month-end activities.
Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills and confidence using Microsoft 365.
Strong attention to detail, organisation and written and verbal communication skills.
A reliable, proactive and solutions-focused approach, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
A relevant accounting, finance or business qualification, or current study towards one, is desirable.
Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance or a similar ERP, and knowledge of GST and FBT, would be advantageous.

Why Join Us?

Join a collaborative team within one of New Zealand’s leading tourism businesses.
Build your finance experience through varied work and development opportunities.
Enjoy access to unique tourism experiences across the thl network.
Work in an iconic region with a business that values people, place and community.

Ready to join the team? Apply now and bring your finance expertise, attention to detail and positive approach to Discover Waitomo.

title: Physical Therapist (PT) – Mobile/Home-Based Care
description:
Overview

We are seeking a skilled, compassionate, and dependable Physical Therapist (PT) to provide high-quality physical therapy services to patients in their homes throughout the Antelope region.

The Physical Therapist will travel to patients' homes to perform comprehensive evaluations, develop individualized plans of care, provide skilled therapeutic interventions, monitor patient progress, and educate patients and caregivers on strategies to improve mobility, function, safety, and independence.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in a home-based environment, has strong clinical judgment and communication skills, and is passionate about delivering patient-centered care.

This is a 1099 independent contractor position.

Duties and Responsibilities

· Travel to patients' homes throughout the assigned service area to provide physical therapy services.

· Perform comprehensive physical therapy evaluations in the patient's home environment.

· Assess strength, range of motion, balance, gait, mobility, coordination, endurance, pain, functional limitations, and ability to safely perform activities of daily living.

· Evaluate the patient's home environment and identify potential safety and fall risks that may impact mobility and independence.

· Develop individualized plans of care based on evaluation findings, physician orders/referrals, patient needs, clinical judgment, and functional goals.

· Establish measurable short-term and long-term functional goals.

· Provide skilled physical therapy interventions appropriate to the patient's diagnosis and functional limitations, including:

o Therapeutic exercises

o Therapeutic activities

o Neuromuscular re-education

o Gait and mobility training

o Balance and coordination training

o Functional strengthening

o Manual therapy when clinically appropriate

o Transfer training

o Fall prevention and safety training

· Train patients in the safe use of assistive devices such as walkers, canes, and other mobility equipment.

· Develop and instruct patients in individualized home exercise programs.

· Educate patients and caregivers regarding diagnosis, treatment, exercises, mobility, safety, fall prevention, and strategies to promote independence.

· Monitor patient response to treatment and make appropriate clinical modifications to the plan of care.

· Perform reassessments and communicate changes in patient condition or functional status as appropriate.

· Coordinate care with physicians, nurses, caregivers, physical therapist assistants, occupational therapists, and other healthcare professionals.

· Communicate effectively with referring providers regarding patient progress, concerns, and recommendations.

· Complete accurate, timely, and thorough documentation for evaluations, daily treatment visits, reassessments, progress reports, and discharge summaries.

· Maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations, professional standards, payer requirements, and company policies.

· Recognize changes in patient condition that may require physician notification, additional medical evaluation, or modification of treatment.

· Maintain patient confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries at all times.

· Provide compassionate, respectful, and professional care to patients and their families in the home setting.

Requirements

· Current and valid California Physical Therapist license in good standing.

· Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program.

· Strong knowledge of anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, biomechanics, and rehabilitation principles.

· Strong clinical reasoning and patient assessment skills.

· Ability to independently perform comprehensive PT evaluations and develop appropriate plans of care.

· Experience treating patients with orthopedic, musculoskeletal, neurological, balance, gait, weakness, mobility, and/or functional limitations preferred.

· Strong knowledge of therapeutic exercise, gait training, balance training, functional mobility, neuromuscular re-education, and fall prevention.

· Excellent patient assessment and acute/chronic pain management skills.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work independently and effectively manage a mobile patient caseload.

· Must be punctual, dependable, organized, and professional.

· Comfortable entering and providing care in patients' homes and working with patients and caregivers in a home-based environment.

· Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.

· Ability to travel throughout the assigned service area.

· CPR/BLS certification preferred or required according to company policy.

· Previous home health, mobile therapy, outpatient, orthopedic, neurological, geriatric, or community-based experience is preferred.

Mobile/Home-Based Care Expectations

Because this position involves providing care in patients' homes, the Physical Therapist must be able to:

· Arrive at scheduled visits within the expected timeframe.

· Manage travel time and maintain an efficient daily schedule.

· Carry and transport necessary clinical equipment and supplies.

· Adapt treatment approaches to different home environments and available space.

· Maintain a safe and professional environment during every patient visit.

· Communicate promptly regarding cancellations, scheduling changes, or patient concerns.

· Respect patients' homes, privacy, routines, and individual preferences.

· Demonstrate sound clinical judgment when working independently in the community.

Documentation and Compliance

The Physical Therapist is responsible for completing all required clinical documentation accurately and within established timeframes, including:

· Initial evaluations

· Treatment notes

· Reassessments

· Progress reports

· Recertifications, when applicable

· Discharge documentation

· Home exercise programs

· Communication with referring providers

· Other documentation required by the organization, payer, or applicable regulations

Job Type

Full-time – 1099 Independent Contractor

Pay Structure (1099)

· Guaranteed base pay: $1,080 per week

· Base compensation is calculated at $45 per patient visit, based on a minimum of 6 patient visits per day.

· $45 per additional patient visit for visits beyond the daily base of 6.

· Compensation is subject to the terms of the independent contractor agreement.

Schedule

4/10 Schedule

· Four 10-hour workdays per week

· Typical start time: 7:30 AM–8:30 AM, depending on patient scheduling and geographic coverage.

· Daily schedule may vary based on patient locations, visit duration, and patient needs.

Work Location

Mobile/Home-Based –Antelope Region

The Physical Therapist will travel to assigned patients' homes throughout the designated service area.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a clinically confident, compassionate, and self-motivated Physical Therapist who enjoys working one-on-one with patients and families. The successful candidate will be comfortable making clinical decisions independently, adapting treatment to the patient's home environment, and providing high-quality care while maintaining excellent documentation and communication.

This position is an excellent opportunity for a Physical Therapist who values autonomy, flexibility, meaningful patient relationships, and community-based care

title: Venture Content Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Venture Content Analyst based in United States .

This is an opportunity to become deeply immersed in the venture capital ecosystem and turn market intelligence into high-quality content.
You’ll track funding rounds, new funds, investors, and emerging trends to understand what is genuinely shaping the market.
The role combines venture research, investment analysis, long-form writing, and content distribution across multiple channels.
You’ll produce thoughtful pieces covering portfolio companies, investments, notable investors, major deals, and important market developments.
Working closely with senior leadership, you’ll gain direct exposure to experienced investors, proprietary processes, and the thinking behind early market signals.
The position is designed to develop into a broader VC Analyst and content-focused role over time.
It is well suited to someone who follows venture capital every day, writes with precision, and is eager to go deeper into the topics they find most compelling.

Accountabilities:

  • Stay exceptionally well informed on venture capital activity, including new funding rounds, emerging funds, notable investors, and significant market developments.
  • Research and identify the developments, trends, and announcements that have meaningful implications for the venture ecosystem.
  • Produce high-quality long-form content for blog articles, LinkedIn, newsletters, and X, prioritizing depth, insight, and accuracy over volume.
  • Write about portfolio companies, investments, fund positions, angel investments, notable investors, major funding rounds, and emerging trends.
  • Conduct the research and analysis required to develop credible, well-supported content and investment-focused narratives.
  • Work closely with the Head of Brand and senior leadership on editorial planning, publishing schedules, and distribution across content channels.
  • Develop a deeper understanding of brand building and the research processes that support effective venture-focused communications.
  • Maintain a high standard of factual accuracy, recognizing that incorrect fund names, round sizes, investor details, or other market information can materially affect credibility.
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate research and content workflows while applying strong judgment about where AI can improve efficiency and where human expertise, taste, and original thinking are essential.
  • Build knowledge and experience that can support progression into a broader VC Analyst and content role.

    • Requirements:

    • Genuine and sustained interest in the venture capital market, with a habit of following the ecosystem closely on a daily basis.
    • Strong knowledge of venture funds, investors, partners, funding rounds, and current market activity, with the ability to identify key players and developments without extensive reference material.
    • Existing experience researching and writing about venture capital, investments, startups, or related market topics.
    • Ability to independently turn research into compelling articles, investment memos, and other high-quality written content.
    • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to factual accuracy.
    • Strong research, analytical, and written communication skills, with the ability to distinguish meaningful developments from market noise.
    • Good editorial judgment and the ability to develop thoughtful, original perspectives on venture trends and investment activity.
    • Practical experience using AI tools in daily work, combined with strong judgment about appropriate and inappropriate use cases.
    • Curiosity, intellectual rigor, and enthusiasm for continuously learning about the venture ecosystem.
    • Ability to work independently and asynchronously while maintaining high standards for quality, ownership, and communication.
    • Comfort operating in a flat organization and learning directly from senior leaders and experienced market participants.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote and asynchronous work environment.
      • Close collaboration with the co-founders and Head of Brand.
      • Direct exposure to an established network of investors and high-quality venture opportunities.
      • Access to internal investment and operating processes.
      • Opportunity to learn directly from experienced leaders and team members.
      • Exposure to a broad range of venture capital activity, investors, companies, and market trends.
      • Opportunity to grow into a dedicated VC Analyst and content-focused position.
      • Meaningful ownership over long-form content and venture research.
      • Opportunity to develop expertise across venture analysis, content strategy, brand building, and market research.

description:

The Company:
Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it. This exceptional content, reach and scope offer advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:
Working remotely in New Brunswick with one of Postmedia’s news teams, ideal candidates are graduating students or recent graduates.
Enterprising self-starters and team players, they have a sense for stories that resonate with a diverse readership. A key asset is the ability to use digital tools to break and develop stories and ideas. Successful candidates will work to tight deadlines covering a wide range of news and other subjects.

Provision may be made by mutual agreement for assignment to other of Postmedia’s newsrooms. Some weekend and statutory holiday work may be included.

Develop content to engage audiences across several platforms tailored to meet the varying needs of web and mobile audiences.
Have story ideas daily, a job essential along with the flexibility to quickly pivot to other newsroom priorities to meet changing needs.
Use social media and other digital tools to uncover what’s breaking and what readers in real time are talking about which quickly needs attention.
Cultivate sources to break stories and help set the news agenda.
Work with digital teams to create interactive content, including text, photo, video and other multimedia elements that both engage and enrich readers.

A graduating journalism school student or graduate, or a candidate from a related field. Newsroom experience is an asset, but you have the ability to quickly layer and prioritize what needs to be done to quickly move up the job learning curve.
Flexible to work effectively in breaking news, features and short form, along with non-traditional story formats.
Hungry to make the most of a chance to work in a daily newsroom with top-notch journalists and eager to show what you can do to help by collaborating with colleagues.
A digger with natural curiosity, not satisfied with pat answers; always looking for hidden story angles and with a talent, or developing one, for explanatory journalism.
A reporter interested not just in what happened or is happening, but also why and how, with the ability to concisely convey that added meaning to readers.
Experience and strength in video, podcast presentation and other digital tools is an asset.
A valid driver’s license and access to a personal vehicle are also assets.

description:

Rotational Program:The Multifamily Operations team sits at the intersection of property operations, analytics, and property performance, supporting regional and property teams across the portfolio through four key functional areas. These areas will require knowledge in market knowledge, operational analytics, utility management, ancillary revenue, and pricing strategy, with hands-on daily deliverables and project deadlines.

title: Mobile Railcar Repair Technician
description:
Mobile Railcar Repair Technician

Road & Rail Services – Austin, TX
Pay: $28.00–$34.00 per hour
Full-Time | Travel Required

Experienced Railcar Repair Professionals

Road & Rail Services is hiring an experienced Mobile Railcar Repair Technician based in Austin, Texas, to perform railcar inspection, maintenance, welding, and repair work at various field locations.

This position is designed for someone who already knows railcar repair and is comfortable taking those skills on the road. You'll travel as required, work in outdoor railroad environments, and complete repairs while maintaining high standards for safety and workmanship.

Previous railcar repair experience and welding experience are required. This is not an entry-level railroad position.

If you're dependable, mechanically skilled, comfortable working independently, and interested in a long-term career in railcar maintenance, we encourage you to apply.

What You'll Do

As a Mobile Railcar Repair Technician, you will help ensure rail equipment is inspected, repaired, and prepared for safe service. Responsibilities include:

Examine railcars for damage, wear, defects, and conditions requiring repair

Determine appropriate repairs within the authorized scope of work

Perform mechanical maintenance and railcar component repairs

Complete welding and fabrication work as required

Perform stick welding and other approved welding procedures

Lubricate railcar components and complete required servicing

Apply required markings and stenciling

Complete repair records, inspection forms, and other documentation

Safely operate company vehicles, tools, and equipment

Maintain an orderly and safe work area

Follow customer, company, AAR, and applicable railroad safety requirements

Travel to assigned locations based on customer and operational needs

Experience & Qualifications

We're looking for an experienced Carman or railcar repair professional who can arrive at a job site and contribute with limited supervision.

Candidates must have:

Previous railcar maintenance or repair experience

Welding experience, including stick welding

Strong mechanical troubleshooting and repair abilities

Experience safely using hand tools, power tools, and repair equipment

Ability to work independently in field environments

Willingness and ability to travel as required

Ability to perform physical work outdoors in varying weather conditions

Valid driver's license

Dependable attendance and strong safety awareness

4G and 5G welding experience is strongly preferred.

Experience as a Railcar Mechanic, Railroad Carman, Railcar Repairman, Freight Car Repairer, or Railcar Maintenance Technician may align well with this position.

Travel & Work Environment

This is a traveling field position based in Austin, TX. Travel frequency and assignment duration will vary according to customer and business requirements.

Work is performed around railcars, railroad tracks, industrial equipment, moving machinery, noise, dirt, and changing weather conditions. Candidates should be prepared for an active, hands-on position rather than a shop or office environment.

Pay & Benefits

$28.00–$34.00 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

Road & Rail Services offers:

Weekly safety incentive opportunities

Medical, dental, and vision insurance

401(k) with company matching

Paid holidays and vacation

Annual steel-toe boot allowance

Company-provided PPE

Opportunities for career advancement

Promote-from-within environment

Build Your Career in Railcar Repair

Founded in 1987, Road & Rail Services provides rail-related services throughout North America, including railcar inspection and repair, field maintenance, and terminal operations.

If you have professional railcar repair experience, strong welding skills, and the flexibility to travel, apply today for our Mobile Railcar Repair Technician opportunity.

title: Data & AI Engineer
description:
Kō wai mātou? Who are we?

Zespri is more than simply the world's single-largest marketer of kiwifruit. We like to think of ourselves as fruit on a mission and as rebels with a cause: to help people, communities and the environment around the world thrive through the goodness of kiwifruit. We are proudly the world's largest marketer of kiwifruit, selling kiwifruit in more than 50 countries. We work with around 2,800 New Zealand and 1,500 international growers and post-harvest companies to source the best-quality Zespri Kiwifruit which we supply through our distribution partners to wholesale and retail customers. We are one of New Zealand's best-known international brands, dedicated to creating sustainable long-term value for growers.

He aha te mahi? What's the role?

Based in Bologna or Aprilia, the Data and AI Engineer is accountable for the data and platform backbone on which every analytics, AI, and BI initiative depends (across the entire data lifecycle). The role designs, builds, and owns the pipelines, data quality, and governance that turn fragmented, manual processes into a trusted, accessible single source of truth. The role prepares the launch of Zespri's data engineering and platform into the next agentic AI environments, rethinking the way data is integrated and enabling powered automation that replaces repetitive workflows. The Data and AI Engineer embeds cross-functional analytics support and data literacy through direct collaboration across teams and coordination with the global Digital Team.

Accountabilities Data Foundation & Pipeline Engineering
  • Design, develop and maintain data pipelines to ingest, process and transform data from different sources into a cloud platform.
  • Connect currently unintegrated platforms through robust API integrations.
  • Develop and maintain feature stores, data catalogues and curated datasets to deliver the Zespri Data & Technology Strategy’s initiatives.
Data Quality, Governance & Audit
  • Audit data availability and quality across Zespri: profile datasets for completeness, consistency and duplication, defining Zespri's data reliability metrics.
  • Stand up the data governance framework: designate the system-of-record platform for each data domain, remove duplication across platforms, and own data definitions.
  • Phase out Excel-based processes, migrate high-risk data and systems to strategic platforms, and version source code on GitHub Enterprise.
Analytics Support & Business Intelligence
  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate data needs into actionable solutions.
  • Prepare and serve curated, model-ready datasets for AI/ML development.
  • Prepare and structure data for Databricks Apps and Dashboards and/or SAP Analytics Cloud.
Agentic AI & Innovation
  • Design, build and orchestrate agentic AI/LLM workflows that automate manual, repetitive processes, building multiple agents within a single, well-governed ecosystem.
  • Lead the next-generation agentic-AI architecture planning.
Ko wai koe? Who are you?

You are a curious, analytical and proactive professional who enjoys solving complex problems and turning ideas into practical outcomes. You think from first principles, make well-reasoned decisions, and focus on the details that matter while keeping sight of the bigger picture. You take ownership of your work, act on opportunities, and continuously look for ways to improve how things are done.

You thrive in collaborative environments, building trust through openness, reliability and clear communication. A team-first mindset, willingness to contribute wherever needed, and the ability to explain complex topics to different audiences are key strengths. You are eager to learn, embrace new ideas and technologies, and welcome feedback as an opportunity for growth.

You will also fulfill the following:

  • At least 3+ years of delivering data engineering in a real-world business context.
  • Proficiency in Python and large-scale data processing (e.g. Spark, PySpark).
  • Strong understanding of data modelling and data warehousing concepts.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or equivalent.
  • Hands‑on experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, orchestration, and API integrations.
  • Understanding of ML/AI lifecycle and data requirements.
  • Exposure to large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and orchestration frameworks is a plus.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
He aha e tika ai a Zespri? Why Zespri?

Our people are what makes our culture so irresistible and uniquely Zespri. We are a passionate and mighty team of 850+ employees in 23 different locations globally. Working at Zespri is an opportunity to join a fast‑paced, culture‑driven environment unlike any other. We want people who share our values of making it happen, creating real connections, and leaving a legacy. Join us in shaping our future and be part of a truly unique organisation.

  • Competitive base salary of between EUR53,000 and EUR68,000, including a short term incentive scheme opportunity. Please note that individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, performance and work location.
  • FlexWELL flexible work ethos; WFH & the office.

title: Chief Artificial Intelligence (AI) Enablement Officer
description:
• Full-time, Senior-level position on a 3-year Fixed-term contract.
  • Parramatta South campus with flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive senior-level remuneration, commensurate with experience.
  • Where the successful candidate is appointed on an academic basis, the position may carry the title of Pro Vice-Chancellor.


Lead enterprise AI strategy, governance and adoption to deliver responsible transformation and measurable University-wide value.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will set the enterprise direction for artificial intelligence across Western Sydney University, translating institutional ambition into a clear strategy, multi-year roadmap and prioritised portfolio of investment. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you will advise the Vice-Chancellor, University Executive and Board on transformation opportunities, emerging technologies, institutional risk and investment priorities.

You will establish and lead the University’s AI enablement capability, bringing together academic and professional portfolios to identify, assess and scale high-value opportunities. You will establish and lead a multidisciplinary AI Enablement function, managing its people, budget, resources, vendors and delivery partners while building strategic relationships across the higher education, government, industry and technology sectors.

You will lead the University’s responsible AI governance and assurance arrangements, establishing clear decision rights, standards, controls and accountability for human oversight. Working across technology, data, cyber security, privacy, legal, risk and academic governance, you will build institutional capability, reduce fragmented investment and embed accountable AI-enabled ways of working. You will provide enterprise coordination while academic and business portfolios retain accountability for their strategies and operational outcomes.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Deliver an enterprise AI strategy and multi-year roadmap with clear priorities, investment decisions and adoption targets, supported by an annual assessment of AI maturity and future priorities.
  • Establish trusted governance, decision rights and assurance controls that enable responsible AI implementation at scale.
  • Build and prioritise a sustainable portfolio of AI initiatives based on strategic value, feasibility, risk, cost and anticipated benefits.
  • Establish a high-performing multidisciplinary AI Enablement function with the capability, resources and partnerships required to support enterprise delivery.
  • Transition proven AI solutions into enduring University services and establish benefits, adoption and maturity measures that demonstrate institutional outcomes, return on investment, delivery performance and risk.


Please refer to the Position Description for full details.

About You

  • A relevant postgraduate qualification, or an equivalent combination of senior executive experience and professional expertise in AI, technology, data, business or organisational transformation.
  • Substantial senior leadership experience delivering enterprise AI or technology-enabled transformation within a large, complex, federated or highly autonomous organisation.
  • Proven success establishing enterprise strategy, governance and investment priorities, and taking AI or enterprise generative AI platforms from experimentation through to scaled implementation and sustainable operations.
  • Strong knowledge of AI, machine learning and generative AI, including their capabilities, limitations and implications for privacy, cyber security, ethics, accessibility, information governance and model risk.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise executives and governing bodies, influence academic and professional leaders, and lead institution-wide change within higher education or another complex, regulated or knowledge-intensive environment.


Benefits
We invest in the people who make our mission possible. Alongside a rewarding career, we offer a range of benefits designed to support your financial, personal and family wellbeing.

  • Financial benefits: Access to staff-only products and offers with selected banking partners, salary sacrifice options for onsite parking, and novated motor vehicle leasing.
  • Health and wellbeing support: Free Employee Assistance Program (EAP), complimentary annual flu vaccination, eligibility for Fitness Passport membership, and access to discounted private health cover.
  • Onsite childcare: Long day care and early learning services operate at our Campbelltown, Hawkesbury, Parramatta, and Penrith campuses. Staff may be eligible for discounted fees and salary packaging, with places subject to centre capacity.


Application Details

  • Position Enquiries: Direct to Kevin Yoon, Associate Director, Talent Acquisition via kevin.yoon@westernsydney.edu.au. Please include the job reference code REF1834O.
  • Closing Date: 11:59pm, Sunday 4 October 2026.
  • Working Rights: You must provide evidence of your fulltime working rights in Australia for the full term of the appointment at time of application.
  • How to Apply: Please note that only applications submitted via the University's online recruitment system will be considered. You must submit:
    • a current curriculum vitae; and
    • a cover letter of no more than two pages outlining your suitability for the position, including your experience leading enterprise AI strategy, responsible AI governance and organisation-wide adoption.

As part of your online application, you will also be asked to respond to screening questions addressing the key qualifications, experiences and skills required for this position.


Belonging at Western
We are committed to substantive equality as outlined in our Equal Opportunity Policy. We actively encourage applications from Indigenous Australians, candidates of all gender identities and expressions, people of all abilities, and those from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds.

For Reasonable Adjustments during the application process, please contact talentacquisitionteam@westernsydney.edu.au.

About Western
This is your opportunity to be part of something bigger. By joining Western Sydney University, you become a valued member of our community. As our region changes, so too does our university. Western is boldly different, energetic, global, diverse, dynamic, and youthful.

Our mission is to deliver student success, impactful research, and stronger communities. As part of our team, you will have a stake in shaping the future of education, broadening horizons, and changing lives. Making a difference starts at Western.

title: Data Engineer – Data & AI
description:
DATA ENGINEERING

In this role, you will collaborate closely with data scientists, business analysts, and solution and analytics architects to shape innovative data solutions and products while driving the implementation, testing, and support of modern data pipelines using contemporary engineering practices. By developing efficient approaches to data ingestion, preparation, integration, and operationalization, you will contribute to strong data governance and compliance standards. You will develop dynamic ELT pipelines using modern analytics engineering platforms and technologies such as Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, DBT, and Dagster, while creating data solutions that are scalable, secure, reusable, and easy to maintain. By ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards and best practices, you will help build a robust and future-ready data ecosystem that supports business growth and innovation.

DATA & AI ENABLEMENT

You will apply AI in ways that support business objectives while ensuring adherence to security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI principles. Working closely with AI engineers, you will help design and productionize the data foundations required for AI-powered analytics, ensuring that AI systems have access to the high-quality data, features, embeddings, metadata, and evaluation datasets needed to deliver reliable and scalable outcomes.

STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

You will work closely with Data Science teams, Data Cloud Architects, and business stakeholders to establish and continuously enhance governance frameworks and processes that promote the responsible and effective use of data and technology. By building strong relationships across IT, Data, Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance, and other business functions, you will foster alignment and collaboration across the organization. In partnership with DevOps, MLOps, and Analytics Engineers, you will help maximize data availability, reliability, and accuracy while continuously improving data quality to enable the development of innovative and impactful data products.

PROJECT MANAGEMENT

You will work closely with stakeholders to gain a deep understanding of business requirements and use cases, translating insights into effective data-driven solutions. At the same time, you will drive continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and service delivery, while creating clear documentation and engaging presentations that facilitate knowledge sharing, alignment, and effective communication across teams.

University degree in IT or business administration with a focus on computer science, data science, or data engineering

Fluency in English, German is beneficial

At least three years of experience with analytics tools such as Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Dagster, DBT

Experience with SQL and Python

Architectural understanding of databases and ETL/ELT pipelines

Knowledge of SAP (BW, HANA, SAC), and analytics front-end tools is beneficial

Demonstrated enterprise mindset, with the ability to align data-engineering solutions with broader business strategy, architecture, governance, security, compliance, and operational requirements

Experience using AI coding assistants or AI-enabled data-platform tools in a professional environment

Familiarity with data science and data lake platforms on modern hyperscalers such as Azure or AWS

Enthusiasm for both engineering tasks and the implementation of business requirements
