title: Physical Therapist (PT) – Mobile/Home-Based Care
description:
Overview

We are seeking a skilled, compassionate, and dependable Physical Therapist (PT) to provide high-quality physical therapy services to patients in their homes throughout the San Fernando region.

The Physical Therapist will travel to patients' homes to perform comprehensive evaluations, develop individualized plans of care, provide skilled therapeutic interventions, monitor patient progress, and educate patients and caregivers on strategies to improve mobility, function, safety, and independence.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in a home-based environment, has strong clinical judgment and communication skills, and is passionate about delivering patient-centered care.

This is a 1099 independent contractor position.

Duties and Responsibilities

· Travel to patients' homes throughout the assigned service area to provide physical therapy services.

· Perform comprehensive physical therapy evaluations in the patient's home environment.

· Assess strength, range of motion, balance, gait, mobility, coordination, endurance, pain, functional limitations, and ability to safely perform activities of daily living.

· Evaluate the patient's home environment and identify potential safety and fall risks that may impact mobility and independence.

· Develop individualized plans of care based on evaluation findings, physician orders/referrals, patient needs, clinical judgment, and functional goals.

· Establish measurable short-term and long-term functional goals.

· Provide skilled physical therapy interventions appropriate to the patient's diagnosis and functional limitations, including:

o Therapeutic exercises

o Therapeutic activities

o Neuromuscular re-education

o Gait and mobility training

o Balance and coordination training

o Functional strengthening

o Manual therapy when clinically appropriate

o Transfer training

o Fall prevention and safety training

· Train patients in the safe use of assistive devices such as walkers, canes, and other mobility equipment.

· Develop and instruct patients in individualized home exercise programs.

· Educate patients and caregivers regarding diagnosis, treatment, exercises, mobility, safety, fall prevention, and strategies to promote independence.

· Monitor patient response to treatment and make appropriate clinical modifications to the plan of care.

· Perform reassessments and communicate changes in patient condition or functional status as appropriate.

· Coordinate care with physicians, nurses, caregivers, physical therapist assistants, occupational therapists, and other healthcare professionals.

· Communicate effectively with referring providers regarding patient progress, concerns, and recommendations.

· Complete accurate, timely, and thorough documentation for evaluations, daily treatment visits, reassessments, progress reports, and discharge summaries.

· Maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations, professional standards, payer requirements, and company policies.

· Recognize changes in patient condition that may require physician notification, additional medical evaluation, or modification of treatment.

· Maintain patient confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries at all times.

· Provide compassionate, respectful, and professional care to patients and their families in the home setting.

Requirements

· Current and valid California Physical Therapist license in good standing.

· Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program.

· Strong knowledge of anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, biomechanics, and rehabilitation principles.

· Strong clinical reasoning and patient assessment skills.

· Ability to independently perform comprehensive PT evaluations and develop appropriate plans of care.

· Experience treating patients with orthopedic, musculoskeletal, neurological, balance, gait, weakness, mobility, and/or functional limitations preferred.

· Strong knowledge of therapeutic exercise, gait training, balance training, functional mobility, neuromuscular re-education, and fall prevention.

· Excellent patient assessment and acute/chronic pain management skills.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work independently and effectively manage a mobile patient caseload.

· Must be punctual, dependable, organized, and professional.

· Comfortable entering and providing care in patients' homes and working with patients and caregivers in a home-based environment.

· Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.

· Ability to travel throughout the assigned service area.

· CPR/BLS certification preferred or required according to company policy.

· Previous home health, mobile therapy, outpatient, orthopedic, neurological, geriatric, or community-based experience is preferred.

Mobile/Home-Based Care Expectations

Because this position involves providing care in patients' homes, the Physical Therapist must be able to:

· Arrive at scheduled visits within the expected timeframe.

· Manage travel time and maintain an efficient daily schedule.

· Carry and transport necessary clinical equipment and supplies.

· Adapt treatment approaches to different home environments and available space.

· Maintain a safe and professional environment during every patient visit.

· Communicate promptly regarding cancellations, scheduling changes, or patient concerns.

· Respect patients' homes, privacy, routines, and individual preferences.

· Demonstrate sound clinical judgment when working independently in the community.

Documentation and Compliance

The Physical Therapist is responsible for completing all required clinical documentation accurately and within established timeframes, including:

· Initial evaluations

· Treatment notes

· Reassessments

· Progress reports

· Recertifications, when applicable

· Discharge documentation

· Home exercise programs

· Communication with referring providers

· Other documentation required by the organization, payer, or applicable regulations

Job Type

Full-time – 1099 Independent Contractor

Pay Structure (1099)

· Guaranteed base pay: $1,080 per week

· Base compensation is calculated at $45 per patient visit, based on a minimum of 6 patient visits per day.

· $45 per additional patient visit for visits beyond the daily base of 6.

· Compensation is subject to the terms of the independent contractor agreement.

Schedule

4/10 Schedule

· Four 10-hour workdays per week

· Typical start time: 7:30 AM–8:30 AM, depending on patient scheduling and geographic coverage.

· Daily schedule may vary based on patient locations, visit duration, and patient needs.

Work Location

Mobile/Home-Based – San Fernando Region

The Physical Therapist will travel to assigned patients' homes throughout the designated service area.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a clinically confident, compassionate, and self-motivated Physical Therapist who enjoys working one-on-one with patients and families. The successful candidate will be comfortable making clinical decisions independently, adapting treatment to the patient's home environment, and providing high-quality care while maintaining excellent documentation and communication.

This position is an excellent opportunity for a Physical Therapist who values autonomy, flexibility, meaningful patient relationships, and community-based care

title: Specialist, Customer Identity and Access management (CIAM)
description:
Overview of Role
The Specialist, Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) is a focused technical role responsible for delivering guidance and hands-on expertise across customer identity platforms, authentication services, and access management technologies. This role places customer identity at the center of a secure digital experience strategy, with expertise in customer creation, authentication, authorization, identity management, privacy, operations, and governance.
The Specialist provides technical expertise for CIAM platforms and solutions, helping ensure secure, scalable, and seamless customer access experiences while aligning with organizational security, privacy, and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities
Serve as a subject matter expert for Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM), maintaining advanced knowledge of customer identity platforms, authentication protocols, customer registration and profile management, identity federation, and access management technologies.
Design, implement, and support customer identity solutions including OAuth2, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), OpenID Connect (OIDC), passwordless authentication, delegated authorization, and customer identity management.
Develop and maintain CIAM standards, security controls, and best practices that support guests experiences while protecting organizational assets and customer data.
Consolidate expertise from multiple internal and external sources, including vendors, consultants, security specialists, and business stakeholders, to provide recommendations that support organizational objectives.

title: Physical Therapist (PT) – Mobile/Home-Based Care
description:
Overview

We are seeking a skilled, compassionate, and dependable Physical Therapist (PT) to provide high-quality physical therapy services to patients in their homes throughout the Jacksonville region.

The Physical Therapist will travel to patients' homes to perform comprehensive evaluations, develop individualized plans of care, provide skilled therapeutic interventions, monitor patient progress, and educate patients and caregivers on strategies to improve mobility, function, safety, and independence.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in a home-based environment, has strong clinical judgment and communication skills, and is passionate about delivering patient-centered care.

This is a 1099 independent contractor position.

Duties and Responsibilities

· Travel to patients' homes throughout the assigned service area to provide physical therapy services.

· Perform comprehensive physical therapy evaluations in the patient's home environment.

· Assess strength, range of motion, balance, gait, mobility, coordination, endurance, pain, functional limitations, and ability to safely perform activities of daily living.

· Evaluate the patient's home environment and identify potential safety and fall risks that may impact mobility and independence.

· Develop individualized plans of care based on evaluation findings, physician orders/referrals, patient needs, clinical judgment, and functional goals.

· Establish measurable short-term and long-term functional goals.

· Provide skilled physical therapy interventions appropriate to the patient's diagnosis and functional limitations, including:

o Therapeutic exercises

o Therapeutic activities

o Neuromuscular re-education

o Gait and mobility training

o Balance and coordination training

o Functional strengthening

o Manual therapy when clinically appropriate

o Transfer training

o Fall prevention and safety training

· Train patients in the safe use of assistive devices such as walkers, canes, and other mobility equipment.

· Develop and instruct patients in individualized home exercise programs.

· Educate patients and caregivers regarding diagnosis, treatment, exercises, mobility, safety, fall prevention, and strategies to promote independence.

· Monitor patient response to treatment and make appropriate clinical modifications to the plan of care.

· Perform reassessments and communicate changes in patient condition or functional status as appropriate.

· Coordinate care with physicians, nurses, caregivers, physical therapist assistants, occupational therapists, and other healthcare professionals.

· Communicate effectively with referring providers regarding patient progress, concerns, and recommendations.

· Complete accurate, timely, and thorough documentation for evaluations, daily treatment visits, reassessments, progress reports, and discharge summaries.

· Maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations, professional standards, payer requirements, and company policies.

· Recognize changes in patient condition that may require physician notification, additional medical evaluation, or modification of treatment.

· Maintain patient confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries at all times.

· Provide compassionate, respectful, and professional care to patients and their families in the home setting.

Requirements

· Current and valid Florida Physical Therapist license in good standing.

· Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program.

· Strong knowledge of anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, biomechanics, and rehabilitation principles.

· Strong clinical reasoning and patient assessment skills.

· Ability to independently perform comprehensive PT evaluations and develop appropriate plans of care.

· Experience treating patients with orthopedic, musculoskeletal, neurological, balance, gait, weakness, mobility, and/or functional limitations preferred.

· Strong knowledge of therapeutic exercise, gait training, balance training, functional mobility, neuromuscular re-education, and fall prevention.

· Excellent patient assessment and acute/chronic pain management skills.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work independently and effectively manage a mobile patient caseload.

· Must be punctual, dependable, organized, and professional.

· Comfortable entering and providing care in patients' homes and working with patients and caregivers in a home-based environment.

· Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.

· Ability to travel throughout the assigned service area.

· CPR/BLS certification preferred or required according to company policy.

· Previous home health, mobile therapy, outpatient, orthopedic, neurological, geriatric, or community-based experience is preferred.

Mobile/Home-Based Care Expectations

Because this position involves providing care in patients' homes, the Physical Therapist must be able to:

· Arrive at scheduled visits within the expected timeframe.

· Manage travel time and maintain an efficient daily schedule.

· Carry and transport necessary clinical equipment and supplies.

· Adapt treatment approaches to different home environments and available space.

· Maintain a safe and professional environment during every patient visit.

· Communicate promptly regarding cancellations, scheduling changes, or patient concerns.

· Respect patients' homes, privacy, routines, and individual preferences.

· Demonstrate sound clinical judgment when working independently in the community.

Documentation and Compliance

The Physical Therapist is responsible for completing all required clinical documentation accurately and within established timeframes, including:

· Initial evaluations

· Treatment notes

· Reassessments

· Progress reports

· Recertifications, when applicable

· Discharge documentation

· Home exercise programs

· Communication with referring providers

· Other documentation required by the organization, payer, or applicable regulations

Job Type

Full-time – 1099 Independent Contractor

Pay Structure (1099)

· Guaranteed base pay: $1,080 per week

· Base compensation is calculated at $45 per patient visit, based on a minimum of 6 patient visits per day.

· $45 per additional patient visit for visits beyond the daily base of 6.

· Compensation is subject to the terms of the independent contractor agreement.

Schedule

4/10 Schedule

· Four 10-hour workdays per week

· Typical start time: 7:30 AM–8:30 AM, depending on patient scheduling and geographic coverage.

· Daily schedule may vary based on patient locations, visit duration, and patient needs.

Work Location

Mobile/Home-Based –Jacksonville Region

The Physical Therapist will travel to assigned patients' homes throughout the designated service area.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a clinically confident, compassionate, and self-motivated Physical Therapist who enjoys working one-on-one with patients and families. The successful candidate will be comfortable making clinical decisions independently, adapting treatment to the patient's home environment, and providing high-quality care while maintaining excellent documentation and communication.

This position is an excellent opportunity for a Physical Therapist who values autonomy, flexibility, meaningful patient relationships, and community-based care

Coordinate surgical procedures, testing, appointments, and interventional encounters under the direction of the Practice Manager and physicians.
Schedule procedures efficiently while coordinating physician calendars and avoiding scheduling conflicts or delays.
Communicate appointment details, surgical preparation instructions, and follow-up requirements to patients.
Coordinate pre-operative requirements, including consents, medical clearance, pre-surgical appointments, and required documentation.
Coordinate post-operative care and follow-up under the direction of the provider.
Ensure referral and medical record information is complete and available prior to patient admission.
Help ensure patients with end-stage renal disease have appropriate, functioning dialysis access prior to initiating dialysis.
Monitor daily schedules for cancellations, add-on patients, and changes and make appropriate adjustments.
Ensure timely interventional encounters are scheduled in the appropriate setting.

Patient Communication & Customer Service

Welcome patients and visitors with a professional, compassionate, and helpful approach.
Interview patients regarding clinical, scheduling, and financial information while maintaining dignity and confidentiality.
Answer and appropriately route incoming telephone calls.
Communicate clearly with patients, physicians, dialysis facilities, and referring providers.
Serve as a key point of contact for patients throughout the scheduling and surgical process.

Insurance & Revenue Cycle Support

Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits, including Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance.
Obtain required referrals and insurance pre-authorizations.
Collect and accurately document insurance and demographic information.
Forward complete and accurate billing information to the Revenue Cycle Management team.
Assist with resolving scheduling or authorization issues that could impact patient care or reimbursement.

Dialysis & Physician Coordination

Communicate with dialysis units regarding patient appointments, procedures, results, and follow-up care.
Coordinate dialysis treatments and transportation when necessary.
Act as an intermediary between physicians, referring facilities, and dialysis centers.
Ensure procedure results, reports, consult letters, and other physician correspondence are appropriately distributed.
Prepare and maintain physician reports, dictation, narratives, consult letters, and other correspondence.

Administrative Support

Open the access center each day and ensure the center is prepared for patient activity.
Maintain accurate patient charts, records, and documentation.
Pull and organize patient charts and records as needed.
Perform administrative duties including filing, faxing, mailing, correspondence, and data entry.
Monitor and order office supplies and equipment as needed.
Maintain strict patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and all applicable policies and regulations.
Participate in team meetings, training, conferences, and other organizational activities.
Provide coverage at other centers and work overtime as needed.
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

What We're Looking For

High school diploma or equivalent required.
2+ years of experience in a healthcare, medical office, surgical practice, medical billing, or related environment required.
Experience with insurance verification, referrals, and prior authorizations.
Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance plans.
Working knowledge of medical terminology.
Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong customer service skills and a compassionate approach to patient interactions.
High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work effectively with physicians, clinical staff, patients, dialysis facilities, and insurance companies.
Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately.
Medical Assistant (MA) certification preferred.

Preferred Experience
Experience in any of the following areas is a plus:

Vascular access
Nephrology
Dialysis
Ambulatory surgery
Surgical scheduling
Medical billing or revenue cycle
Insurance authorization
Patient access or referral coordination

Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the care of patients who depend on reliable vascular access for their ongoing dialysis treatment. You’ll work closely with physicians, clinical teams, dialysis partners, and patients while helping ensure procedures are scheduled, authorized, and coordinated smoothly from start to finish.
If you are organized, compassionate, detail-oriented, and enjoy being the person who keeps things moving, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Talent Sourcing Partner
description:
Talent Sourcing Partner
If you enjoy teaming up with top talent, strong processes, and robust technology then you'll enjoy Magnit Global as we continue our investment in People, Process, and Technology. Magnit Global, a global consulting firm supporting contingent workforce management, is currently recruiting for the position of Talent Sourcing Partner.
Magnit Global introduced the first purely vendor neutral model for managing the contingent workforce in 1994 and continues to be an industry leader servicing our global clients throughout the US and in more than 50 countries. Managed Service Providers (MSP) today capture 50% of the more than $1.0 Trillion in temp and contractor spend, a percentage estimated by analysts to experience double-digit growth annually for the next decade.
Why Should You Apply
Direct sourced talent is at the forefront of every organization’s strategy for contingent labor. Developing and engaging trusted talent networks who contribute their skills and experience will continue to be an area of focus and growth for leading organizations. DirectSource MAGNIT is an exciting solution Magnit Global is offering to our clients to provide the best-in-class solution for direct sourcing. Joining this team is an excellent opportunity for someone that wants to be part of something innovative and wants the challenge of developing a successful service, solution, and program. This role is built for someone that is self-motivated and adaptable to change and will give individuals an opportunity to leave their mark on how the team is developed and grows. Direct sourcing is expected to grow rapidly and as a result there will be opportunity to learn, grow, and progress in your career with Magnit Global. If you have a background in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, Human Resources, Managed Services, or anything else related to contingent labor/talent development, then this might be the position for you!

About The Role
Magnit’s direct sourcing solution called DirectSource Magnit, utilizes cutting edge AI technology and best-in-class curation services to match candidates from private talent pools to open positions. The Talent Sourcing Partner (TSP) is most often working remotely supporting a specific client(s) and is responsible for the day to day delivery of DirectSource MAGNIT services. There may be some travel to client sites required.

The TSP is a client-facing role that engages regularly with client hiring managers to deliver the services outlined in PRO’s Scope of Work. As a business partner, the TSP regularly leads direct sourcing initiatives with representatives of Client corporate functions (Talent Acquisition, Human Resources Operations, Vendor Management, Information Systems, Risk Management) and third party suppliers. In addition, the TSP works closely with MAGNIT colleagues from various departments who contribute to delivery excellence.
The TSP works under the direction of a Direct Sourcing Manager to ensure candidates from talent communities associated with our clients are curated through the contingent hiring process. TSPs will consult with client stakeholders to enable talent curation strategies and campaigns in order to ensure labor sourcing goals are met. A TSP will be expected to build trusting relationships with DirectSource MAGNIT candidates from cradle to grave with the goal of giving every candidate a noteworthy, delightful experience. TSPs will demonstrate creative solutioning, data driven decision making, and a “people first” approach to achieving program success. TSPs will fulfill high levels of customer satisfaction while adhering to client’s culture, expectations, and code of conduct.

Location
Remote- US Based working PST/ MST/ CST Hours
The ideal candidate would be located in Austin, TX or the Bay Area, CA (would be ideal if the candidate could onsite once per quarter)

What You Will Do
DirectSource MAGNIT engagements may vary depending on the client demand. In all cases, the TSP is viewed as a Business Partner who provides ongoing consultation to ensure an optimal execution of agreed upon scope.

Curation Services

Oversee and manage the fulfillment of contingent worker requisitions through the DirectSource MAGNIT solution
Validate new openings, review matched candidates, submit best matches to hiring managers, communicate with and guide candidates through the process, facilitate manager decision making.
Engage with hiring managers and others to ensure quality job descriptions to ensure candidate fit, quantity, and rate optimization.
Develop and deploy strategies to attract candidates to the talent pool, ensure worker information is up to date and that the appropriate skill sets are present to meet client needs
Meet with managers and their leadership to update direct sourcing strategy and talent pool development
Actively ensure optimal communication between hiring managers and candidates to yield timely and effective fulfillment.
Educate and guide hiring managers on appropriate all-inclusive market bill rates based on review of the job duties and supplier candidate submission to ensure appropriate rates and timely requisition fulfillment
Identify process efficiencies and recommend implementation to the Program Manager
On occasion manage or assist with third party payroll and/or 1099 Compliance work

General Functions:

Maintain an updated Desk SOP “Standard Operating Procedures” for day-to-day operations so that the program functions efficiently
Evaluate all processes with an eye to effectiveness and efficiency. Implement new processes and enhance current process to strengthen efficiency
Develop positive and professional relationships with client hiring managers on a regular basis to gauge satisfaction and develop a trusted-advisor relationship
Manage the resolution of complex issues that may jeopardize PRO’s reputation with the client or that require the involvement of senior MAGNIT resources, utilizing the Program Manager or other internal partners for support
Apply sound judgement and good decision-making skills when handling critical Employee Relations issues. Resolve and follow through, in a timely manner, all issues related to the worker, either at the request of the worker or that of his/her manager
Provide consultation to client managers as needed in a manner that yields collaboration and risk mitigation
Participate in and deliver monthly governance reporting and quarterly business reviews
May train new team members on learning systems and procedures
Generate and analyze all required weekly reports to both client and MAGNIT on a timely basis
Follow all required client and MAGNIT mandated procedures and policies during the exercise of their responsibilities
Display integrity in the use of equipment, resources and materials

What You Will Need

College degree, AA or equivalent experience
Three years of experience in technical recruiting or sourcing and customer service (MUST HAVE)
Experience in sales, marketing, or staffing industry operations, is a plus.
Ability to communicate effectively in writing, verbal, and interpersonal. Able to interact and communicate with all levels of staff and clients.
Must have good customer service and organizational skills.
Able to lift up to 20 pounds, bend, stoop, sit at desk for extended periods of time, and to move about from building to building.
Detail oriented, critical think, problem solver.

Compensation
Salary range is $65,000-$80,000 USD annually.
Salary rates are based on experience, skills, and geographical location.

title: Head of Distribution
description:
Head of Distribution (Indirect Revenue & Distribution)

Location: Dunstable (LU5 5XE), hybrid working 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home/another location
Function: Sales & Distribution (Commercial)
Salary: £100,000 - £115,000 dependant on skills and experiences £7,500 car allowance + up to 50% bonus + health + up to 10% matched pension + bens

At Whitbread, we're proud to be the home of Premier Inn, the UK's largest hotel brand. Having built an industry-leading direct booking model, we're now entering an exciting new phase of growth and are looking for an exceptional Head of Distribution to shape the future of our indirect business.
This is a newly created, high-profile leadership role with the opportunity to define and execute a distribution strategy that will influence hundreds of millions of pounds in revenue. You will lead our approach across Online Travel Agencies (OTAs), Travel Management Companies (TMCs) and key connectivity partners, ensuring every partnership drives profitable, incremental demand while delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Cross- departmental relationships will be key to execution. You will work closely with Commercial, Revenue Management, Marketing and Finance leaders to determine how, when and where we activate distribution channels to maximise performance.
Leading a team of around 12 Account Managers, Sales and Technical specialists, you will build capability, raise performance standards and create a culture focused on commercial excellence, accountability and results.

You will bring experience of creating distribution strategies, negotiating large-scale commercial agreements, leading successful sales teams and influencing senior stakeholders across complex organisations. Existing relationships across the OTA, TMC and wider distribution ecosystem would be highly advantageous.
If you're excited by the opportunity to reshape a major distribution function, influence board-level thinking and help build a multi-hundred million pound indirect business for one of the UK's most recognised brands, we would love to hear from you.
We’re proud to be a Top Employer for 14 consecutive years, a top apprenticeship employer, a Leader in Stonewall’s Proud Employer Accreditation, and a Top 25 Exemplary Employer in the Investing in Ethnicity Parliamentary Matrix.

title: Municipal Engineer
description:
Are you a Municipal Engineer looking to work on diverse and exciting projects with a dedicated team? At ISL, you'll join people who genuinely enjoy working together, collaborating across disciplines through our OneISL approach.

If you're hard working, detail oriented, passionate about learning new skills, and like capturing projects from all angles, this is the position for you. We'd love to hear from you, especially if designing water and wastewater solutions and seeing then come to life in the field excites you.
A Little About Us
ISL is comprised of just over 600 award-winning engineers, technologists, planners, landscape architects, scientists, and professionals who work together to deliver infrastructure projects that minimize environmental impacts and maximize benefits to the community.
Learn more about our work by visiting us on Instagram @islengineering / LinkedIn and feel free to join our ISL newsletter on LinkedIn: Inside ISL.
More about what we do:

We deliver on a variety of multidisciplinary projects including linear infrastructure and stations.
We have extensive expertise – We are comprised of five sectors specializing in Transportation, Municipal and Community, Bridges, Building and Structures, and Land and Environment. Learn more about our areas of practice.
We are award winning and recognized in industry – Visit our #ISLLife blog and learn more.

About the Role
ISL’s Calgary Water/Wastewater Service Line, as part of our Municipal Sector, provides expert assessment, design, construction and commissioning services for water and wastewater systems in communities. We are a multi-disciplinary team of over 20 ISLers, providing services in and around Western Canada.
We are looking for a person to join our close knit team who can apply their knowledge and experience in detailed design to deliver a variety of services for our public and private sector clients with a focus on providing water and wastewater infrastructure designs from planning through construction. We offer our team members a diverse range of projects on which to hone their skills and are committed to team member career progression. We pride ourselves on delivering quality service to our clients on each of our projects.
Responsibilities:
This position will be responsible for multiple aspects of design and tendering including:

Design of water and wastewater projects including analysis of existing data, site visits, hydraulic design calculations, and design drawing markups
Assisting project managers with project coordination
Assisting with quantity take-offs and cost estimates
Report and technical memo writing
Writing of project and technical specifications
Assisting with construction administration
Leveraging technology to provide high quality deliverables
Assisting with creating proposal content

Please note that you will require a valid Driver’s License and reliable means of transportation/vehicle.
Ready to throw your name in?
As a new member of ISL’s Municipal Service Line team, this future ISLer models our organizational values of Curiosity, Unity, Integrity and Excellence.
Your cover letter must demonstrate:

If you are just starting out, what is something that excites you about the municipal engineering industry?
If you’re a few years into your career, what is a past project or work experience that excited you or had significant meaning to you?

Your resume should show us:

A degree in Civil Engineering, and an EIT or P.Eng. designation with APEGA, or eligibility for registration with APEGA.
1 to 5 years of related experience, preferably in municipal water and wastewater design.
Past experiences collaborating with internal and external clients.
Past experiences working in a fast paced environment with competing priorities.

Bonus points for:

Previous experience in municipal water and wastewater design
Experience in supporting projects from planning to construction where you have played a role in the full cycle of development

What ISL Offers
Thank you for considering ISL Engineering as your next step.
We value you for your contributions and want to ensure that your personal success is intertwined with your professional success. Our wellness philosophy encompasses the four pillars of physical, mental, financial, and spiritual wellbeing. Our benefits package is comprehensive and offers you some of the best available tools to maximize your career and lifestyle.
Depending on your experience level, the salary range (based on a 40-hour work week) is:
$74,000 to $100,000
Here are some of the exceptional benefits we provide:

Flexible working hours
Hybrid work structure
Employer paid benefits including health, dental and extensive paramedical services
Healthcare Spending and Lifestyle Option Accounts
Group RRSP
Annual bonus incentives
Paid professional development opportunities and memberships
An excellent onboarding and mentorship plan to set you up for success
24/7/365 Employee Family Assistance program

Life Insurance and AD&D options.
Parental leave top ups.
Shareholder opportunities.
Service Recognition Awards.

Location:
ISL is proudly located in over 16 offices across Western Canada. This position will be located in:

Calgary
